verses.en: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.fr: Théophile, j''ai parlé, dans mon premier livre, de tout ce que Jésus a commencé de faire et d''enseigner dès le commencement
verses.am: ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥

verses.en: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.fr: jusqu''au jour où il fut enlevé au ciel, après avoir donné ses ordres, par le Saint-Esprit, aux apôtres qu''il avait choisis.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ የመረጣቸውን ሐዋርያትን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ካዘዛቸው በኋላ እስከ ዐረገበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ያደርገውና ያስተምረው ዘንድ ስለ ጀመረው ሁሉ መጀመሪያውን ነገር ጻፍሁ፤

verses.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verses.fr: Après qu''il eut souffert, il leur apparut vivant, et leur en donna plusieurs preuves, se montrant à eux pendant quarante jours, et parlant des choses qui concernent le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ደግሞ አርባ ቀን እየታያቸው ስለ እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ነገር እየነገራቸው፥ በብዙ ማስረጃ ከሕማማቱ በኋላ ሕያው ሆኖ ለእነርሱ ራሱን አሳያቸው።

verses.en: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
verses.fr: Comme il se trouvait avec eux, il leur recommanda de ne pas s''éloigner de Jérusalem, mais d''attendre ce que le Père avait promis, ce que je vous ai annoncé, leur dit-il;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር አብሮ ሳለ ከኢየሩሳሌም እንዳይወጡ አዘዛቸው፥ ነገር ግን። ከእኔ የሰማችሁትን አብ የሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል ጠብቁ፤

verses.en: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
verses.fr: car Jean a baptisé d''eau, mais vous, dans peu de jours, vous serez baptisés du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ በውኃ አጥምቆ ነበርና፥ እናንተ ግን ከጥቂት ቀን በኃላ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ትጠመቃላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
verses.fr: Alors les apôtres réunis lui demandèrent: Seigneur, est-ce en ce temps que tu rétabliras le royaume d''Israël?
verses.am: እነርሱም በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ወራት ለእስራኤል መንግሥትን ትመልሳለህን? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Ce n''est pas à vous de connaître les temps ou les moments que le Père a fixés de sa propre autorité.
verses.am: እርሱም። አብ በገዛ ሥልጣኑ ያደረገውን ወራትንና ዘመናትን ታውቁ ዘንድ ለእናንተ አልተሰጣችሁም፤

verses.en: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.fr: Mais vous recevrez une puissance, le Saint-Esprit survenant sur vous, et vous serez mes témoins à Jérusalem, dans toute la Judée, dans la Samarie, et jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስ በእናንተ ላይ በወረደ ጊዜ ኃይልን ትቀበላላችሁ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በይሁዳም ሁሉ በሰማርያም እስከ ምድር ዳርም ድረስ ምስክሮቼ ትሆናላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.fr: Après avoir dit cela, il fut élevé pendant qu''ils le regardaient, et une nuée le déroba à leurs yeux.
verses.am: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ እነርሱ እያዩት ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ደመናም ከዓይናቸው ሰውራ ተቀበለችው።

verses.en: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.fr: Et comme ils avaient les regards fixés vers le ciel pendant qu''il s''en allait, voici, deux hommes vêtus de blanc leur apparurent,
verses.am: እርሱም ሲሄድ ወደ ሰማይ ትኵር ብለው ሲመለከቱ ሳሉ፥ እነሆ፥ ነጫጭ ልብስ የለበሱ ሁለት ሰዎች በአጠገባቸው ቆሙ፤

verses.en: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.fr: et dirent: Hommes Galiléens, pourquoi vous arrêtez-vous à regarder au ciel? Ce Jésus, qui a été enlevé au ciel du milieu de vous, viendra de la même manière que vous l''avez vu allant au ciel.
verses.am: ደግሞም። የገሊላ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ወደስማይ እየተመለከታችሁ ስለ ምን ቆማችኋል? ይህ ከእናንተ ወደ ሰማይ የወጣው ኢየሱስ ወደ ሰማይ ሲሄድ እንዳያችሁት፥ እንዲሁ ይመጣል አሉአቸው።

verses.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
verses.fr: Alors ils retournèrent à Jérusalem, de la montagne appelée des oliviers, qui est près de Jérusalem, à la distance d''un chemin de sabbat.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደብረ ዘይት ከሚባለው ተራራ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ እርሱም ከኢየሩሳሌም የሰንበት መንገድ ያህል የራቀ ነው።

verses.en: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
verses.fr: Quand ils furent arrivés, ils montèrent dans la chambre haute où ils se tenaient d''ordinaire; c''étaient Pierre, Jean, Jacques, André, Philippe, Thomas, Barthélemy, Matthieu, Jacques, fils d''Alphée, Simon le Zélote, et Jude, fils de Jacques.
verses.am: በገቡም ጊዜ ወደሚኖሩበት ሰገነት ወጡ፥ ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስም፥ ያዕቆብም፥ እንድርያስም፥ ፊልጶስም፥ ቶማስም፥ በርተሎሜዎስም፥ ማቴዎስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም፥ ቀናተኛ የሚባለው ስምዖንም፥ የያዕቆብ ልጅ ይሁዳም።

verses.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.fr: Tous d''un commun accord persévéraient dans la prière, avec les femmes, et Marie, mère de Jésus, et avec les frères de Jésus.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከሴቶችና ከኢየሱስ እናት ከማርያም ከወንድሞቹም ጋር በአንድ ልብ ሆነው ለጸሎት ይተጉ ነበር።

verses.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.fr: En ces jours-là, Pierre se leva au milieu des frères, le nombre des personnes réunies étant d''environ cent vingt. Et il dit:
verses.am: በዚህም ወራት ጴጥሮስ መቶ ሀያ በሚያህል በሰዎች ማኅበር አብረው በነበሩ በወንድሞቹ መካከል ተነሥቶ አለ።

verses.en: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.fr: Hommes frères, il fallait que s''accomplît ce que le Saint-Esprit, dans l''Ecriture, a annoncé d''avance, par la bouche de David, au sujet de Judas, qui a été le guide de ceux qui ont saisi Jésus.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ኢየሱስን ለያዙት መሪ ስለሆናቸው ስለ ይሁዳ መንፈስ ቅዱስ አስቀድሞ በዳዊት አፍ የተናገረው የመጽሐፍ ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይገባ ነበር፤

verses.en: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.fr: Il était compté parmi nous, et il avait part au même ministère.
verses.am: ከእኛ ጋር ተቈጥሮ ነበርና፥ ለዚህም አገልግሎት ታድሎ ነበርና።

verses.en: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.fr: Cet homme, ayant acquis un champ avec le salaire du crime, est tombé, s''est rompu par le milieu du corps, et toutes ses entrailles se sont répandues.
verses.am: ይህም ሰው በዓመፅ ዋጋ መሬት ገዛ በግንባሩም ተደፍቶ ከመካከሉ ተሰነጠቀ አንጀቱም ሁሉ ተዘረገፈ፤

verses.en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.fr: La chose a été si connue de tous les habitants de Jérusalem que ce champ a été appelé dans leur langue Hakeldama, c''est-à-dire, champ du sang.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ሁሉ ታወቀ፤ ስለዚህም ያ መሬት በቋንቋቸው አኬልዳማ ተብሎ ተጠራ፥ እርሱም የደም መሬት ማለት ነው።

verses.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
verses.fr: Or, il est écrit dans le livre des Psaumes: Que sa demeure devienne déserte, Et que personne ne l''habite! Et: Qu''un autre prenne sa charge!
verses.am: በመዝሙር መጽሐፍ። መኖሪያው ምድረ በዳ ትሁን የሚኖርባትም አይኑር፤ ደግሞም። ሹመቱን ሌላ ይውሰዳት ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
verses.fr: Il faut donc que, parmi ceux qui nous ont accompagnés tout le temps que le Seigneur Jésus a vécu avec nous,
verses.am: ኢዮስጦስም የሚሉትን በርስያን የተባለውን ዮሴፍንና ማትያስን ሁለቱን አቆሙ።

verses.en: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.fr: depuis le baptême de Jean jusqu''au jour où il a été enlevé du milieu de nous, il y en ait un qui nous soit associé comme témoin de sa résurrection.
verses.am: ኢዮስጦስም የሚሉትን በርስያን የተባለውን ዮሴፍንና ማትያስን ሁለቱን አቆሙ።

verses.en: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.fr: Ils en présentèrent deux: Joseph appelé Barsabbas, surnommé Justus, et Matthias.
verses.am: ዕጣም ተጣጣሉላቸው፥ ዕጣውም ለማትያስ ወደቀና ከአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ጋር ተቈጠረ።

verses.en: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
verses.fr: Puis ils firent cette prière: Seigneur, toi qui connais les coeurs de tous, désigne lequel de ces deux tu as choisi,
verses.am: ዕጣም ተጣጣሉላቸው፥ ዕጣውም ለማትያስ ወደቀና ከአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ጋር ተቈጠረ።

verses.en: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
verses.fr: afin qu''il ait part à ce ministère et à cet apostolat, que Judas a abandonné pour aller en son lieu.
verses.am: ሲጸልዩም። የሁሉን ልብ የምታውቅ አንተ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይሁዳ ወደ ገዛ ራሱ ስፍራ ይሄድ ዘንድ በተዋት በዚህች አገልግሎትና ሐዋርያነት ስፍራን እንዲቀበል የመረጥኸውን ከእነዚህ ከሁለቱ አንዱን ሹመው አሉ።

verses.en: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
verses.fr: Ils tirèrent au sort, et le sort tomba sur Matthias, qui fut associé aux onze apôtres.
verses.am: ዕጣም ተጣጣሉላቸው፥ ዕጣውም ለማትያስ ወደቀና ከአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ጋር ተቈጠረ።

verses.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.fr: Le jour de la Pentecôte, ils étaient tous ensemble dans le même lieu.
verses.am: በዓለ ኀምሳ የተባለውም ቀን በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ ሁሉም በአንድ ልብ ሆነው አብረው ሳሉ፥

verses.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.fr: Tout à coup il vint du ciel un bruit comme celui d''un vent impétueux, et il remplit toute la maison où ils étaient assis.
verses.am: ድንገት እንደሚነጥቅ ዓውሎ ነፋስ ከሰማይ ድምፅ መጣ፥ ተቀምጠው የነበሩበትንም ቤት ሁሉ ሞላው።

verses.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verses.fr: Des langues, semblables à des langues de feu, leur apparurent, séparées les unes des autres, et se posèrent sur chacun d''eux.
verses.am: እንደ እሳትም የተከፋፈሉ ልሳኖች ታዩአቸው፤ በያንዳንዳቸውም ላይ ተቀመጡባቸው።

verses.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.fr: Et ils furent tous remplis du Saint-Esprit, et se mirent à parler en d''autres langues, selon que l''Esprit leur donnait de s''exprimer.
verses.am: በሁሉም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው፥ መንፈስም ይናገሩ ዘንድ እንደ ሰጣቸው በሌላ ልሳኖች ይናገሩ ጀመር።

verses.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait en séjour à Jérusalem des Juifs, hommes pieux, de toutes les nations qui sont sous le ciel.
verses.am: ከሰማይም በታች ካሉ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በጸሎት የተጉ አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌም ይኖሩ ነበር፤

verses.en: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
verses.fr: Au bruit qui eut lieu, la multitude accourut, et elle fut confondue parce que chacun les entendait parler dans sa propre langue.
verses.am: ይህም ድምፅ በሆነ ጊዜ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፥ እያንዳንዱም በገዛ ቋንቋው ሲናገሩ ይሰማ ስለ ነበር የሚሉትን አጡ።

verses.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
verses.fr: Ils étaient tous dans l''étonnement et la surprise, et ils se disaient les uns aux autres: Voici, ces gens qui parlent ne sont-ils pas tous Galiléens?
verses.am: ተገርመውም ተደንቀውም እንዲህ አሉ። እነሆ፥ እነዚህ የሚናገሩት ሁሉ የገሊላ ሰዎች አይደሉምን?

verses.en: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
verses.fr: Et comment les entendons-nous dans notre propre langue à chacun, dans notre langue maternelle?
verses.am: እኛም እያንዳንዳችን የተወለድንበትን የገዛ ቋንቋችንን እንዴት እንሰማለን?

verses.en: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
verses.fr: Parthes, Mèdes, Elamites, ceux qui habitent la Mésopotamie, la Judée, la Cappadoce, le Pont, l''Asie,
verses.am: የጳርቴና የሜድ የኢላሜጤም ሰዎች፥ በሁለት ወንዝም መካከል በይሁዳም በቀጰዶቅያም በጳንጦስም በእስያም፥

verses.en: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
verses.fr: la Phrygie, la Pamphylie, l''Egypte, le territoire de la Libye voisine de Cyrène, et ceux qui sont venus de Rome, Juifs et prosélytes,
verses.am: በፍርግያም በጵንፍልያም በግብፅም በቀሬናም በኩል ባሉት በሊቢያ ወረዳዎች የምንኖር፥ በሮሜም የምንቀመጥ፥ አይሁድም ወደ ይሁዲነትም የገባን፥

verses.en: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
verses.fr: Crétois et Arabes, comment les entendons-nous parler dans nos langues des merveilles de Dieu?
verses.am: የቀርጤስና የዓረብ ሰዎች፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ታላቅ ሥራ በልሳኖቻችን ሲናገሩ እንሰማቸዋለን።

verses.en: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.fr: Ils étaient tous dans l''étonnement, et, ne sachant que penser, ils se disaient les uns aux autres: Que veut dire ceci?
verses.am: ሁሉም ተገረሙና አመንትተው እርስ በርሳቸው። እንጃ ይህ ምን ይሆን? አሉ።

verses.en: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
verses.fr: Mais d''autres se moquaient, et disaient: Ils sont pleins de vin doux.
verses.am: ሌሎች ግን እያፌዙባቸው። ጉሽ የወይን ጠጅ ጠግበዋል አሉ።

verses.en: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
verses.fr: Alors Pierre, se présentant avec les onze, éleva la voix, et leur parla en ces termes: Hommes Juifs, et vous tous qui séjournez à Jérusalem, sachez ceci, et prêtez l''oreille à mes paroles!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጴጥሮስ ከአሥራ አንዱ ጋር ቆመ፥ ድምፁንም ከፍ አድርጎ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው። አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሁላችሁ፥ ይህ በእናንተ ዘንድ የታወቀ ይሁን፥ ቃሎቼንም አድምጡ።

verses.en: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
verses.fr: Ces gens ne sont pas ivres, comme vous le supposez, car c''est la troisième heure du jour.
verses.am: ለእናንተ እንደ መሰላችሁ እነዚህ የሰከሩ አይደሉም፥ ከቀኑ ሦስተኛ ሰዓት ነውና፤

verses.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
verses.fr: Mais c''est ici ce qui a été dit par le prophète Joël:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህ በነቢዩ በኢዩኤል የተባለው ነው።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.fr: Dans les derniers jours, dit Dieu, je répandrai de mon Esprit sur toute chair; Vos fils et vos filles prophétiseront, Vos jeunes gens auront des visions, Et vos vieillards auront des songes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይላል። በመጨረሻው ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ሥጋ በለበሰ ሁሉ ላይ ከመንፈሴ አፈሳለሁ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ጎበዞቻችሁም ራእይ ያያሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም ሕልም ያልማሉ፤

verses.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
verses.fr: Oui, sur mes serviteurs et sur mes servantes, Dans ces jours-là, je répandrai de mon Esprit; et ils prophétiseront.
verses.am: ደግሞም በዚያች ወራት በወንዶችና በሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ ላይ ከመንፈሴ አፈሳለሁ ትንቢትም ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
verses.fr: Je ferai paraître des prodiges en haut dans le ciel et des miracles en bas sur la terre, Du sang, du feu, et une vapeur de fumée;
verses.am: ድንቆችን በላይ በሰማይ፥ ምልክቶችንም በታች በምድር እሰጣለሁ፤ ደምም እሳትም የጢስ ጭጋግም ይሆናል፤

verses.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and notable day of the Lord come:
verses.fr: Le soleil se changera en ténèbres, Et la lune en sang, Avant l''arrivée du jour du Seigneur, De ce jour grand et glorieux.
verses.am: ታላቅ የሆነ የተሰማም የጌታ ቀን ሳይመጣ ፀሐይ ወደ ጨለማ ጨረቃም ወደ ደም ይለወጣሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.fr: Alors quiconque invoquera le nom du Seigneur sera sauvé.
verses.am: የጌታን ስም የሚጠራም ሁሉ ይድናል።

verses.en: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.fr: Hommes Israélites, écoutez ces paroles! Jésus de Nazareth, cet homme à qui Dieu a rendu témoignage devant vous par les miracles, les prodiges et les signes qu''il a opérés par lui au milieu de vous, comme vous le savez vous-mêmes;
verses.am: የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤ ራሳችሁ እንደምታውቁ፥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ በእርሱ በኩል ባደረገው ተአምራትና በድንቆች በምልክቶችም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ለእናንተ የተገለጠ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.fr: cet homme, livré selon le dessein arrêté et selon la prescience de Dieu, vous l''avez crucifié, vous l''avez fait mourir par la main des impies.
verses.am: እርሱንም በእግዚአብሔር በተወሰነው አሳቡና በቀደመው እውቀቱ ተሰጥቶ በዓመፀኞች እጅ ሰቅላችሁ ገደላችሁት።

verses.en: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.fr: Dieu l''a ressuscité, en le délivrant des liens de la mort, parce qu''il n''était pas possible qu''il fût retenu par elle.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን የሞትን ጣር አጥፍቶ አስነሣው፥ ሞት ይይዘው ዘንድ አልቻለምና።

verses.en: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.fr: Car David dit de lui: Je voyais constamment le Seigneur devant moi, Parce qu''il est à ma droite, afin que je ne sois point ébranlé.
verses.am: ዳዊት ስለ እርሱ እንዲህ ይላልና። ጌታን ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አየሁት፥ እንዳልታወክ በቀኜ ነውና።

verses.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
verses.fr: Aussi mon coeur est dans la joie, et ma langue dans l''allégresse; Et même ma chair reposera avec espérance,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ልቤን ደስ አለው፥ ልሳኔም ሐሤት አደረገ፥ ደግሞም ሥጋዬ በተስፋ ያድራል፤

verses.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.fr: Car tu n''abandonneras pas mon âme dans le séjour des morts, Et tu ne permettras pas que ton Saint voie la corruption.
verses.am: ነፍሴን በሲኦል አትተዋትምና፥ ቅዱስህንም መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትሰጠውም።

verses.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verses.fr: Tu m''as fait connaître les sentiers de la vie, Tu me rempliras de joie par ta présence.
verses.am: የሕይወትን መንገድ አስታወቅኸኝ፤ ከፊትህ ጋር ደስታን ትሞላብኛለህ።

verses.en: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
verses.fr: Hommes frères, qu''il me soit permis de vous dire librement, au sujet du patriarche David, qu''il est mort, qu''il a été enseveli, et que son sépulcre existe encore aujourd''hui parmi nous.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስለ አባቶች አለቃ ስለ ዳዊት እንደ ሞተም እንደ ተቀበረም ለእናንተ በግልጥ እናገር ዘንድ ፍቀዱልኝ፤ መቃብሩም እስከ ዛሬ በእኛ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
verses.fr: Comme il était prophète, et qu''il savait que Dieu lui avait promis avec serment de faire asseoir un de ses descendants sur son trône,
verses.am: ነቢይ ስለ ሆነ፥ ከወገቡም ፍሬ በዙፋኑ ያስቀምጥ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር መሐላ እንደ ማለለት ስለ አወቀ፥

verses.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
verses.fr: c''est la résurrection du Christ qu''il a prévue et annoncée, en disant qu''il ne serait pas abandonné dans le séjour des morts et que sa chair ne verrait pas la corruption.
verses.am: ስለ ክርስቶስ ትንሣኤ አስቀድሞ አይቶ፥ ነፍሱ በሲኦል እንዳልቀረች ሥጋውም መበስበስን እንዳላየ ተናገረ።

verses.en: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.fr: C''est ce Jésus que Dieu a ressuscité; nous en sommes tous témoins.
verses.am: ይህን ኢየሱስን እግዚአብሔር አስነሣው ለዚህም ነገር እኛ ሁላችን ምስክሮች ነን፤

verses.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
verses.fr: Elevé par la droite de Dieu, il a reçu du Père le Saint-Esprit qui avait été promis, et il l''a répandu, comme vous le voyez et l''entendez.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎና የመንፈስ ቅዱስን የተስፋ ቃል ከአብ ተቀብሎ ይህን እናንተ አሁን የምታዩትንና የምትሰሙትን አፈሰሰው።

verses.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.fr: Car David n''est point monté au ciel, mais il dit lui-même: Le Seigneur a dit à mon Seigneur: Assieds-toi à ma droite,
verses.am: አለ። እንግዲህ ይህን እናንተ የሰቀላችሁትን ኢየሱስን እግዚአብሔር ጌታም ክርስቶስም እንዳደረገው የእስራኤል ወገን ሁሉ በእርግጥ ይወቅ።

verses.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que je fasse de tes ennemis ton marchepied.
verses.am: አለ። እንግዲህ ይህን እናንተ የሰቀላችሁትን ኢየሱስን እግዚአብሔር ጌታም ክርስቶስም እንዳደረገው የእስራኤል ወገን ሁሉ በእርግጥ ይወቅ።

verses.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made the same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
verses.fr: Que toute la maison d''Israël sache donc avec certitude que Dieu a fait Seigneur et Christ ce Jésus que vous avez crucifié.
verses.am: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ ልባቸው ተነካ፥ ጴጥሮስንና ሌሎችንም ሐዋርያት። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ምን እናድርግ? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu ce discours, ils eurent le coeur vivement touché, et ils dirent à Pierre et aux autres apôtres: Hommes frères, que ferons-nous?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ንስሐ ግቡ፥ ኃጢአታችሁም ይሰረይ ዘንድ እያንዳንዳችሁ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም ተጠመቁ፤ የመንፈስ ቅዱስንም ስጦታ ትቀበላላችሁ።

verses.en: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Pierre leur dit: Repentez-vous, et que chacun de vous soit baptisé au nom de Jésus-Christ, pour le pardon de vos péchés; et vous recevrez le don du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: የተስፋው ቃል ለእናንተና ለልጆቻችሁ ጌታ አምላካችንም ወደ እርሱ ለሚጠራቸው በሩቅ ላሉ ሁሉ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.en: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
verses.fr: Car la promesse est pour vous, pour vos enfants, et pour tous ceux qui sont au loin, en aussi grand nombre que le Seigneur notre Dieu les appellera.
verses.am: በብዙ ሌላ ቃልም መሰከረና። ከዚህ ጠማማ ትውልድ ዳኑ ብሎ መከራቸው።

verses.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
verses.fr: Et, par plusieurs autres paroles, il les conjurait et les exhortait, disant: Sauvez-vous de cette génération perverse.
verses.am: ቃሉንም የተቀበሉ ተጠመቁ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሦስት ሺህ የሚያህል ነፍስ ተጨመሩ፤

verses.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
verses.fr: Ceux qui acceptèrent sa parole furent baptisés; et, en ce jour-là, le nombre des disciples s''augmenta d''environ trois mille âmes.
verses.am: በሐዋርያትም ትምህርትና በኅብረት እንጀራውንም በመቍረስ በየጸሎቱም ይተጉ ነበር።

verses.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.fr: Ils persévéraient dans l''enseignement des apôtres, dans la communion fraternelle, dans la fraction du pain, et dans les prières.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሰው ሁሉ ፍርሀት ሆነ፤ በሐዋርያትም እጅ ብዙ ድንቅና ምልክት ተደረገ።

verses.en: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
verses.fr: La crainte s''emparait de chacun, et il se faisait beaucoup de prodiges et de miracles par les apôtres.
verses.am: ያመኑትም ሁሉ አብረው ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui croyaient étaient dans le même lieu, et ils avaient tout en commun.
verses.am: ያላቸውንም ሁሉ አንድነት አደረጉ። መሬታቸውንና ጥሪታቸውንም እየሸጡ፥ ማንኛውም እንደሚፈልግ ለሁሉ ያካፍሉት ነበር።

verses.en: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
verses.fr: Ils vendaient leurs propriétés et leurs biens, et ils en partageaient le produit entre tous, selon les besoins de chacun.
verses.am: በየቀኑም በአንድ ልብ ሆነው በመቅደስ እየተጉ በቤታቸውም እንጀራ እየቈረሱ፥ በደስታና በጥሩ ልብ ምግባቸውን ይመገቡ ነበር፤

verses.en: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.fr: Ils étaient chaque jour tous ensemble assidus au temple, ils rompaient le pain dans les maisons, et prenaient leur nourriture avec joie et simplicité de coeur,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑ በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስ ነበራቸው። ጌታም የሚድኑትን ዕለት ዕለት በእነርሱ ላይ ይጨምር ነበር።

verses.en: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
verses.fr: louant Dieu, et trouvant grâce auprès de tout le peuple. Et le Seigneur ajoutait chaque jour à l''Eglise ceux qui étaient sauvés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑ በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስ ነበራቸው። ጌታም የሚድኑትን ዕለት ዕለት በእነርሱ ላይ ይጨምር ነበር።

verses.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
verses.fr: Pierre et Jean montaient ensemble au temple, à l''heure de la prière: c''était la neuvième heure.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስም በጸሎት ጊዜ በዘጠኝ ሰዓት ወደ መቅደስ ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.fr: Il y avait un homme boiteux de naissance, qu''on portait et qu''on plaçait tous les jours à la porte du temple appelée la Belle, pour qu''il demandât l''aumône à ceux qui entraient dans le temple.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደስም ከሚገቡት ምጽዋት ይለምን ዘንድ፥ ሰዎች ተሸክመው መልካም በሚሉአት በመቅደስ ደጅ በየቀኑ ያስቀምጡት የነበሩ ከእናቱ ማኅፀን ጀምሮ አንካሳ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
verses.fr: Cet homme, voyant Pierre et Jean qui allaient y entrer, leur demanda l''aumône.
verses.am: እርሱም ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ወደ መቅደስ ሊገቡ እንዳላቸው ባየ ጊዜ፥ ምጽዋትን ለመናቸው።

verses.en: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
verses.fr: Pierre, de même que Jean, fixa les yeux sur lui, et dit: Regarde-nous.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ከዮሐንስ ጋር ትኵር ብሎ ወደ እርሱ ተመልክቶ። ወደ እኛ ተመልከት አለው።

verses.en: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.fr: Et il les regardait attentivement, s''attendant à recevoir d''eux quelque chose.
verses.am: እርሱም አንድ ነገር ከእነርሱ እንዲቀበል ሲጠብቅ ወደ እነርሱ ተመለከተ።

verses.en: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.fr: Alors Pierre lui dit: Je n''ai ni argent, ni or; mais ce que j''ai, je te le donne: au nom de Jésus-Christ de Nazareth, lève-toi et marche.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን። ብርና ወርቅ የለኝም፤ ይህን ያለኝን ግን እሰጥሃለሁ፤ በናዝሬቱ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም ተነሣና ተመላለስ አለው።

verses.en: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.fr: Et le prenant par la main droite, il le fit lever. Au même instant, ses pieds et ses chevilles devinrent fermes;
verses.am: በቀኝ እጁም ይዞ አስነሣው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም እግሩና ቍርጭምጭምቱ ጸና፥

verses.en: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.fr: d''un saut il fut debout, et il se mit à marcher. Il entra avec eux dans le temple, marchant, sautant, et louant Dieu.
verses.am: ወደ ላይ ዘሎም ቆመ፥ ይመላለስም ጀመር፤ እየተመላለሰም እየዘለለም እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገነ ከእነርሱ ጋር ወደ መቅደስ ገባ።

verses.en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.fr: Tout le monde le vit marchant et louant Dieu.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነ ሲመላለስ አዩት፤

verses.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
verses.fr: Ils reconnaissaient que c''était celui qui était assis à la Belle porte du temple pour demander l''aumône, et ils furent remplis d''étonnement et de surprise au sujet de ce qui lui était arrivé.
verses.am: መልካምም በሚሉአት በመቅደስ ደጅ ስለ ምጽዋት ተቀምጦ የነበረው እርሱ እንደ ሆነ አወቁት፤ በእርሱም ከሆነው የተነሣ መደነቅና መገረም ሞላባቸው።

verses.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
verses.fr: Comme il ne quittait pas Pierre et Jean, tout le peuple étonné accourut vers eux, au portique dit de Salomon.
verses.am: እርሱም ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ይዞ ሳለ፥ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እየተደነቁ የሰሎሞን ደጅ መመላለሻ በሚባለው አብረው ወደ እነርሱ ሮጡ።

verses.en: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
verses.fr: Pierre, voyant cela, dit au peuple: Hommes Israélites, pourquoi vous étonnez-vous de cela? Pourquoi avez-vous les regards fixés sur nous, comme si c''était par notre propre puissance ou par notre piété que nous eussions fait marcher cet homme?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም አይቶ ለሕዝቡ እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ። የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ፥ በዚህ ስለ ምን ትደነቃላችሁ? ወይስ በገዛ ኃይላችን ወይስ እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራታችን ይህ ይመላለስ ዘንድ እንዳደረግነው ስለ ምን ትኵር ብላችሁ ታዩናላችሁ?

verses.en: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
verses.fr: Le Dieu d''Abraham, d''Isaac et de Jacob, le Dieu de nos pères, a glorifié son serviteur Jésus, que vous avez livré et renié devant Pilate, qui était d''avis qu''on le relâchât.
verses.am: የአብርሀምና የይስሐቅ የያዕቆብም አምላክ፥ የአባቶቻችን አምላክ፥ እናንተ አሳልፋችሁ የሰጣችሁትንና ሊፈታው ቈርጦ ሳለ በጲላጦስ ፊት የካዳችሁትን ብላቴናውን ኢየሱስን አከበረው።

verses.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
verses.fr: Vous avez renié le Saint et le Juste, et vous avez demandé qu''on vous accordât la grâce d''un meurtrier.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ቅዱሱን ጻድቁንም ክዳችሁ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ሰው ይሰጣችሁ ዘንድ ለመናችሁ፥

verses.en: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
verses.fr: Vous avez fait mourir le Prince de la vie, que Dieu a ressuscité des morts; nous en sommes témoins.
verses.am: የሕይወትንም ራስ ገደላችሁት፤ እርሱን ግን እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን አስነሣው፥ ለዚህም ነገር እኛ ምስክሮች ነን።

verses.en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.fr: C''est par la foi en son nom que son nom a raffermi celui que vous voyez et connaissez; c''est la foi en lui qui a donné à cet homme cette entière guérison, en présence de vous tous.
verses.am: በስሙም በማመን ይህን የምታዩትንና የምታውቁትን የእርሱ ስም አጸናው፥ በእርሱም በኩል የሆነው እምነት በሁላችሁ ፊት ይህን ፍጹም ጤና ሰጠው።

verses.en: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, frères, je sais que vous avez agi par ignorance, ainsi que vos chefs.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እናንተ እንደ አለቆቻችሁ ደግሞ ባለማወቅ እንዳደረጋችሁት አውቄአለሁ፤

verses.en: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu a accompli de la sorte ce qu''il avait annoncé d''avance par la bouche de tous ses prophètes, que son Christ devait souffrir.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ክርስቶስ መከራ እንዲቀበል አስቀድሞ በነቢያት ሁሉ አፍ የተናገረውን እንዲሁ ፈጸመው።

verses.en: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord.
verses.fr: Repentez-vous donc et convertissez-vous, pour que vos péchés soient effacés, afin que des temps de rafraîchissement viennent de la part du Seigneur,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከጥንት ጀምሮ በቅዱሳን ነቢያቱ አፍ የተናገረው፥ ነገር ሁሉ እስከሚታደስበት ዘመን ድረስ ሰማይ ይቀበለው ዘንድ ይገባልና።

verses.en: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
verses.fr: et qu''il envoie celui qui vous a été destiné, Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከጥንት ጀምሮ በቅዱሳን ነቢያቱ አፍ የተናገረው፥ ነገር ሁሉ እስከሚታደስበት ዘመን ድረስ ሰማይ ይቀበለው ዘንድ ይገባልና።

verses.en: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
verses.fr: que le ciel doit recevoir jusqu''aux temps du rétablissement de toutes choses, dont Dieu a parlé anciennement par la bouche de ses saints prophètes.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለአባቶች። ጌታ አምላክ እኔን እንዳስነሣኝ ነቢይን ከወንድሞቻችሁ ያስነሣላችኋል፤ በሚነግራችሁ ሁሉ እርሱን ስሙት።

verses.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
verses.fr: Moïse a dit: Le Seigneur votre Dieu vous suscitera d''entre vos frères un prophète comme moi; vous l''écouterez dans tout ce qu''il vous dira,
verses.am: ያንም ነቢይ የማትሰማው ነፍስ ሁሉ ከሕዝብ ተለይታ ትጠፋለች አለ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
verses.fr: et quiconque n''écoutera pas ce prophète sera exterminé du milieu du peuple.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም ከሳሙኤል ጀምሮ ከእርሱም በኋላ የተናገሩት ነቢያት ሁሉ ደግሞ ስለዚህ ወራት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
verses.fr: Tous les prophètes qui ont successivement parlé, depuis Samuel, ont aussi annoncé ces jours-là.
verses.am: እናንተ የነቢያት ልጆችና እግዚአብሔር ለአብርሃም። በዘርህ የምድር ወገኖች ሁሉ ይባረካሉ ብሎ፥ ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ያደረገው የኪዳን ልጆች ናችሁ።

verses.en: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
verses.fr: Vous êtes les fils des prophètes et de l''alliance que Dieu a traitée avec nos pères, en disant à Abraham: Toutes les familles de la terre seront bénies en ta postérité.
verses.am: ለእናንተ አስቀድሞ እግዚአብሔር ብላቴናውን አስነሥቶ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከክፋታችሁ እየመለሰ ይባርካችሁ ዘንድ፥ ሰደደው።

verses.en: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
verses.fr: C''est à vous premièrement que Dieu, ayant suscité son serviteur, l''a envoyé pour vous bénir, en détournant chacun de vous de ses iniquités.
verses.am: ለእናንተ አስቀድሞ እግዚአብሔር ብላቴናውን አስነሥቶ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከክፋታችሁ እየመለሰ ይባርካችሁ ዘንድ፥ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
verses.fr: Tandis que Pierre et Jean parlaient au peuple, survinrent les sacrificateurs, le commandant du temple, et les sadducéens,
verses.am: ለሕዝቡም ሲናገሩ የካህናት አለቆችና የመቅደስ አዛዥ ሰዱቃውያንም፥

verses.en: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.fr: mécontents de ce qu''ils enseignaient le peuple, et annonçaient en la personne de Jésus la résurrection des morts.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ስለ አስተማሩና በኢየሱስ የሙታንን ትንሣኤ ስለ ሰበኩ ተቸግረው፥ ወደ እነርሱ ቀረቡ፥

verses.en: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
verses.fr: Ils mirent les mains sur eux, et ils les jetèrent en prison jusqu''au lendemain; car c''était déjà le soir.
verses.am: እጃቸውንም ጭነውባቸው አሁን መሽቶ ነበርና እስከ ማግሥቱ ድረስ በወኅኒ አኖሩአቸው።

verses.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
verses.fr: Cependant, beaucoup de ceux qui avaient entendu la parole crurent, et le nombre des hommes s''éleva à environ cinq mille.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ቃሉን ከሰሙት ብዙዎች አመኑ፥ የወንዶችም ቍጥር አምስት ሺህ ያህል ሆነ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
verses.fr: Le lendemain, les chefs du peuple, les anciens et les scribes,

verses.en: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: s''assemblèrent à Jérusalem, avec Anne, le souverain sacrificateur, Caïphe, Jean, Alexandre, et tous ceux qui étaient de la race des principaux sacrificateurs.
verses.am: በነገውም አለቆቻቸውና ሽማግሌዎች ጻፎችም ሊቀ ካህናቱ ሐናም ቀያፋም ዮሐንስም እስክንድሮስም የሊቀ ካህናቱም ዘመዶች የነበሩት ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ፤

verses.en: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
verses.fr: Ils firent placer au milieu d''eux Pierre et Jean, et leur demandèrent: Par quel pouvoir, ou au nom de qui avez-vous fait cela?
verses.am: እነርሱንም በመካከል አቁመው። በምን ኃይል ወይስ በማን ስም እናንተ ይህን አደረጋችሁ? ብለው ጠየቁአቸው።

verses.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
verses.fr: Alors Pierre, rempli du Saint-Esprit, leur dit: Chefs du peuple, et anciens d''Israël,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መንፈስ ቅዱስንም ተሞልቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ የሕዝብ አለቆችና ሽማግሌዎች፥

verses.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
verses.fr: puisque nous sommes interrogés aujourd''hui sur un bienfait accordé à un homme malade, afin que nous disions comment il a été guéri,
verses.am: እኛ ዛሬ ለድውዩ ሰው ስለ ተደረገው መልካም ሥራ ይህ በምን እንደዳነ ብንመረመር፥

verses.en: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
verses.fr: sachez-le tous, et que tout le peuple d''Israël le sache! C''est par le nom de Jésus-Christ de Nazareth, que vous avez crucifié, et que Dieu a ressuscité des morts, c''est par lui que cet homme se présente en pleine santé devant vous.
verses.am: እናንተ በሰቀላችሁት እግዚአብሔርም ከሙታን ባስነሣው በናዝሬቱ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም ይህ ደኅና ሆኖ በፊታችሁ እንደ ቆመ፥ ለእናንተ ለሁላችሁ ለእስራኤልም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የታወቀ ይሁን።

verses.en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
verses.fr: Jésus est La pierre rejetée par vous qui bâtissez, Et qui est devenue la principale de l''angle.
verses.am: እናንተ ግንበኞች የናቃችሁት፥ የማዕዘን ራስ የሆነው ይህ ድንጋይ ነው።

verses.en: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verses.fr: Il n''y a de salut en aucun autre; car il n''y a sous le ciel aucun autre nom qui ait été donné parmi les hommes, par lequel nous devions être sauvés.
verses.am: መዳንም በሌላ በማንም የለም፤ እንድንበት ዘንድ የሚገባን ለሰዎች የተሰጠ ስም ከሰማይ በታች ሌላ የለምና።

verses.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils virent l''assurance de Pierre et de Jean, ils furent étonnés, sachant que c''étaient des hommes du peuple sans instruction; et ils les reconnurent pour avoir été avec Jésus.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስም በግልጥ እንደ ተናገሩ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ መጽሐፍን የማያውቁና ያልተማሩ ሰዎች እንደ ሆኑ አስተውለው አደነቁ፥ ከኢየሱስም ጋር እንደ ነበሩ አወቁአቸው፤

verses.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
verses.fr: Mais comme ils voyaient là près d''eux l''homme qui avait été guéri, ils n''avaient rien à répliquer.
verses.am: የተፈወሰውንም ሰው ከእነርሱ ጋር ቆሞ ሲያዩ የሚመልሱትን አጡ።

verses.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
verses.fr: Ils leur ordonnèrent de sortir du sanhédrin, et ils délibérèrent entre eux,
verses.am: ከሸንጎም ወደ ውጭ ይወጡ ዘንድ አዝዘው። በእነዚህ ሰዎች ምን እንሥራ?

verses.en: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
verses.fr: disant: Que ferons-nous à ces hommes? Car il est manifeste pour tous les habitants de Jérusalem qu''un miracle signalé a été accompli par eux, et nous ne pouvons pas le nier.
verses.am: የታወቀ ምልክት በእነርሱ እጅ እንደ ተደረገ በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተገልጦአልና፥ እንሸሽገው ዘንድ አንችልም፤

verses.en: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
verses.fr: Mais, afin que la chose ne se répande pas davantage parmi le peuple, défendons-leur avec menaces de parler désormais à qui que ce soit en ce nom-là.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሕዝቡ ዘንድ አብዝቶ እንዳይስፋፋ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ለማንም ሰው በዚህ ስም እንዳይናገሩ እየዛትን እንዘዛቸው ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተማከሩ።

verses.en: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
verses.fr: Et les ayant appelés, ils leur défendirent absolument de parler et d''enseigner au nom de Jésus.
verses.am: ጠርተውም በኢየሱስ ስም ፈጽመው እንዳይናገሩና እንዳያስተምሩ አዘዙአቸው።

verses.en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
verses.fr: Pierre et Jean leur répondirent: Jugez s''il est juste, devant Dieu, de vous obéir plutôt qu''à Dieu;
verses.am: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ግን መልሰው። እግዚአብሔርን ከመስማት ይልቅ እናንተን እንሰማ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የሚገባ እንደ ሆነ ቍረጡ፤

verses.en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
verses.fr: car nous ne pouvons pas ne pas parler de ce que nous avons vu et entendu.
verses.am: እኛስ ያየነውንና የሰማነውን ከመናገር ዝም ማለት አንችልም አሉአቸው።

verses.en: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
verses.fr: Ils leur firent de nouvelles menaces, et les relâchèrent, ne sachant comment les punir, à cause du peuple, parce que tous glorifiaient Dieu de ce qui était arrivé.
verses.am: እነርሱም እንደ ምን እንደሚቀጡ ምክንያት ስላላገኙባቸው፥ እንደ ገና ዝተው ከሕዝቡ የተነሣ ፈቱአቸው፤ ሰዎች ሁሉ ስለ ሆነው ነገር እግዚአብሔርን ያከብሩ ነበርና።

verses.en: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
verses.fr: Car l''homme qui avait été l''objet de cette guérison miraculeuse était âgé de plus de quarante ans.
verses.am: ይህ የመፈወስ ምልክት የተደረገለት ሰው ከአርባ ዓመት ይበልጠው ነበርና።

verses.en: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
verses.fr: Après avoir été relâchés, ils allèrent vers les leurs, et racontèrent tout ce que les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens leur avaient dit.
verses.am: ተፈትተውም ወደ ወገኖቻቸው መጡና የካህናት አለቆችና ሽማግሌዎች ያሉአቸውን ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው።

verses.en: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils l''eurent entendu, ils élevèrent à Dieu la voix tous ensemble, et dirent: Seigneur, toi qui as fait le ciel, la terre, la mer, et tout ce qui s''y trouve,
verses.am: እነርሱም በሰሙ ጊዜ በአንድ ልብ ሆነው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አደረጉ እንዲህም አሉ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ሰማዩንና ምድሩን ባሕሩንም በእነርሱም የሚኖረውን ሁሉ የፈጠርህ፥

verses.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
verses.fr: c''est toi qui as dit par le Saint-Esprit, par la bouche de notre père, ton serviteur David: Pourquoi ce tumulte parmi les nations, Et ces vaines pensées parmi les peuples?
verses.am: በመንፈስ ቅዱስም በብላቴናህ በአባታችን በዳዊት አፍ። አሕዛብ ለምን አጕረመረሙ? ሕዝቡስ ከንቱን ነገር ለምን አሰቡ?

verses.en: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
verses.fr: Les rois de la terre se sont soulevés, Et les princes se sont ligués Contre le Seigneur et contre son Oint.
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት ተነሡ አለቆችም በጌታና በተቀባው ላይ አብረው ተከማቹ ብለህ የተናገርህ አምላክ ነህ።

verses.en: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
verses.fr: En effet, contre ton saint serviteur Jésus, que tu as oint, Hérode et Ponce Pilate se sont ligués dans cette ville avec les nations et avec les peuples d''Israël,
verses.am: ከጸለዩም በኋላ ተሰብስበው የነበሩበት ስፍራ ተናወጠ፥ በሁሉም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል በግልጥ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
verses.fr: pour faire tout ce que ta main et ton conseil avaient arrêté d''avance.
verses.am: ከጸለዩም በኋላ ተሰብስበው የነበሩበት ስፍራ ተናወጠ፥ በሁሉም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል በግልጥ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
verses.fr: Et maintenant, Seigneur, vois leurs menaces, et donne à tes serviteurs d''annoncer ta parole avec une pleine assurance,
verses.am: ከጸለዩም በኋላ ተሰብስበው የነበሩበት ስፍራ ተናወጠ፥ በሁሉም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል በግልጥ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
verses.fr: en étendant ta main, pour qu''il se fasse des guérisons, des miracles et des prodiges, par le nom de ton saint serviteur Jésus.
verses.am: ያመኑትም ሕዝብ አንድ ልብ አንዲትም ነፍስ ነበሩአቸው፥ ገንዘባቸውም ሁሉ በአንድነት ነበረ እንጂ ካለው አንድ ነገር ስንኳ የራሱ እንደ ሆነ ማንም አልተናገረም።

verses.en: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
verses.fr: Quand ils eurent prié, le lieu où ils étaient assemblés trembla; ils furent tous remplis du Saint-Esprit, et ils annonçaient la parole de Dieu avec assurance.
verses.am: ሐዋርያትም የጌታን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ትንሣኤ በታላቅ ኃይል ይመሰክሩ ነበር፤ በሁሉም ላይ ታላቅ ጸጋ ነበረባቸው።

verses.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
verses.fr: La multitude de ceux qui avaient cru n''était qu''un coeur et qu''une âme. Nul ne disait que ses biens lui appartinssent en propre, mais tout était commun entre eux.
verses.am: በመካከላቸው አንድ ስንኳ ችግረኛ አልነበረምና፤ መሬት ወይም ቤት ያላቸው ሁሉ እየሸጡ የተሸጠውን ዋጋ ያመጡ ነበርና፥

verses.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
verses.fr: Les apôtres rendaient avec beaucoup de force témoignage de la résurrection du Seigneur Jésus. Et une grande grâce reposait sur eux tous.
verses.am: በሐዋርያትም እግር አጠገብ ያኖሩ ነበር፤ ማናቸውም እንደሚፈልግ መጠን ለእያንዳንዱ ያካፍሉት ነበር።

verses.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
verses.fr: Car il n''y avait parmi eux aucun indigent: tous ceux qui possédaient des champs ou des maisons les vendaient, apportaient le prix de ce qu''ils avaient vendu,
verses.am: ትውልዱም የቆጵሮስ ሰው የነበረ አንድ ሌዋዊ ዮሴፍ የሚሉት ነበረ፥ እርሱም በሐዋርያት በርናባስ ተባለ ትርጓሜውም የመጽናናት ልጅ ነው፤

verses.en: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
verses.fr: et le déposaient aux pieds des apôtres; et l''on faisait des distributions à chacun selon qu''il en avait besoin.
verses.am: እርሻም ነበረውና ሽጦ ገንዘቡን አምጥቶ ከሐዋርያት እግር አጠገብ አኖረው።

verses.en: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
verses.fr: Joseph, surnommé par les apôtres Barnabas, ce qui signifie fils d''exhortation, Lévite, originaire de Chypre,
verses.am: ትውልዱም የቆጵሮስ ሰው የነበረ አንድ ሌዋዊ ዮሴፍ የሚሉት ነበረ፥ እርሱም በሐዋርያት በርናባስ ተባለ ትርጓሜውም የመጽናናት ልጅ ነው፤

verses.en: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
verses.fr: vendit un champ qu''il possédait, apporta l''argent, et le déposa aux pieds des apôtres.
verses.am: እርሻም ነበረውና ሽጦ ገንዘቡን አምጥቶ ከሐዋርያት እግር አጠገብ አኖረው።

verses.en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.fr: Mais un homme nommé Ananias, avec Saphira sa femme, vendit une propriété,
verses.am: ሐናንያም የተባለ አንድ ሰው ሰጲራ ከተባለች ከሚስቱ ጋር መሬት ሸጠ፥

verses.en: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
verses.fr: et retint une partie du prix, sa femme le sachant; puis il apporta le reste, et le déposa aux pieds des apôtres.
verses.am: ሚስቱም ደግሞ ስታውቅ ከሽያጩ አስቀረና እኩሌታውን አምጥቶ በሐዋርያት እግር አጠገብ አኖረው።

verses.en: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.fr: Pierre lui dit: Ananias, pourquoi Satan a-t-il rempli ton coeur, au point que tu mentes au Saint-Esprit, et que tu aies retenu une partie du prix du champ?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ሐናንያ ሆይ፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ታታልልና ከመሬቱ ሽያጭ ታስቀር ዘንድ ሰይጣን በልብህ ስለ ምን ሞላ?

verses.en: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
verses.fr: S''il n''eût pas été vendu, ne te restait-il pas? Et, après qu''il a été vendu, le prix n''était-il pas à ta disposition? Comment as-tu pu mettre en ton coeur un pareil dessein? Ce n''est pas à des hommes que tu as menti, mais à Dieu.
verses.am: ሳትሸጠው የአንተ አልነበረምን? ከሸጥኸውስ በኋላ በሥልጣንህ አልነበረምን? ይህን ነገር ስለ ምን በልብህ አሰብህ? እግዚአብሔርን እንጂ ሰውን አልዋሸህም አለው።

verses.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
verses.fr: Ananias, entendant ces paroles, tomba, et expira. Une grande crainte saisit tous les auditeurs.
verses.am: ሐናንያም ይህን ቃል ሰምቶ ወደቀ ሞተም፤ በሰሙትም ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ፍርሃት ሆነ።

verses.en: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
verses.fr: Les jeunes gens, s''étant levés, l''enveloppèrent, l''emportèrent, et l''ensevelirent.
verses.am: ጐበዞችም ተነሥተው ከፈኑት አውጥተውም ቀበሩት።

verses.en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.fr: Environ trois heures plus tard, sa femme entra, sans savoir ce qui était arrivé.
verses.am: ከሦስት ሰዓት ያህል በኋላም ሚስቱ የሆነውን ሳታውቅ ገባች።

verses.en: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.fr: Pierre lui adressa la parole: Dis-moi, est-ce à un tel prix que vous avez vendu le champ? Oui, répondit-elle, c''est à ce prix-là.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። እስቲ ንገሪኝ፥ መሬታችሁን ይህን ለሚያህል ሸጣችሁትን? አላት። እርስዋም። አዎን፥ ይህን ለሚያህል ነው አለች።

verses.en: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
verses.fr: Alors Pierre lui dit: Comment vous êtes-vous accordés pour tenter l''Esprit du Seigneur? Voici, ceux qui ont enseveli ton mari sont à la porte, et ils t''emporteront.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። የጌታን መንፈስ ትፈታተኑ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ተስማማችሁ? እነሆ፥ ባልሽን የቀበሩት ሰዎች እግር በደጅ ነው አንቺንም ያወጡሻል አላት።

verses.en: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
verses.fr: Au même instant, elle tomba aux pieds de l''apôtre, et expira. Les jeunes gens, étant entrés, la trouvèrent morte; ils l''emportèrent, et l''ensevelirent auprès de son mari.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜም በእግሩ አጠገብ ወደቀች ሞተችም፤ ጐበዞችም ሲገቡ ሞታ አገኙአት አውጥተውም በባልዋ አጠገብ ቀበሩአት።

verses.en: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
verses.fr: Une grande crainte s''empara de toute l''assemblée et de tous ceux qui apprirent ces choses.
verses.am: በቤተ ክርስቲያን ሁሉና ይህንም በሰሙ ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ፍርሃት ሆነ።

verses.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de miracles et de prodiges se faisaient au milieu du peuple par les mains des apôtres. Ils se tenaient tous ensemble au portique de Salomon,
verses.am: በሐዋርያትም እጅ ብዙ ምልክትና ድንቅ በሕዝብ መካከል ይደረግ ነበር፤ ሁሉም በአንድ ልብ ሆነው በሰሎሞን ደጅ መመላለሻ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
verses.fr: et aucun des autres n''osait se joindre à eux; mais le peuple les louait hautement.
verses.am: ከሌሎችም አንድ ስንኳ ሊተባበራቸው የሚደፍር አልነበረም፥

verses.en: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
verses.fr: Le nombre de ceux qui croyaient au Seigneur, hommes et femmes, s''augmentait de plus en plus;
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ግን ያከብሩአቸው ነበር፤ የሚያምኑትም ከፊት ይልቅ ለጌታ ይጨመሩለት ነበር፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶችም ብዙ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
verses.fr: en sorte qu''on apportait les malades dans les rues et qu''on les plaçait sur des lits et des couchettes, afin que, lorsque Pierre passerait, son ombre au moins couvrît quelqu''un d''eux.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ጴጥሮስ ሲያልፍ ጥላውም ቢሆን ከእነርሱ አንዱን ይጋርድ ዘንድ ድውያንን ወደ አደባባይ አውጥተው በአልጋና በወሰካ ያኖሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
verses.fr: La multitude accourait aussi des villes voisines à Jérusalem, amenant des malades et des gens tourmentés par des esprits impurs; et tous étaient guéris.
verses.am: ደግሞም በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ ካለችው ከተማ ድውያንንና በርኵሳን መናፍስት የተሣቀዩትን እያመጡ ብዙ ሰዎች ይሰበስቡ ነበር፤ ሁሉም ይፈወሱ ነበር።

verses.en: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
verses.fr: Cependant le souverain sacrificateur et tous ceux qui étaient avec lui, savoir le parti des sadducéens, se levèrent, remplis de jalousie,
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱ ግን የሰዱቃውያን ወገን ሆነውም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሁሉ ተነሡ ቅንዓትም ሞላባቸው።

verses.en: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
verses.fr: mirent les mains sur les apôtres, et les jetèrent dans la prison publique.
verses.am: በሐዋርያትም ላይ እጃቸውን ጭነው በሕዝቡ ወኅኒ ውስጥ አኖሩአቸው።

verses.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
verses.fr: Mais un ange du Seigneur, ayant ouvert pendant la nuit les portes de la prison, les fit sortir, et leur dit:
verses.am: የጌታ መልአክ ግን በሌሊት የወኅኒውን ደጅ ከፍቶ አወጣቸውና።

verses.en: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
verses.fr: Allez, tenez-vous dans le temple, et annoncez au peuple toutes les paroles de cette vie.
verses.am: ሂዱና ቆማችሁ የዚህን ሕይወት ቃል ሁሉ ለሕዝብ በመቅደስ ንገሩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.fr: Ayant entendu cela, ils entrèrent dès le matin dans le temple, et se mirent à enseigner. Le souverain sacrificateur et ceux qui étaient avec lui étant survenus, ils convoquèrent le sanhédrin et tous les anciens des fils d''Israël, et ils envoyèrent chercher les apôtres à la prison.
verses.am: በሰሙም ጊዜ ማልደው ወደ መቅደስ ገብተው አስተማሩ። ግን ሊቀ ካህናቱና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት መጥተው ሸንጎውንና የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ በአንድነት ጠሩ፥ ያመጡአቸውም ዘንድ ወደ ወኅኒ ላኩ።

verses.en: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned and told,
verses.fr: Les huissiers, à leur arrivée, ne les trouvèrent point dans la prison. Ils s''en retournèrent, et firent leur rapport,
verses.am: የመቅደስ አዛዥና የካህናት አለቆችም ይህን ነገር በሰሙ ጊዜ። እንጃ ይህ ምን ይሆን? እያሉ ስለ እነርሱ አመነቱ።

verses.en: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.fr: en disant: Nous avons trouvé la prison soigneusement fermée, et les gardes qui étaient devant les portes; mais, après avoir ouvert, nous n''avons trouvé personne dedans.
verses.am: የመቅደስ አዛዥና የካህናት አለቆችም ይህን ነገር በሰሙ ጊዜ። እንጃ ይህ ምን ይሆን? እያሉ ስለ እነርሱ አመነቱ።

verses.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent entendu ces paroles, le commandant du temple et les principaux sacrificateurs ne savaient que penser des apôtres et des suites de cette affaire.
verses.am: አንድ ሰውም መጥቶ። እነሆ፥ በወኅኒ ያኖራችኋቸው ሰዎች እየቆሙ ሕዝቡንም እያስተማሩ በመቅደስ ናቸው ብሎ አወራላቸው።

verses.en: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
verses.fr: Quelqu''un vint leur dire: Voici, les hommes que vous avez mis en prison sont dans le temple, et ils enseignent le peuple.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አዛዡ ከሎሌዎች ጋር ሄዶ አመጣቸው፥ በኃይል ግን አይደለም፤ ሕዝቡ እንዳይወግሩአቸው ይፈሩ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
verses.fr: Alors le commandant partit avec les huissiers, et les conduisit sans violence, car ils avaient peur d''être lapidés par le peuple.
verses.am: አምጥተውም በሸንጎ አቆሙአቸው።

verses.en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
verses.fr: Après qu''ils les eurent amenés en présence du sanhédrin, le souverain sacrificateur les interrogea
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም። በዚህ ስም እንዳታስተምሩ አጥብቀን አላዘዝናችሁምን? እነሆም፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን በትምህርታችሁ ሞልታችኋል፤ የዚያንም ሰው ደም በእኛ ታመጡብን ዘንድ ታስባላችሁ ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
verses.fr: en ces termes: Ne vous avons-nous pas défendu expressément d''enseigner en ce nom-là? Et voici, vous avez rempli Jérusalem de votre enseignement, et vous voulez faire retomber sur nous le sang de cet homme!
verses.am: ጴጥሮስና ሐዋርያትም መልሰው አሉ። ከሰው ይልቅ ለእግዚአብሔር ልንታዘዝ ይገባል።

verses.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.fr: Pierre et les apôtres répondirent: Il faut obéir à Dieu plutôt qu''aux hommes.
verses.am: እናንተ በእንጨት ላይ ሰቅላችሁ የገደላችሁትን ኢየሱስን የአባቶቻችን አምላክ አስነሣው፤

verses.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
verses.fr: Le Dieu de nos pères a ressuscité Jésus, que vous avez tué, en le pendant au bois.
verses.am: ይህን እግዚአብሔር፥ ለእስራኤል ንስሐን የኃጢአትንም ስርየት ይሰጥ ዘንድ፥ ራስም መድኃኒትም አድርጎ በቀኙ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው።

verses.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
verses.fr: Dieu l''a élevé par sa droite comme Prince et Sauveur, pour donner à Israël la repentance et le pardon des péchés.
verses.am: እኛም ለዚህ ነገር ምስክሮች ነን፥ ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር ለሚታዘዙት የሰጠው መንፈስ ቅዱስ ምስክር ነው።

verses.en: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
verses.fr: Nous sommes témoins de ces choses, de même que le Saint-Esprit, que Dieu a donné à ceux qui lui obéissent.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሲሰሙ በጣም ተቈጡ ሊገድሉአቸውም አሰቡ።

verses.en: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
verses.fr: Furieux de ces paroles, ils voulaient les faire mourir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሕዝብ ሁሉ ዘንድ የከበረ የሕግ መምህር ገማልያል የሚሉት አንድ ፈሪሳዊ በሸንጎ ተነሥቶ ሐዋርያትን ጥቂት ፈቀቅ እንዲያደርጉአቸው አዘዘ፥

verses.en: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
verses.fr: Mais un pharisien, nommé Gamaliel, docteur de la loi, estimé de tout le peuple, se leva dans le sanhédrin, et ordonna de faire sortir un instant les apôtres.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ስለ እነዚህ ሰዎች ምን እንደምታደርጉ ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Hommes Israélites, prenez garde à ce que vous allez faire à l''égard de ces gens.
verses.am: ከዚህ ወራት አስቀድሞ ቴዎዳስ። እኔ ታላቅ ነኝ ብሎ ተነሥቶ ነበርና፥ አራት መቶ የሚያህሉ ሰዎችም ከእርሱ ጋር ተባበሩ፤ እርሱም ጠፋ የሰሙትም ሁሉ ተበተኑ እንደ ምናምንም ሆኑ።

verses.en: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
verses.fr: Car, il n''y a pas longtemps que parut Theudas, qui se donnait pour quelque chose, et auquel se rallièrent environ quatre cents hommes: il fut tué, et tous ceux qui l''avaient suivi furent mis en déroute et réduits à rien.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሰዎች በተጻፉበት ዘመን የገሊላው ይሁዳ ተነሣ ብዙ ሰዎችንም አሸፍቶ አስከተለ፤ እርሱም ጠፋ የሰሙትም ሁሉ ተበታተኑ።

verses.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
verses.fr: Après lui, parut Judas le Galiléen, à l''époque du recensement, et il attira du monde à son parti: il périt aussi, et tous ceux qui l''avaient suivi furent dispersés.
verses.am: አሁንም እላችኋለሁ። ከእነዚህ ሰዎች ተለዩ ተዉአቸውም፤ ይህ አሳብ ወይም ይህ ሥራ ከሰው እንደ ሆነ ይጠፋልና፤

verses.en: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
verses.fr: Et maintenant, je vous le dis ne vous occupez plus de ces hommes, et laissez-les aller. Si cette entreprise ou cette oeuvre vient des hommes, elle se détruira;
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ ግን ታጠፉአቸው ዘንድ አይቻላችሁም፥ በእርግጥ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስትጣሉ ምናልባት እንዳትገኙ።

verses.en: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
verses.fr: mais si elle vient de Dieu, vous ne pourrez la détruire. Ne courez pas le risque d''avoir combattu contre Dieu.
verses.am: ሰሙትም፥ ሐዋርያትንም ወደ እነርሱ ጠርተው ገረፉአቸው፥ በኢየሱስም ስም እንዳይናገሩ አዝዘው ፈቱአቸው።

verses.en: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.fr: Ils se rangèrent à son avis. Et ayant appelé les apôtres, ils les firent battre de verges, ils leur défendirent de parler au nom de Jésus, et ils les relâchèrent.
verses.am: እነርሱም ስለ ስሙ ይናቁ ዘንድ የተገባቸው ሆነው ስለ ተቈጠሩ ከሸንጎው ፊት ደስ እያላቸው ወጡ፤

verses.en: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.fr: Les apôtres se retirèrent de devant le sanhédrin, joyeux d''avoir été jugés dignes de subir des outrages pour le nom de Jésus.
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስና በቤታቸው ስለ ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ማስተማርንና መስበክን አይተዉም ነበር።

verses.en: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Et chaque jour, dans le temple et dans les maisons, ils ne cessaient d''enseigner, et d''annoncer la bonne nouvelle de Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስና በቤታቸው ስለ ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ማስተማርንና መስበክን አይተዉም ነበር።

verses.en: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, le nombre des disciples augmentant, les Hellénistes murmurèrent contre les Hébreux, parce que leurs veuves étaient négligées dans la distribution qui se faisait chaque jour.
verses.am: በዚህም ወራት ደቀ መዛሙርት እየበዙ ሲሄዱ ከግሪክ አገር መጥተው የነበሩት አይሁድ በይሁዳ ኖረው በነበሩት አይሁድ አንጐራጐሩባቸው፥ በየቀኑ በተሠራው አገልግሎት መበለቶቻቸውን ችላ ይሉባቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
verses.fr: Les douze convoquèrent la multitude des disciples, et dirent: Il n''est pas convenable que nous laissions la parole de Dieu pour servir aux tables.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱም ደቀ መዛሙርት ሁሉን ጠርተው እንዲህ አሉአቸው። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ትተን ማዕድን እናገለግል ዘንድ የሚገባ ነገር አይደለም።

verses.en: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, frères, choisissez parmi vous sept hommes, de qui l''on rende un bon témoignage, qui soient pleins d''Esprit-Saint et de sagesse, et que nous chargerons de cet emploi.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በመልካም የተመሰከረላቸውን መንፈስ ቅዱስና ጥበብም የሞላባቸውን ሰባት ሰዎች ከእናንተ ምረጡ፥ ለዚህም ጉዳይ እንሾማቸዋለን፤

verses.en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.fr: Et nous, nous continuerons à nous appliquer à la prière et au ministère de la parole.
verses.am: እኛ ግን ለጸሎትና ቃሉን ለማገልገል እንተጋለን።

verses.en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
verses.fr: Cette proposition plut à toute l''assemblée. Ils élurent Etienne, homme plein de foi et d''Esprit-Saint, Philippe, Prochore, Nicanor, Timon, Parménas, et Nicolas, prosélyte d''Antioche.
verses.am: ይህም ቃል ሕዝብን ሁሉ ደስ አሰኛቸው፤ እምነትና መንፈስ ቅዱስም የሞላበትን ሰው እስጢፋኖስን ፊልጶስንም ጵሮኮሮስንም ኒቃሮናንም ጢሞናንም ጳርሜናንም ወደ ይሁዲነት ገብቶ የነበረውን የአንጾኪያውን ኒቆላዎስንም መረጡ።

verses.en: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
verses.fr: Ils les présentèrent aux apôtres, qui, après avoir prié, leur imposèrent les mains.
verses.am: በሐዋርያትም ፊት አቆሙአቸው፥ ከጸለዩም በኋላ እጃቸውን ጫኑባቸው።

verses.en: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.fr: La parole de Dieu se répandait de plus en plus, le nombre des disciples augmentait beaucoup à Jérusalem, et une grande foule de sacrificateurs obéissaient à la foi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል እየሰፋ ሄደ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የደቀ መዛሙርት ቍጥር እጅግ እየበዛ ሄደ፤ ከካህናትም ብዙ ሰዎች ለሃይማኖት የታዘዙ ሆኑ።

verses.en: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.fr: Etienne, plein de grâce et de puissance, faisait des prodiges et de grands miracles parmi le peuple.
verses.am: እስጢፋኖስም ጸጋንና ኃይልን ተሞልቶ በሕዝቡ መካከል ድንቅንና ታላቅ ምልክትን ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
verses.fr: Quelques membres de la synagogue dite des Affranchis, de celle des Cyrénéens et de celle des Alexandrins, avec des Juifs de Cilicie et d''Asie, se mirent à discuter avec lui;
verses.am: የነፃ ወጪዎች ከተባለችው ምኵራብም ከቀሬናና ከእስክንድርያም ሰዎች ከኪልቅያና ከእስያም ከነበሩት አንዳንዶቹ ተነሥተው እስጢፋኖስን ይከራከሩት ነበር፤

verses.en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
verses.fr: mais ils ne pouvaient résister à sa sagesse et à l''Esprit par lequel il parlait.
verses.am: ይናገርበት የነበረውንም ጥበብና መንፈስ ይቃወሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
verses.fr: Alors ils subornèrent des hommes qui dirent: Nous l''avons entendu proférer des paroles blasphématoires contre Moïse et contre Dieu.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ። በሙሴ ላይ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ የስድብን ነገር ሲናገር ሰምተነዋል የሚሉ ሰዎችን አስነሡ።

verses.en: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
verses.fr: Ils émurent le peuple, les anciens et les scribes, et, se jetant sur lui, ils le saisirent, et l''emmenèrent au sanhédrin.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንና ሽማግሌዎችንም ጻፎችንም አናደዱ፥ ቀርበውም ያዙት ወደ ሸንጎም አመጡትና።

verses.en: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.fr: Ils produisirent de faux témoins, qui dirent: Cet homme ne cesse de proférer des paroles contre le lieu saint et contre la loi;
verses.am: ይህ ሰው በዚህ በተቀደሰው ስፍራ በሕግም ላይ የስድብን ነገር ለመናገር አይተውም፤

verses.en: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
verses.fr: car nous l''avons entendu dire que Jésus, ce Nazaréen, détruira ce lieu, et changera les coutumes que Moïse nous a données.
verses.am: ይህ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ይህን ስፍራ ያፈርሰዋል ሙሴም ያስተላለፈልንን ሥርዓት ይለውጣል ሲል ሰምተነዋልና የሚሉ የሐሰት ምስክሮችን አቆሙ።

verses.en: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui siégeaient au sanhédrin ayant fixé les regards sur Etienne, son visage leur parut comme celui d''un ange.
verses.am: በሸንጎም የተቀመጡት ሁሉ ትኵር ብለው ሲመለከቱት እንደ መልአክ ፊት ሆኖ ፊቱን አዩት።

verses.en: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.fr: Le souverain sacrificateur dit: Les choses sont-elles ainsi?
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም። ይህ ነገር እንዲህ ነውን? አለው፤

verses.en: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
verses.fr: Etienne répondit: Hommes frères et pères, écoutez! Le Dieu de gloire apparut à notre père Abraham, lorsqu''il était en Mésopotamie, avant qu''il s''établît à Charran;
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ። ወንድሞችና አባቶች ሆይ፥ ስሙ። የክብር አምላክ ለአባታችን ለአብርሃም በካራን ሳይቀመጥ ገና በሁለት ወንዝ መካከል ሳለ ታየና።

verses.en: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
verses.fr: et il lui dit: Quitte ton pays et ta famille, et va dans le pays que je te montrerai.
verses.am: ከአገርህና ከዘመዶችህም ወጥተህ ወደማሳይህ ወደ ማንኛውም ምድር ና አለው።

verses.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
verses.fr: Il sortit alors du pays des Chaldéens, et s''établit à Charran. De là, après la mort de son père, Dieu le fit passer dans ce pays que vous habitez maintenant;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ከከለዳውያን አገር ወጥቶ በካራን ተቀመጠ። ከዚያም አባቱ ከሞተ በኋላ እናንተ ዛሬ ወደምትኖሩባት ወደዚች አገር አወጣው።

verses.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
verses.fr: il ne lui donna aucune propriété en ce pays, pas même de quoi poser le pied, mais il promit de lui en donner la possession, et à sa postérité après lui, quoiqu''il n''eût point d''enfant.
verses.am: በዚችም የእግር ጫማ ስንኳ የሚያህል ርስት አልሰጠውም፤ ነገር ግን ልጅ ሳይኖረው ለእርሱ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለዘሩ ርስት አድርጎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ ተስፋ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
verses.fr: Dieu parla ainsi: Sa postérité séjournera dans un pays étranger; on la réduira en servitude et on la maltraitera pendant quatre cents ans.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ዘሩ በሌላ አገር መጻተኞች እንዲሆኑ አራት መቶ ዓመትም ባሪያዎች እንዲያደርጉአቸው እንዲያስጨንቁአቸውም እንዲህ ተናገረ፤

verses.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.fr: Mais la nation à laquelle ils auront été asservis, c''est moi qui la jugerai, dit Dieu. Après cela, ils sortiront, et ils me serviront dans ce lieu-ci.
verses.am: ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር። እንደ ባሪያዎች በሚገዙአቸው ሕዝብ ላይ እኔ እፈርድባቸዋለሁ፥ ከዚህም በኋላ ይወጣሉ በዚህም ስፍራ ያመልኩኛል አለ።

verses.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
verses.fr: Puis Dieu donna à Abraham l''alliance de la circoncision; et ainsi, Abraham, ayant engendré Isaac, le circoncit le huitième jour; Isaac engendra et circoncit Jacob, et Jacob les douze patriarches.
verses.am: የመገረዝንም ኪዳን ሰጠው፤ እንዲሁም ይስሐቅን ወለደ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ገረዘው ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ያዕቆብም አሥራ ሁለቱን የአባቶችን አለቆች።

verses.en: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
verses.fr: Les patriarches, jaloux de Joseph, le vendirent pour être emmené en Egypte. Mais Dieu fut avec lui,
verses.am: የአባቶችም አለቆች በዮሴፍ ቀንተው ወደ ግብፅ ሸጡት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥

verses.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.fr: et le délivra de toutes ses tribulations; il lui donna de la sagesse et lui fit trouver grâce devant Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, qui l''établit gouverneur d''Egypte et de toute sa maison.
verses.am: ከመከራውም ሁሉ አወጣው፥ በግብፅ ንጉሥ በፈርዖንም ፊት ሞገስንና ጥበብን ሰጠው፥ በግብፅና በቤቱ ሁሉ ላይም ቢትወደድ አድርጎ ሾመው።

verses.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.fr: Il survint une famine dans tout le pays d''Egypte, et dans celui de Canaan. La détresse était grande, et nos pères ne trouvaient pas de quoi se nourrir.
verses.am: በግብፅና በከነዓንም አገር ሁሉ ራብና ብዙ ጭንቅ መጣ፥ አባቶቻችንም ምግብን አላገኙም።

verses.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.fr: Jacob apprit qu''il y avait du blé en Egypte, et il y envoya nos pères une première fois.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም በግብፅ እህል መኖሩን በሰማ ጊዜ በመጀመሪያ አባቶቻችንን ሰደዳቸው፤

verses.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.fr: Et la seconde fois, Joseph fut reconnu par ses frères, et Pharaon sut de quelle famille il était.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ዮሴፍ ለወንድሞቹ ታወቀ፥ የዮሴፍም ትውልድ በፈርዖን ዘንድ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.fr: Puis Joseph envoya chercher son père Jacob, et toute sa famille, composée de soixante-quinze personnes.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም አባቱን ያዕቆብንና ሰባ አምስት ነፍስ የነበረውን ቤተ ዘመድ ሁሉ ልኮ አስጠራ።

verses.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.fr: Jacob descendit en Egypte, où il mourut, ainsi que nos pères;
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወደ ግብፅ ወረደ እርሱም ሞተ አባቶቻችንም፤

verses.en: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
verses.fr: et ils furent transportés à Sichem, et déposés dans le sépulcre qu''Abraham avait acheté, à prix d''argent, des fils d''Hémor, père de Sichem.
verses.am: ወደ ሴኬምም አፍልሰው አብርሃም ከሴኬም አባት ከኤሞር ልጆች በብር በገዛው መቃብር ቀበሩአቸው።

verses.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.fr: Le temps approchait où devait s''accomplir la promesse que Dieu avait faite à Abraham, et le peuple s''accrut et se multiplia en Egypte,
verses.am: እርሱም ወገናችንን ተተንኵሎ ሕፃናትን በሕይወት እንዳይጠብቁ ወደ ውጭ ይጥሉ ዘንድ አድርጎ አባቶቻችንን አስጨነቀ።

verses.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que parut un autre roi, qui n''avait pas connu Joseph.
verses.am: እርሱም ወገናችንን ተተንኵሎ ሕፃናትን በሕይወት እንዳይጠብቁ ወደ ውጭ ይጥሉ ዘንድ አድርጎ አባቶቻችንን አስጨነቀ።

verses.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
verses.fr: Ce roi, usant d''artifice contre notre race, maltraita nos pères, au point de leur faire exposer leurs enfants, pour qu''ils ne vécussent pas.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሙሴ ተወለደ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ያማረ ነበር፤ በአባቱ ቤትም ሦስት ወር አደገ፤

verses.en: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
verses.fr: A cette époque, naquit Moïse, qui était beau aux yeux de Dieu. Il fut nourri trois mois dans la maison de son père;
verses.am: በተጣለም ጊዜ የፈርዖን ልጅ አነሣችው ልጅም ይሆናት ዘንድ አሳደገችው።

verses.en: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.fr: et, quand il eut été exposé, la fille de Pharaon le recueillit, et l''éleva comme son fils.
verses.am: ሙሴም የግብፆችን ጥበብ ሁሉ ተማረ፥ በቃሉና በሥራውም የበረታ ሆነ።

verses.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
verses.fr: Moïse fut instruit dans toute la sagesse des Egyptiens, et il était puissant en paroles et en oeuvres.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አርባ ዓመት ሲሞላው ወንድሞቹን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ይጐበኝ ዘንድ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.en: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il avait quarante ans, lorsqu''il lui vint dans le coeur de visiter ses frères, les fils d''Israël.
verses.am: አንዱም ሲበደል አይቶ ረዳው፥ የግብፅን ሰውም መትቶ ለተገፋው ተበቀለ።

verses.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
verses.fr: Il en vit un qu''on outrageait, et, prenant sa défense, il vengea celui qui était maltraité, et frappa l''Egyptien.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹም እግዚአብሔር በእጁ መዳንን እንዲሰጣቸው የሚያስተውሉ ይመስለው ነበር፥ እነርሱ ግን አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
verses.fr: Il pensait que ses frères comprendraient que Dieu leur accordait la délivrance par sa main; mais ils ne comprirent pas.
verses.am: በማግሥቱም እርስ በርሳቸው ሲጣሉ አገኛቸው፥ ሊያስታርቃቸውም ወዶ። ሰዎች ሆይ፥ እናንተስ ወንድማማች ናችሁ፤ ስለ ምን እርስ በርሳችሁ ትበዳደላላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.fr: Le jour suivant, il parut au milieu d''eux comme ils se battaient, et il les exhorta à la paix: Hommes, dit-il, vous êtes frères; pourquoi vous maltraitez-vous l''un l''autre?
verses.am: ያም ባልንጀራውን የሚበድል ግን። አንተን በእኛ ላይ ሹምና ፈራጅ እንድትሆን የሾመህ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.fr: Mais celui qui maltraitait son prochain le repoussa, en disant: Qui t''a établi chef et juge sur nous?
verses.am: ወይስ ትናንትና የግብፁን ሰው እንደ ገደልኸው ልትገድለኝ ትወዳለህን? ብሎ ገፋው።

verses.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.fr: Veux-tu me tuer, comme tu as tué hier l''Egyptien?
verses.am: ሙሴም ከዚህ ነገር የተነሣ ሸሽቶ በምድያም አገር መጻተኛ ሆኖ ኖረ፤ በዚያም ሁለት ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.en: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
verses.fr: A cette parole, Moïse prit la fuite, et il alla séjourner dans le pays de Madian, où il engendra deux fils.
verses.am: አርባ ዓመትም ሲሞላ የጌታ መልአክ በሲና ተራራ ምድረ በዳ በቍጥቋጦ መካከል በእሳት ነበልባል ታየው።

verses.en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.fr: Quarante ans plus tard, un ange lui apparut, au désert de la montagne de Sinaï, dans la flamme d''un buisson en feu.
verses.am: ጌታም። የቆምህባት ስፍራ የተቀደሰች ምድር ናትና የእግርህን ጫማ አውልቅ።

verses.en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
verses.fr: Moïse, voyant cela, fut étonné de cette apparition; et, comme il s''approchait pour examiner, la voix du Seigneur se fit entendre:
verses.am: ጌታም። የቆምህባት ስፍራ የተቀደሰች ምድር ናትና የእግርህን ጫማ አውልቅ።

verses.en: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.fr: Je suis le Dieu de tes pères, le Dieu d''Abraham, d''Isaac et de Jacob. Et Moïse, tout tremblant, n''osait regarder.
verses.am: በግብፅ ያሉትን የሕዝቤን መከራ ፈጽሜ አይቼ መቃተታቸውንም ሰምቼ ላድናቸው ወረድሁ፤ አሁንም ና፥ ወደ ግብፅ እልክሃለሁ አለው።
