verses.en: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur lui dit: Ote tes souliers de tes pieds, car le lieu sur lequel tu te tiens est une terre sainte.
verses.am: ሹምና ፈራጅ እንድትሆን የሾመህ ማን ነው? ብለው የካዱትን፥ ይህን ሙሴን በቍጥቋጦው በታየው በመልአኩ እጅ እግዚአብሔር ሹምና ቤዛ አድርጎ ላከው።

verses.en: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.fr: J''ai vu la souffrance de mon peuple qui est en Egypte, j''ai entendu ses gémissements, et je suis descendu pour le délivrer. Maintenant, va, je t''enverrai en Egypte.
verses.am: ይህ ሰው በግብፅ ምድርና በኤርትራ ባሕር በምድረ በዳም አርባ ዓመት ድንቅና ምልክት እያደረገ አወጣቸው።

verses.en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.fr: Ce Moïse, qu''ils avaient renié, en disant: Qui t''a établi chef et juge? c''est lui que Dieu envoya comme chef et comme libérateur avec l''aide de l''ange qui lui était apparu dans le buisson.
verses.am: ይህ ሰው ለእስራኤል ልጆች። እግዚአብሔር ከወንድሞቻችሁ እንደ እኔ ያለ ነቢይ ያስነሣላችኋል፤ እርሱን ስሙት ያላቸው ሙሴ ነው።

verses.en: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.fr: C''est lui qui les fit sortir d''Egypte, en opérant des prodiges et des miracles au pays d''Egypte, au sein de la mer Rouge, et au désert, pendant quarante ans.
verses.am: ይህ ሰው በሲና ተራራ ከተናገረው መልአክና ከአባቶቻችን ጋር በምድረ በዳ በማኅበሩ ውስጥ የነበረው ነው፤ ይሰጠንም ዘንድ ሕይወት ያላቸውን ቃላት ተቀበለ፤

verses.en: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
verses.fr: C''est ce Moïse qui dit aux fils d''Israël: Dieu vous suscitera d''entre vos frères un prophète comme moi.
verses.am: ለእርሱም አባቶቻችን ሊታዘዙት አልወደዱም፤ ነገር ግን ገፉት በልባቸውም ወደ ግብፅ ተመለሱ፤

verses.en: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
verses.fr: C''est lui qui, lors de l''assemblée au désert, étant avec l''ange qui lui parlait sur la montagne de Sinaï et avec nos pères, reçut des oracles vivants, pour nous les donner.
verses.am: አሮንንም። በፊታችን የሚሄዱ አማልክት ሥራልን፤ ይህ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣን ሙሴ ምን እንደ ሆነ አናውቅምና አሉት።

verses.en: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
verses.fr: Nos pères ne voulurent pas lui obéir, ils le repoussèrent, et ils tournèrent leur coeur vers l''Egypte,
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ጥጃ አደረጉ ለጣዖቱም መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ፥ በእጃቸውም ሥራ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.fr: en disant à Aaron: Fais-nous des dieux qui marchent devant nous; car ce Moïse qui nous a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, nous ne savons ce qu''il est devenu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ዘወር አለ የሰማይንም ጭፍራ ያመልኩ ዘንድ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ በነቢያትም መጽሐፍ። እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት፥ አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ የታረደውን ከብትና መሥዋዕትን አቀረባችሁልኝን?

verses.en: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.fr: Et, en ces jours-là, ils firent un veau, ils offrirent un sacrifice à l''idole, et se réjouirent de l''oeuvre de leurs mains.
verses.am: ትሰግዱላቸውም ዘንድ የሠራችኋቸውን ምስሎች እነርሱንም የሞሎክን ድንኳንና ሬምፉም የሚሉትን የአምላካችሁን ኮከብ አነሣችሁ፤ እኔም ከባቢሎን ወዲያ እሰዳችኋለሁ ተብሎ እንዲህ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
verses.fr: Alors Dieu se détourna, et les livra au culte de l''armée du ciel, selon qu''il est écrit dans le livre des prophètes: M''avez-vous offert des victimes et des sacrifices Pendant quarante ans au désert, maison d''Israël?...
verses.am: እንዳየው ምስል አድርጎ ይሠራት ዘንድ ሙሴን ተናግሮ እንዳዘዘው፥ የምስክር ድንኳን ከአባቶቻችን ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ ነበረች፤

verses.en: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.fr: Vous avez porté la tente de Moloch Et l''étoile du dieu Remphan, Ces images que vous avez faites pour les adorer! Aussi vous transporterai-je au delà de Babylone.
verses.am: አባቶቻችንም ደግሞ በተራ ተቀብለው እግዚአብሔር በፊታቸው ያወጣቸውን የአሕዛብን አገር በያዙት ጊዜ ከኢያሱ ጋር አገቡአት፥ እስከ ዳዊት ዘመንም ድረስ ኖረች።

verses.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
verses.fr: Nos pères avaient au désert le tabernacle du témoignage, comme l''avait ordonné celui qui dit à Moïse de le faire d''après le modèle qu''il avait vu.
verses.am: እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞገስ አግኝቶ ለያዕቆብ አምላክ ማደሪያን ያገኝ ዘንድ ለመነ።

verses.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
verses.fr: Et nos pères, l''ayant reçu, l''introduisirent, sous la conduite de Josué, dans le pays qui était possédé par les nations que Dieu chassa devant eux, et il y resta jusqu''aux jours de David.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰሎሞን ቤት ሠራለት።

verses.en: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.fr: David trouva grâce devant Dieu, et demanda d''élever une demeure pour le Dieu de Jacob;

verses.en: But Solomon built him an house.
verses.fr: et ce fut Salomon qui lui bâtit une maison.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ነቢዩ። ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ ለእኔ ምን ዓይነት ቤት ትሠራላችሁ? ይላል ጌታ፥ ወይስ የማርፍበት ስፍራ ምንድር ነው? ይህንስ ሁሉ እጄ የሠራችው አይደለምን? እንዳለ፥ ልዑል የሰው እጅ በሠራችው አይኖርም።

verses.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.fr: Mais le Très-Haut n''habite pas dans ce qui est fait de main d''homme, comme dit le prophète:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ነቢዩ። ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ ለእኔ ምን ዓይነት ቤት ትሠራላችሁ? ይላል ጌታ፥ ወይስ የማርፍበት ስፍራ ምንድር ነው? ይህንስ ሁሉ እጄ የሠራችው አይደለምን? እንዳለ፥ ልዑል የሰው እጅ በሠራችው አይኖርም።

verses.en: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
verses.fr: Le ciel est mon trône, Et la terre mon marchepied. Quelle maison me bâtirez-vous, dit le Seigneur, Ou quel sera le lieu de mon repos?
verses.am: እናንተ አንገተ ደንዳኖች ልባችሁና ጆሮአችሁም ያልተገረዘ፥ እናንተ ሁልጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ትቃወማላችሁ፤ አባቶቻችሁ እንደ ተቃወሙት እናንተ ደግሞ።

verses.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas ma main qui a fait toutes ces choses?...
verses.am: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ በልባቸው በጣም ተቈጡ ጥርሳቸውንም አፋጩበት።

verses.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.fr: Hommes au cou raide, incirconcis de coeur et d''oreilles! vous vous opposez toujours au Saint-Esprit. Ce que vos pères ont été, vous l''êtes aussi.
verses.am: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ በልባቸው በጣም ተቈጡ ጥርሳቸውንም አፋጩበት።

verses.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.fr: Lequel des prophètes vos pères n''ont-ils pas persécuté? Ils ont tué ceux qui annonçaient d''avance la venue du Juste, que vous avez livré maintenant, et dont vous avez été les meurtriers,
verses.am: መንፈስ ቅዱስንም ተሞልቶ ወደ ሰማይ ትኵር ብሎ ሲመለከት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ኢየሱስንም በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ቆሞ አየና።

verses.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
verses.fr: vous qui avez reçu la loi d''après des commandements d''anges, et qui ne l''avez point gardée!...
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሰማያት ተከፍተው የሰው ልጅም በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ቆሞ አያለሁ አለ።

verses.en: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
verses.fr: En entendant ces paroles, ils étaient furieux dans leur coeur, et ils grinçaient des dents contre lui.
verses.am: በታላቅ ድምፅም እየጮኹ ጆሮአቸውን ደፈኑ፥ በአንድ ልብ ሆነውም ወደ እርሱ ሮጡ፥

verses.en: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.fr: Mais Etienne, rempli du Saint-Esprit, et fixant les regards vers le ciel, vit la gloire de Dieu et Jésus debout à la droite de Dieu.
verses.am: ከከተማም ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ወገሩት። ምስክሮችም ልብሳቸውን ሳውል በሚሉት በአንድ ጎበዝ እግር አጠገብ አኖሩ።

verses.en: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Voici, je vois les cieux ouverts, et le Fils de l''homme debout à la droite de Dieu.
verses.am: እስጢፋኖስም። ጌታ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን ተቀበል ብሎ ሲጠራ ይወግሩት ነበር።

verses.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
verses.fr: Ils poussèrent alors de grands cris, en se bouchant les oreilles, et ils se précipitèrent tous ensemble sur lui,
verses.am: ተንበርክኮም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን ኃጢአት አትቍጠርባቸው ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ። ይህንም ብሎ አንቀላፋ። ሳውልም በእርሱ መገደል ተስማምቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
verses.fr: le traînèrent hors de la ville, et le lapidèrent. Les témoins déposèrent leurs vêtements aux pieds d''un jeune homme nommé Saul.
verses.am: ከከተማም ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ወገሩት። ምስክሮችም ልብሳቸውን ሳውል በሚሉት በአንድ ጎበዝ እግር አጠገብ አኖሩ።

verses.en: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.fr: Et ils lapidaient Etienne, qui priait et disait: Seigneur Jésus, reçois mon esprit!
verses.am: እስጢፋኖስም። ጌታ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን ተቀበል ብሎ ሲጠራ ይወግሩት ነበር።

verses.en: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.fr: Puis, s''étant mis à genoux, il s''écria d''une voix forte: Seigneur, ne leur impute pas ce péché! Et, après ces paroles, il s''endormit.
verses.am: ተንበርክኮም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን ኃጢአት አትቍጠርባቸው ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ። ይህንም ብሎ አንቀላፋ። ሳውልም በእርሱ መገደል ተስማምቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.fr: Saul avait approuvé le meurtre d''Etienne. Il y eut, ce jour-là, une grande persécution contre l''Eglise de Jérusalem; et tous, excepté les apôtres, se dispersèrent dans les contrées de la Judée et de la Samarie.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀንም በኢየሩሳሌም ባለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ላይ ታላቅ ስደት ሆነ፤ ሁሉም ከሐዋርያትም በቀር ወደ ይሁዳና ወደ ሰማርያ አገሮች ተበተኑ።

verses.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.fr: Des hommes pieux ensevelirent Etienne, et le pleurèrent à grand bruit.
verses.am: በጸሎትም የተጉ ሰዎች እስጢፋኖስን ቀበሩት ታላቅ ልቅሶም አለቀሱለት።

verses.en: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
verses.fr: Saul, de son côté, ravageait l''Eglise; pénétrant dans les maisons, il en arrachait hommes et femmes, et les faisait jeter en prison.
verses.am: ሳውል ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ያፈርስ ነበር፤ ወደ ሁሉም ቤት እየገባ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም እየጐተተ ወደ ወኅኒ አሳልፎ ይሰጥ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient été dispersés allaient de lieu en lieu, annonçant la bonne nouvelle de la parole.
verses.am: የተበተኑትም ቃሉን እየሰበኩ ዞሩ።

verses.en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
verses.fr: Philippe, étant descendu dans la ville de Samarie, y prêcha le Christ.
verses.am: ፊልጶስም ወደ ሰማርያ ከተማ ወርዶ ክርስቶስን ሰበከላቸው።

verses.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
verses.fr: Les foules tout entières étaient attentives à ce que disait Philippe, lorsqu''elles apprirent et virent les miracles qu''il faisait.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም የፊልጶስን ቃል በሰሙ ጊዜ ያደርጋት የነበረውንም ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ፥ የተናገረውን በአንድ ልብ አደመጡ።

verses.en: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
verses.fr: Car des esprits impurs sortirent de plusieurs démoniaques, en poussant de grands cris, et beaucoup de paralytiques et de boiteux furent guéris.
verses.am: ርኵሳን መናፍስት በታላቅ ድምፅ እየጮኹ ከብዙ ሰዎች ይወጡ ነበርና፤ ብዙም ሽባዎችና አንካሶች ተፈወሱ፤

verses.en: And there was great joy in that city.
verses.fr: Et il y eut une grande joie dans cette ville.
verses.am: በዚያችም ከተማ ታላቅ ደስታ ሆነ።

verses.en: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
verses.fr: Il y avait auparavant dans la ville un homme nommé Simon, qui, se donnant pour un personnage important, exerçait la magie et provoquait l''étonnement du peuple de la Samarie.
verses.am: ሲሞን የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ግን። እኔ ታላቅ ነኝ ብሎ፥ እየጠነቈለ የሰማርያንም ወገን እያስገረመ ቀድሞ በከተማ ነበረ።

verses.en: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
verses.fr: Tous, depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand, l''écoutaient attentivement, et disaient: Celui-ci est la puissance de Dieu, celle qui s''appelle la grande.
verses.am: ከታናናሾችም ጀምሮ እስከ ታላላቆቹ ድረስ። ታላቁ የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ይህ ነው እያሉ ሁሉ ያደምጡት ነበር።

verses.en: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
verses.fr: Ils l''écoutaient attentivement, parce qu''il les avait longtemps étonnés par ses actes de magie.
verses.am: ከብዙ ዘመንም ጀምሮ በጥንቈላ ስላስገረማቸው ያደምጡት ነበር።

verses.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.fr: Mais, quand ils eurent cru à Philippe, qui leur annonçait la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu et du nom de Jésus-Christ, hommes et femmes se firent baptiser.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትና ስለ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም እየሰበከላቸው ፊልጶስን ባመኑት ጊዜ፥ ወንዶችም ሴቶችም ተጠመቁ።

verses.en: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
verses.fr: Simon lui-même crut, et, après avoir été baptisé, il ne quittait plus Philippe, et il voyait avec étonnement les miracles et les grands prodiges qui s''opéraient.
verses.am: ሲሞንም ደግሞ ራሱ አመነ፤ ተጠምቆም ከፊልጶስ ጋር ይተባበር ነበር፤ የሚደረገውንም ምልክትና ታላቅ ተአምራት ባየ ጊዜ ተገረመ።

verses.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
verses.fr: Les apôtres, qui étaient à Jérusalem, ayant appris que la Samarie avait reçu la parole de Dieu, y envoyèrent Pierre et Jean.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም የነበሩት ሐዋርያት የሰማርያ ሰዎች የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደተቀበሉ ሰምተው ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ሰደዱላቸው።

verses.en: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
verses.fr: Ceux-ci, arrivés chez les Samaritains, prièrent pour eux, afin qu''ils reçussent le Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: እነርሱም በወረዱ ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ ጸለዩላቸው፤

verses.en: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
verses.fr: Car il n''était encore descendu sur aucun d''eux; ils avaient seulement été baptisés au nom du Seigneur Jésus.
verses.am: በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም ብቻ ተጠምቀው ነበር እንጂ ከእነርሱ በአንዱ ላይ ስንኳ ገና አልወረደም ነበርና።

verses.en: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Alors Pierre et Jean leur imposèrent les mains, et ils reçurent le Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እጃቸውን ጫኑባቸው መንፈስ ቅዱስንም ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
verses.fr: Lorsque Simon vit que le Saint-Esprit était donné par l''imposition des mains des apôtres, il leur offrit de l''argent,
verses.am: ሲሞንም በሐዋርያት እጅ መጫን መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዲሰጥ ባየ ጊዜ፥ ገንዘብ አመጣላቸውና።

verses.en: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: en disant: Accordez-moi aussi ce pouvoir, afin que celui à qui j''imposerai les mains reçoive le Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: እጄን የምጭንበት ሁሉ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ይቀበል ዘንድ ለእኔ ደግሞ ይህን ሥልጣን ስጡኝ አለ።

verses.en: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
verses.fr: Mais Pierre lui dit: Que ton argent périsse avec toi, puisque tu as cru que le don de Dieu s''acquérait à prix d''argent!
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን እንዲህ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታ በገንዘብ እንድታገኝ አስበሃልና ብርህ ከአንተ ጋር ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
verses.fr: Il n''y a pour toi ni part ni lot dans cette affaire, car ton coeur n''est pas droit devant Dieu.
verses.am: ልብህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የቀና አይደለምና ከዚህ ነገር ዕድል ወይም ፈንታ የለህም።

verses.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
verses.fr: Repens-toi donc de ta méchanceté, et prie le Seigneur pour que la pensée de ton coeur te soit pardonnée, s''il est possible;
verses.am: እንግዲህ ስለዚህ ክፋትህ ንሰሐ ግባ፥ ምናልባትም የልብህን አሳብ ይቅር ይልህ እንደ ሆነ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለምን፤

verses.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
verses.fr: car je vois que tu es dans un fiel amer et dans les liens de l''iniquité.
verses.am: በመራራ መርዝና በዓመፅ እስራት እንዳለህ አይሃለሁና።

verses.en: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
verses.fr: Simon répondit: Priez vous-mêmes le Seigneur pour moi, afin qu''il ne m''arrive rien de ce que vous avez dit.
verses.am: ሲሞንም መልሶ። ካላችሁት አንዳች እንዳይደርስብኝ እናንተው ወደ ጌታ ለምኑልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.fr: Après avoir rendu témoignage à la parole du Seigneur, et après l''avoir prêchée, Pierre et Jean retournèrent à Jérusalem, en annonçant la bonne nouvelle dans plusieurs villages des Samaritains.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከመሰከሩና የጌታን ቃል ከተናገሩ በኋላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፤ በሳምራውያን በብዙ መንደሮችም ወንጌልን ሰበኩ።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
verses.fr: Un ange du Seigneur, s''adressant à Philippe, lui dit: Lève-toi, et va du côté du midi, sur le chemin qui descend de Jérusalem à Gaza, celui qui est désert.
verses.am: የጌታም መልአክ ፊልጶስን። ተነሥተህ በደቡብ በኩል ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ጋዛ ወደሚያወርደው ምድረ በዳ ወደ ሆነ መንገድ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
verses.fr: Il se leva, et partit. Et voici, un Ethiopien, un eunuque, ministre de Candace, reine d''Ethiopie, et surintendant de tous ses trésors, venu à Jérusalem pour adorer,
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ሄደ። እነሆም፥ ህንደኬ የተባለች የኢትዮጵያ ንግሥት አዛዥና ጃንደረባ የነበረ በገንዘብዋም ሁሉ የሠለጠነ አንድ የኢትዮጵያ ሰው ሊሰግድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥቶ ነበር፤

verses.en: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
verses.fr: s''en retournait, assis sur son char, et lisait le prophète Esaïe.
verses.am: ሲመለስም በሰረገላ ተቀምጦ የነቢዩን የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ያነብ ነበር።

verses.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
verses.fr: L''Esprit dit à Philippe: Avance, et approche-toi de ce char.
verses.am: መንፈስም ፊልጶስን። ወደዚህ ሰረገላ ቅረብና ተገናኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
verses.fr: Philippe accourut, et entendit l''Ethiopien qui lisait le prophète Esaïe. Il lui dit: Comprends-tu ce que tu lis?
verses.am: ፊልጶስም ሮጦ የነቢዩን የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ሲያነብ ሰማና። በውኑ የምታነበውን ታስተውለዋለህን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Comment le pourrais-je, si quelqu''un ne me guide? Et il invita Philippe à monter et à s''asseoir avec lui.
verses.am: እርሱም። የሚመራኝ ሳይኖር ይህ እንዴት ይቻለኛል? አለው። ወጥቶም ከእርሱ ጋር ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ፊልጶስን ለመነው።

verses.en: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
verses.fr: Le passage de l''Ecriture qu''il lisait était celui-ci: Il a été mené comme une brebis à la boucherie; Et, comme un agneau muet devant celui qui le tond, Il n''a point ouvert la bouche.
verses.am: ያነበውም የነበረ የመጽሐፉ ክፍል ይህ ነበረ፤ እንደ በግ ወደ መታረድ ተነዳ፥ የበግ ጠቦትም በሸላቹ ፊት ዝም እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ አፉን አልከፈተም።

verses.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
verses.fr: Dans son humiliation, son jugement a été levé. Et sa postérité, qui la dépeindra? Car sa vie a été retranchée de la terre.
verses.am: በውርደቱ ፍርዱ ተወገደ፤ ሕይወቱ ከምድር ተወግዳለችና ትውልዱንስ ማን ይናገራል?

verses.en: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
verses.fr: L''eunuque dit à Philippe: Je te prie, de qui le prophète parle-t-il ainsi? Est-ce de lui-même, ou de quelque autre?
verses.am: ጃንደረባውም ለፊልጶስ መልሶ። እባክህ፥ ነቢዩ ይህን ስለ ማን ይናገራል? ስለ ራሱ ነውን ወይስ ስለ ሌላ? አለው።

verses.en: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
verses.fr: Alors Philippe, ouvrant la bouche et commençant par ce passage, lui annonça la bonne nouvelle de Jésus.
verses.am: ፊልጶስም አፉን ከፈተ፥ ከዚህም መጽሐፍ ጀምሮ ስለ ኢየሱስ ወንጌልን ሰበከለት።

verses.en: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.fr: Comme ils continuaient leur chemin, ils rencontrèrent de l''eau. Et l''eunuque dit: Voici de l''eau; qu''est-ce qui empêche que je sois baptisé?
verses.am: በመንገድም ሲሄዱ ወደ ውኃ ደረሱ፤ ጃንደረባውም። እነሆ ውኃ፤ እንዳልጠመቅ የሚከለክለኝ ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.en: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
verses.fr: Philippe dit: Si tu crois de tout ton coeur, cela est possible. L''eunuque répondit: Je crois que Jésus-Christ est le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: ፊልጶስም። በፍጹም ልብህ ብታምን፥ ተፈቅዶአል አለው። መልሶም። ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ አምናለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.fr: Il fit arrêter le char; Philippe et l''eunuque descendirent tous deux dans l''eau, et Philippe baptisa l''eunuque.
verses.am: ሰረገላውም ይቆም ዘንድ አዘዘ፥ ፊልጶስና ጃንደረባው ሁለቱም ወደ ውኃ ወረዱ፥ አጠመቀውም።

verses.en: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.fr: Quand ils furent sortis de l''eau, l''Esprit du Seigneur enleva Philippe, et l''eunuque ne le vit plus. Tandis que, joyeux, il poursuivait sa route,
verses.am: ከውኃውም ከወጡ በኋላ የጌታ መንፈስ ፊልጶስን ነጠቀው፤ ጃንደረባውም ሁለተኛ አላየውም፥ ደስ ብሎት መንገዱን ይሄድ ነበርና።

verses.en: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
verses.fr: Philippe se trouva dans Azot, d''où il alla jusqu''à Césarée, en évangélisant toutes les villes par lesquelles il passait.
verses.am: ፊልጶስ ግን በአዛጦን ተገኘ፥ ወደ ቂሣርያም እስኪመጣ ድረስ እየዞረ በከተማዎች ሁሉ ወንጌልን ይሰብክ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.fr: Cependant Saul, respirant encore la menace et le meurtre contre les disciples du Seigneur, se rendit chez le souverain sacrificateur,
verses.am: ሳውል ግን የጌታን ደቀ መዛሙርት እንዲገድላቸው ገና እየዛተ ወደ ሊቀ ካህናት ሄደ፥

verses.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
verses.fr: et lui demanda des lettres pour les synagogues de Damas, afin que, s''il trouvait des partisans de la nouvelle doctrine, hommes ou femmes, il les amenât liés à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በዚህ መንገድ ያሉትንም ሰዎች ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ቢያገኝ፥ እያሰረ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ያመጣቸው ዘንድ በደማስቆ ላሉት ምኵራቦች ደብዳቤ ከእርሱ ለመነ።

verses.en: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
verses.fr: Comme il était en chemin, et qu''il approchait de Damas, tout à coup une lumière venant du ciel resplendit autour de lui.
verses.am: ሲሄድም ወደ ደማስቆ በቀረበ ጊዜ ድንገት በእርሱ ዙሪያ ከሰማይ ብርሃን አንጸባረቀ፤

verses.en: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.fr: Il tomba par terre, et il entendit une voix qui lui disait: Saul, Saul, pourquoi me persécutes-tu?
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ ወድቆ ሳለ። ሳውል ሳውል፥ ስለ ምን ታሳድደኛለህ? የሚለውን ድምፅ ሰማ።

verses.en: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Qui es-tu, Seigneur? Et le Seigneur dit: Je suis Jésus que tu persécutes. Il te serait dur de regimber contre les aiguillons.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ማን ነህ? አለው። እርሱም። አንተ የምታሳድደኝ እኔ ኢየሱስ ነኝ፤ የመውጊያውን ብረት ብትቃወም ለአንተ ይብስብሃል አለው።

verses.en: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.fr: Tremblant et saisi d''effroi, il dit: Seigneur, que veux-tu que je fasse? Et le Seigneur lui dit: Lève-toi, entre dans la ville, et on te dira ce que tu dois faire.
verses.am: እየተንቀጠቀጠና እየተደነቀ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምን አደርግ ዘንድ ትወዳለህ? አለው። ጌታም። ተነሥተህ ወደ ከተማ ግባና ታደርገው ዘንድ የሚያስፈልግህን ይነግሩሃል አለው።

verses.en: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
verses.fr: Les hommes qui l''accompagnaient demeurèrent stupéfaits; ils entendaient bien la voix, mais ils ne voyaient personne.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር በመንገድ የሄዱ ሰዎች ድምፁን እየሰሙ ማንን ግን ሳያዩ እንደ ዲዳዎች ቁሙ።

verses.en: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
verses.fr: Saul se releva de terre, et, quoique ses yeux fussent ouverts, il ne voyait rien; on le prit par la main, et on le conduisit à Damas.
verses.am: ሳውልም ከምድር ተነሣ፥ አይኖቹም በተከፈቱ ጊዜ ምንም አላየም፤ እጁንም ይዘው እየመሩ ወደ ደማስቆ አገቡት።

verses.en: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
verses.fr: Il resta trois jours sans voir, et il ne mangea ni ne but.
verses.am: ሳያይም ሦስት ቀን ኖረ፤ አልበላምም አልጠጣምም።

verses.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait à Damas un disciple nommé Ananias. Le Seigneur lui dit dans une vision: Ananias! Il répondit: Me voici, Seigneur!
verses.am: በደማስቆም ሐናንያ የሚሉት አንድ ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረ፥ ጌታም በራእይ። ሐናንያ ሆይ፥ አለው። እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆኝ አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verses.fr: Et le Seigneur lui dit: Lève-toi, va dans la rue qu''on appelle la droite, et cherche, dans la maison de Judas, un nommé Saul de Tarse. Car il prie,
verses.am: ጌታም። ተነሥተህ ቅን ወደ ሚባለው መንገድ ሂድ፥ በይሁዳ ቤትም ሳውል የሚሉትን አንድ የጠርሴስ ሰው ፈልግ፤

verses.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.fr: et il a vu en vision un homme du nom d''Ananias, qui entrait, et qui lui imposait les mains, afin qu''il recouvrât la vue.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እርሱ ይጸልያልና፤ ሐናንያ የሚሉትም ሰው ገብቶ ደግሞ እንዲያይ እጁን ሲጭንበት አይቶአል አለው።

verses.en: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.fr: Ananias répondit: Seigneur, j''ai appris de plusieurs personnes tous les maux que cet homme a faits à tes saints dans Jérusalem;
verses.am: ሐናንያም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም በቅዱሳንህ ላይ ስንት ክፉ እንዳደረገ ስለዚህ ሰው ከብዙዎች ሰምቼአለሁ፤

verses.en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
verses.fr: et il a ici des pouvoirs, de la part des principaux sacrificateurs, pour lier tous ceux qui invoquent ton nom.
verses.am: በዚህም ስምህን የሚጠሩትን ሁሉ ለማሰር ከካህናት አለቆች ሥልጣን አለው አለ።

verses.en: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.fr: Mais le Seigneur lui dit: Va, car cet homme est un instrument que j''ai choisi, pour porter mon nom devant les nations, devant les rois, et devant les fils d''Israël;
verses.am: ጌታም። ይህ በአሕዛብም በነገሥታትም በእስራኤልም ልጆች ፊት ስሜን ይሸከም ዘንድ ለእኔ የተመረጠ ዕቃ ነውና ሂድ፤

verses.en: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
verses.fr: et je lui montrerai tout ce qu''il doit souffrir pour mon nom.
verses.am: ስለ ስሜ ስንት መከራ ሊቀበል እንዲያስፈልገው እኔ አመለክተዋለሁና አለው።

verses.en: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Ananias sortit; et, lorsqu''il fut arrivé dans la maison, il imposa les mains à Saul, en disant: Saul, mon frère, le Seigneur Jésus, qui t''est apparu sur le chemin par lequel tu venais, m''a envoyé pour que tu recouvres la vue et que tu sois rempli du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: ሐናንያም ሄዶ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፥ እጁንም ጭኖበት። ወንድሜ ሳውል ሆይ፥ ጌታ፥ እርሱም በመጣህበት መንገድ የታየህ ኢየሱስ ነው፥ ደግሞ ታይ ዘንድና መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይሞላብህ ዘንድ ላከኝ አለ።

verses.en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verses.fr: Au même instant, il tomba de ses yeux comme des écailles, et il recouvra la vue. Il se leva, et fut baptisé;
verses.am: ወዲያውም እንደ ቅርፊት ያለ ከዓይኑ ወደቀ፥ ያን ጊዜም ደግሞ አየ፤ ተነሥቶም ተጠመቀ፥

verses.en: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
verses.fr: et, après qu''il eut pris de la nourriture, les forces lui revinrent. Saul resta quelques jours avec les disciples qui étaient à Damas.
verses.am: መብልም በልቶ በረታ። በደማስቆም ካሉት ደቀ መዛሙርት ጋር ጥቂት ቀን ኖረ።

verses.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.fr: Et aussitôt il prêcha dans les synagogues que Jésus est le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ስለ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ በምኵራቦቹ ሰበከ።

verses.en: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui l''entendaient étaient dans l''étonnement, et disaient: N''est-ce pas celui qui persécutait à Jérusalem ceux qui invoquent ce nom, et n''est-il pas venu ici pour les emmener liés devant les principaux sacrificateurs?
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሁሉ ተገረሙና። ይህ በኢየሩሳሌም ይህን ስም የሚጠሩትን ያጠፋ አይደለምን? ስለዚህስ ታስረው ወደ ካህናት አለቆች ይወስዳቸው ዘንድ ወደዚህ አልመጣምን? አሉ።

verses.en: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
verses.fr: Cependant Saul se fortifiait de plus en plus, et il confondait les Juifs qui habitaient Damas, démontrant que Jésus est le Christ.
verses.am: ሳውል ግን እየበረታ ሄደ፥ በደማስቆም ለተቀመጡት አይሁድ ይህ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ አስረድቶ መልስ ያሳጣቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
verses.fr: Au bout d''un certain temps, les Juifs se concertèrent pour le tuer,
verses.am: ብዙ ቀንም ሲሞላ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት ተማከሩ፤

verses.en: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
verses.fr: et leur complot parvint à la connaissance de Saul. On gardait les portes jour et nuit, afin de lui ôter la vie.
verses.am: ሳውል ግን አሳባቸውን አወቀ። ይገድሉትም ዘንድ በሌሊትና በቀን የከተማይቱን በር ሁሉ ይጠቀብቁ ነበር፤

verses.en: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
verses.fr: Mais, pendant une nuit, les disciples le prirent, et le descendirent par la muraille, dans une corbeille.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን በሌሊት ወስደው በቅጥር ላይ አሳልፈው በቅርጫት አወረዱት።

verses.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il se rendit à Jérusalem, Saul tâcha de se joindre à eux; mais tous le craignaient, ne croyant pas qu''il fût un disciple.
verses.am: ሳውልም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በደረሰ ጊዜ ከደቀ መዛሙርት ጋር ይተባበር ዘንድ ሞከረ፤ ሁሉም ደቀ መዝሙር እንደ ሆነ ስላላመኑ ፈሩት።

verses.en: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.fr: Alors Barnabas, l''ayant pris avec lui, le conduisit vers les apôtres, et leur raconta comment sur le chemin Saul avait vu le Seigneur, qui lui avait parlé, et comment à Damas il avait prêché franchement au nom de Jésus.
verses.am: በርናባስ ግን ወስዶ ወደ ሐዋርያት አገባውና ጌታን በመንገድ እንዴት እንዳየውና እንደ ተናገረው በደማስቆም በኢየሱስ ስም ደፍሮ እንዴት እንደ ነገረ ተረከላቸው።

verses.en: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il allait et venait avec eux dans Jérusalem,
verses.am: በጌታም በኢየሱስ ስም ደፍሮ እየተናገረ በኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጣና ሲገባ ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ፤

verses.en: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
verses.fr: et s''exprimait en toute assurance au nom du Seigneur. Il parlait aussi et disputait avec les Hellénistes; mais ceux-ci cherchaient à lui ôter la vie.
verses.am: ከግሪክ አገርም መጥተው ከነበሩት አይሁድ ጋር ይነጋገርና ይከራከር ነበር፤ እነርሱ ግን ሊገድሉት ፈለጉ።

verses.en: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.fr: Les frères, l''ayant su, l''emmenèrent à Césarée, et le firent partir pour Tarse.
verses.am: ወንድሞችም ይህን ባወቁ ጊዜ ወደ ቂሣርያ ወሰዱት ወደ ጠርሴስም ሰደዱት።

verses.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verses.fr: L''Eglise était en paix dans toute la Judée, la Galilée et la Samarie, s''édifiant et marchant dans la crainte du Seigneur, et elle s''accroissait par l''assistance du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ሁሉና በገሊላ በሰማርያም የነበሩት አብያተ ክርስቲያናት በሰላም ኖሩ ታነጹም፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃትና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ መጽናናት እየሄዱ ይበዙ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
verses.fr: Comme Pierre visitait tous les saints, il descendit aussi vers ceux qui demeuraient à Lydde.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም በየስፍራው ሁሉ ሲዞር በልዳ ወደሚኖሩ ቅዱሳን ደግሞ ወረደ።

verses.en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
verses.fr: Il y trouva un homme nommé Enée, couché sur un lit depuis huit ans, et paralytique.
verses.am: በዚያም ከስምንት ዓመት ጀምሮ በአልጋ ላይ ተኝቶ የነበረውን ኤንያ የሚሉትን አንድ ሰው አገኘ፤ እርሱም ሽባ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
verses.fr: Pierre lui dit: Enée, Jésus-Christ te guérit; lève-toi, et arrange ton lit. Et aussitôt il se leva.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ኤንያ ሆይ፥ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ይፈውስሃል፤ ተነሣ ለራስህም አንጥፍ አለው።

verses.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
verses.fr: Tous les habitants de Lydde et du Saron le virent, et ils se convertirent au Seigneur.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ተነሣ። በልዳና በሰሮናም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ እርሱን አይተው ወደ ጌታ ዘወር አሉ።

verses.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
verses.fr: Il y avait à Joppé, parmi les disciples, une femme nommée Tabitha, ce qui signifie Dorcas: elle faisait beaucoup de bonnes oeuvres et d''aumônes.
verses.am: በኢዮጴም ጣቢታ የሚሉአት አንዲት ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረች፥ ትርጓሜውም ዶርቃ ማለት ነው፤ እርስዋም መልካም ነገር የሞላባት ምጽዋትም የምታደርግ ነበረች።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
verses.fr: Elle tomba malade en ce temps-là, et mourut. Après l''avoir lavée, on la déposa dans une chambre haute.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ታመመችና ሞተች፤ አጥበውም በሰገነት አኖሩአት።

verses.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
verses.fr: Comme Lydde est près de Joppé, les disciples, ayant appris que Pierre s''y trouvait, envoyèrent deux hommes vers lui, pour le prier de venir chez eux sans tarder.
verses.am: ልዳም ለኢዮጴ ቅርብ ናትና ደቀ መዛሙርት ጴጥሮስ በዚያ እንዳለ ሰምተው፥ ወደ እነርሱ ከመምጣት እንዳይዘገይ እየለመኑ ሁለት ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ላኩ።

verses.en: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.fr: Pierre se leva, et partit avec ces hommes. Lorsqu''il fut arrivé, on le conduisit dans la chambre haute. Toutes les veuves l''entourèrent en pleurant, et lui montrèrent les tuniques et les vêtements que faisait Dorcas pendant qu''elle était avec elles.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ተነሥቶ ከእነርሱ ጋር መጣ፤ በደረሰም ጊዜ በሰገነት አወጡት መበለቶችም ሁሉ እያለቀሱ ዶርቃ ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለች ያደረገቻቸውን ቀሚሶችንና ልብሶችን ሁሉ እያሳዩት በፊቱ ቆሙ።

verses.en: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.fr: Pierre fit sortir tout le monde, se mit à genoux, et pria; puis, se tournant vers le corps, il dit: Tabitha, lève-toi! Elle ouvrit les yeux, et ayant vu Pierre, elle s''assit.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ሁሉን ወደ ውጭ አስወጥቶ ተንበርክኮም ጸለየ፥ ወደ ሬሳውም ዘወር ብሎ። ጣቢታ ሆይ፥ ተነሺ አላት። እርስዋም ዓይኖችዋን ከፈተች ጴጥሮስንም ባየች ጊዜ ተቀመጠች።

verses.en: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
verses.fr: Il lui donna la main, et la fit lever. Il appela ensuite les saints et les veuves, et la leur présenta vivante.
verses.am: እጁንም ለእርስዋ ሰጥቶ አስነሣት፤ ቅዱሳንንና መበለቶችንም ጠራ ሕያውም ሆና በፊታቸው አቆማት።

verses.en: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
verses.fr: Cela fut connu de tout Joppé, et beaucoup crurent au Seigneur.
verses.am: ይህም በኢዮጴ ሁሉ የታወቀ ሆነ፥ ብዙ ሰዎችም በጌታ አመኑ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.fr: Pierre demeura quelque temps à Joppé, chez un corroyeur nommé Simon.
verses.am: በኢዮጴም ስምዖን ከሚሉት ከአንድ ቍርበት ፋቂ ጋር አያሌ ቀን ኖረ።

verses.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
verses.fr: Il y avait à Césarée un homme nommé Corneille, centenier dans la cohorte dite italienne.
verses.am: በቂሣርያም ኢጣሊቄ ለሚሉት ጭፍራ የመቶ አለቃ የሆነ ቆርኔሌዎስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
verses.fr: Cet homme était pieux et craignait Dieu, avec toute sa maison; il faisait beaucoup d''aumônes au peuple, et priait Dieu continuellement.
verses.am: እርሱም ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር እግዚአብሔርን የሚያመልክና የሚፈራ ለሕዝብም እጅግ ምጽዋት የሚያደርግ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ሁልጊዜ የሚጸልይ ነበረ።

verses.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
verses.fr: Vers la neuvième heure du jour, il vit clairement dans une vision un ange de Dieu qui entra chez lui, et qui lui dit: Corneille!
verses.am: ከቀኑም ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ያህል። ቆርኔሌዎስ ሆይ የሚለው የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ወደ እርሱ ሲገባ በራእይ በግልጥ አየው።

verses.en: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
verses.fr: Les regards fixés sur lui, et saisi d''effroi, il répondit: Qu''est-ce, Seigneur? Et l''ange lui dit: Tes prières et tes aumônes sont montées devant Dieu, et il s''en est souvenu.
verses.am: እርሱም ትኵር ብሎ ሲመለከተው ደንግጦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምንድር ነው? አለ። መልአኩም አለው። ጸሎትህና ምጽዋትህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመታሰቢያ እንዲሆን አረገ።

verses.en: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
verses.fr: Envoie maintenant des hommes à Joppé, et fais venir Simon, surnommé Pierre;
verses.am: አሁንም ወደ ኢዮጴ ሰዎችን ልከህ ጴጥሮስ የሚባለውን ስምዖንን አስመጣ።

verses.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
verses.fr: il est logé chez un certain Simon, corroyeur, dont la maison est près de la mer.
verses.am: እርሱ ቤቱ በባሕር አጠገብ ባለው በቍርበት ፋቂው በስምዖን ዘንድ እንግድነት ተቀምጦአል፤ ልታደርገው የሚገባህን እርሱ ይነግርሃል።

verses.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.fr: Dès que l''ange qui lui avait parlé fut parti, Corneille appela deux de ses serviteurs, et un soldat pieux d''entre ceux qui étaient attachés à sa personne;
verses.am: የተናገረውም መልአክ በሄደ ጊዜ፥ ከሎሎዎቹ ሁለቱን፥ ከማይለዩትም ጭፍሮቹ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያመልክ አንዱን ወታደር ጠርቶ፥

verses.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.fr: et, après leur avoir tout raconté, il les envoya à Joppé.
verses.am: ነገሩን ሁሉ ተረከላቸው ወደ ኢዮጴም ላካቸው።

verses.en: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.fr: Le lendemain, comme ils étaient en route, et qu''ils approchaient de la ville, Pierre monta sur le toit, vers la sixième heure, pour prier.
verses.am: እነርሱም በነገው ሲሄዱ ወደ ከተማም ሲቀርቡ፥ ጴጥሮስ በስድስት ሰዓት ያህል ይጸልይ ዘንድ ወደ ጣራው ወጣ።

verses.en: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.fr: Il eut faim, et il voulut manger. Pendant qu''on lui préparait à manger, il tomba en extase.
verses.am: ተርቦም ሊበላ ወደደ፤ ሲያዘጋጁለት ሳሉም ተመስጦ መጣበት፤

verses.en: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending upon him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.fr: Il vit le ciel ouvert, et un objet semblable à une grande nappe attachée par les quatre coins, qui descendait et s''abaissait vers la terre,
verses.am: ሰማይም ተከፍቶ በአራት ማዕዘን የተያዘ ታላቅ ሸማ የሚመስል ዕቃ ወደ ምድር ሲወርድ አየ፤

verses.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.fr: et où se trouvaient tous les quadrupèdes et les reptiles de la terre et les oiseaux du ciel.
verses.am: በዚያውም አራት እግር ያላቸው ሁሉ አራዊትም በምድርም የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሰማይ ወፎችም ነበሩበት።

verses.en: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.fr: Et une voix lui dit: Lève-toi, Pierre, tue et mange.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ ተነሣና አርደህ ብላ የሚልም ድምፅ ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

verses.en: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.fr: Mais Pierre dit: Non, Seigneur, car je n''ai jamais rien mangé de souillé ni d''impur.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አይሆንም፤ አንዳች ርኵስ የሚያስጸይፍም ከቶ በልቼ አላውቅምና አለ።

verses.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.fr: Et pour la seconde fois la voix se fit encore entendre à lui: Ce que Dieu a déclaré pur, ne le regarde pas comme souillé.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሁለተኛ። እግዚአብሔር ያነጻውን አንተ አታርክሰው የሚል ድምፅ ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

verses.en: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.fr: Cela arriva jusqu''à trois fois; et aussitôt après, l''objet fut retiré dans le ciel.
verses.am: ይህም ሦስት ጊዜ ሆነ፥ ወዲያውም ዕቃው ወደ ሰማይ ተወሰደ።

verses.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
verses.fr: Tandis que Pierre ne savait en lui-même que penser du sens de la vision qu''il avait eue, voici, les hommes envoyés par Corneille, s''étant informés de la maison de Simon, se présentèrent à la porte,
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ስላየው ራእይ። ምን ይሆን? ብሎ በልቡ ሲያመነታ፥ እነሆ፥ ቆርኔሌዎስ የላካቸው ሰዎች ስለ ስምዖን ቤት ጠይቀው ወደ ደጁ ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.fr: et demandèrent à haute voix si c''était là que logeait Simon, surnommé Pierre.
verses.am: ድምፃቸውንም ከፍ አድርገው። ጴጥሮስ የተባለው ስምዖን በዚህ እንግድነት ተቀምጦአልን? ብለው ይጠይቁ ነበር።

verses.en: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.fr: Et comme Pierre était à réfléchir sur la vision, l''Esprit lui dit: Voici, trois hommes te demandent;
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ስለ ራእዩ ሲያወጣ ሲያወርድ ሳለ፥ መንፈስ። እነሆ፥ ሦስት ሰዎች ይፈልጉሃል፤

verses.en: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.fr: lève-toi, descends, et pars avec eux sans hésiter, car c''est moi qui les ai envoyés.
verses.am: ተነሥተህ ውረድ፥ እኔም ልኬአቸዋለሁና ሳትጠራጠር ከእነርሱ ጋር ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.fr: Pierre donc descendit, et il dit à ces hommes: Voici, je suis celui que vous cherchez; quel est le motif qui vous amène?
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ሰዎቹ ወርዶ። እነሆ፥ የምትፈልጉኝ እኔ ነኝ፤ የመጣችሁበትስ ምክንያት ምንድር ነው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Corneille, centenier, homme juste et craignant Dieu, et de qui toute la nation des Juifs rend un bon témoignage, a été divinement averti par un saint ange de te faire venir dans sa maison et d''entendre tes paroles.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ጻድቅ ሰው እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ በአይሁድም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የተመሰከረለት የመቶ አለቃ ቆርኔሌዎስ ወደ ቤቱ ያስመጣህ ዘንድ ከአንተም ቃልን ይሰማ ዘንድ ከቅዱስ መልአክ ተረዳ አሉት።

verses.en: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.fr: Pierre donc les fit entrer, et les logea. Le lendemain, il se leva, et partit avec eux. Quelques-uns des frères de Joppé l''accompagnèrent.
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ ውስጥ ጠርቶ እንድግድነት ተቀበላቸው። በነገውም ተነሥቶ ከእነርሱ ጋር ወጣ፥ በኢዮጴም ከነበሩት ወንድሞች አንዳንዶቹ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and he had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Césarée le jour suivant. Corneille les attendait, et avait invité ses parents et ses amis intimes.
verses.am: በነገውም ወደ ቂሣርያ ገቡ፤ ቆርኔሌዎስም ዘመዶቹንና የቅርብ ወዳጆቹን በአንድነት ጠርቶ ይጠባበቃቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Pierre entra, Corneille, qui était allé au-devant de lui, tomba à ses pieds et se prosterna.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም በገባ ጊዜ ቆርኔሌዎስ ተገናኝቶ ከእግሩ በታች ወደቀና ሰገደለት።

verses.en: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.fr: Mais Pierre le releva, en disant: Lève-toi; moi aussi, je suis un homme.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን። ተነሣ፤ እኔ ራሴ ደግሞ ሰው ነኝ ብሎ አስነሣው።

verses.en: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.fr: Et conversant avec lui, il entra, et trouva beaucoup de personnes réunies.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር እየተነጋገረ ገባ፥ ብዙዎችም ተከማችተው አግኝቶ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.fr: Vous savez, leur dit-il, qu''il est défendu à un Juif de se lier avec un étranger ou d''entrer chez lui; mais Dieu m''a appris à ne regarder aucun homme comme souillé et impur.
verses.am: አይሁዳዊ ሰው ከሌላ ወገን ጋር ይተባበር ወይም ይቃረብ ዘንድ እንዳልተፈቀደ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ፤ ለእኔ ግን እግዚአብሔር ማንንም ሰው ርኵስና የሚያስጸይፍ ነው እንዳልል አሳየኝ፤

verses.en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je n''ai pas eu d''objection à venir, puisque vous m''avez appelé; je vous demande donc pour quel motif vous m''avez envoyé chercher.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ደግሞ ብትጠሩኝ ሳልከራከር መጣሁ። አሁንም በምን ምክንያት አስመጣችሁኝ? ብዬ እጠይቃችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.fr: Corneille dit: Il y a quatre jours, à cette heure-ci, je priais dans ma maison à la neuvième heure; et voici, un homme vêtu d''un habit éclatant se présenta devant moi,
verses.am: ቆርኔሌዎስም እንዲህ አለው። በዚች ሰዓት የዛሬ አራት ቀን የዘጠኝ ሰዓት ጸሎት በቤቴ እጸልይ ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ የሚያንጸባርቅ ልብስ የለበሰ ሰው በፊቴ ቆመና።

verses.en: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.fr: et dit: Corneille, ta prière a été exaucée, et Dieu s''est souvenu de tes aumônes.
verses.am: ቆርኔሌዎስ ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጸሎትህ ተሰማ ምጽዋትህም ታሰበ።

verses.en: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
verses.fr: Envoie donc à Joppé, et fais venir Simon, surnommé Pierre; il est logé dans la maison de Simon, corroyeur, près de la mer.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወደ ኢዮጴ ልከህ ጴጥሮስ የተባለውን ስምዖንን አስጠራ፤ እርሱ በቍርበት ፋቂው በስምዖን ቤት በባሕር አጠገብ እንግድነት ተቀምጦአል አለኝ።

verses.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
verses.fr: Aussitôt j''ai envoyé vers toi, et tu as bien fait de venir. Maintenant donc nous sommes tous devant Dieu, pour entendre tout ce que le Seigneur t''a ordonné de nous dire.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያን ጊዜ ወደ አንተ ላክሁ፥ አንተም በመምጣትህ መልካም አድርገሃል። እንግዲህ አንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታዘዝኸውን ሁሉ እንድንሰማ እኛ ሁላችን አሁን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በዚህ አለን።

verses.en: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.fr: Alors Pierre, ouvrant la bouche, dit: En vérité, je reconnais que Dieu ne fait point acception de personnes,
verses.am: የሁሉ ጌታ በሚሆን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምን እየሰበከ ይህን ቃል ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ላከ።

verses.en: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.fr: mais qu''en toute nation celui qui le craint et qui pratique la justice lui est agréable.
verses.am: የሁሉ ጌታ በሚሆን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምን እየሰበከ ይህን ቃል ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ላከ።

verses.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
verses.fr: Il a envoyé la parole aux fils d''Israël, en leur annonçant la paix par Jésus-Christ, qui est le Seigneur de tous.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ከሰበከው ጥምቀት በኋላ ከገሊላ ጀምሮ በይሁዳ ሁሉ የሆነውን ነገር እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.fr: Vous savez ce qui est arrivé dans toute la Judée, après avoir commencé en Galilée, à la suite du baptême que Jean a prêché;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በኃይልም ቀባው፥ እርሱም መልካም እያደረገ ለዲያብሎስም የተገዙትን ሁሉ እየፈወሰ ዞረ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረና፤

verses.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.fr: vous savez comment Dieu a oint du Saint-Esprit et de force Jésus de Nazareth, qui allait de lieu en lieu faisant du bien et guérissant tous ceux qui étaient sous l''empire du diable, car Dieu était avec lui.
verses.am: እኛም በአይሁድ አገርና በኢየሩሳሌም ባደረገው ነገር ሁሉ ምስክሮች ነን፤ እርሱንም በእንጨት ላይ ሰቅለው ገደሉት።

verses.en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.fr: Nous sommes témoins de tout ce qu''il a fait dans le pays des Juifs et à Jérusalem. Ils l''ont tué, en le pendant au bois.
verses.am: እርሱን እግዚአብሔር በሦስተኛው ቀን አስነሣው ይገለጥም ዘንድ ሰጠው፤

verses.en: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.fr: Dieu l''a ressuscité le troisième jour, et il a permis qu''il apparût,
verses.am: ይኸውም ለሕዝብ ሁሉ አይደለም ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ የተመረጡ ምስክሮች ለሆንን ለእኛ ነው እንጂ፤ ከሙታንም ከተነሣ በኋላ ከእርሱ ጋር የበላን የጠጣንም እኛ ነን።

verses.en: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.fr: non à tout le peuple, mais aux témoins choisis d''avance par Dieu, à nous qui avons mangé et bu avec lui, après qu''il fut ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: ለሕዝብም እንድንሰብክና በሕያዋንና በሙታን ሊፈርድ በእግዚአብሔር የተወሰነ እርሱ እንደ ሆነ እንመሰክር ዘንድ አዘዘን።

verses.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.fr: Et Jésus nous a ordonné de prêcher au peuple et d''attester que c''est lui qui a été établi par Dieu juge des vivants et des morts.
verses.am: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ በስሙ የኃጢአቱን ስርየት እንዲቀበል ነቢያት ሁሉ ይመሰክሩለታል።

verses.en: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.fr: Tous les prophètes rendent de lui le témoignage que quiconque croit en lui reçoit par son nom le pardon des péchés.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ይህን ነገር ገና ሲናገር ቃሉን በሰሙት ሁሉ ላይ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ወረደ።

verses.en: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.fr: Comme Pierre prononçait encore ces mots, le Saint-Esprit descendit sur tous ceux qui écoutaient la parole.
verses.am: ከጴጥሮስም ጋር የመጡት ሁሉ ከተገረዙት ወገን የሆኑ ምዕመናን በአሕዛብ ላይ ደግሞ የመንፈስ ቅዱስ ስጦታ ስለ ፈሰሰ ተገረሙ፤

verses.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Tous les fidèles circoncis qui étaient venus avec Pierre furent étonnés de ce que le don du Saint-Esprit était aussi répandu sur les païens.
verses.am: በልሳኖች ሲናገሩ እግዚአብሔርንም ሲያከብሩ ሰምተዋቸዋልና።

verses.en: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.fr: Car ils les entendaient parler en langues et glorifier Dieu. Alors Pierre dit:
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መልሶ። እነዚህ እንደ እኛ ደግሞ መንፈስ ቅዱስን የተቀበሉ እንዳይጠመቁ ውኃን ይከለክላቸው ዘንድ የሚችል ማን ነው? አለ።

verses.en: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
verses.fr: Peut-on refuser l''eau du baptême à ceux qui ont reçu le Saint-Esprit aussi bien que nous?
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስምም ይጠመቁ ዘንድ አዘዛቸው። ከዚህ በኋላ ጥቂት ቀን እንዲቀመጥ ለመኑት።

verses.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.fr: Et il ordonna qu''ils fussent baptisés au nom du Seigneur. Sur quoi ils le prièrent de rester quelques jours auprès d''eux.
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስምም ይጠመቁ ዘንድ አዘዛቸው። ከዚህ በኋላ ጥቂት ቀን እንዲቀመጥ ለመኑት።

verses.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.fr: Les apôtres et les frères qui étaient dans la Judée apprirent que les païens avaient aussi reçu la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: ሐዋርያትና በይሁዳም የነበሩት ወንድሞች አሕዛብ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ ተቀበሉ ሰሙ።

verses.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.fr: Et lorsque Pierre fut monté à Jérusalem, les fidèles circoncis lui adressèrent des reproches,
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በወጣ ጊዜ ከተገረዙት ወገን የሆኑት ሰዎች ከእርሱ ጋር ተከራክረው።

verses.en: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.fr: en disant: Tu es entré chez des incirconcis, et tu as mangé avec eux.
verses.am: ወዳልተገረዙ ሰዎች ገብተህ ከእነርሱ ጋር በላህ አሉት።

verses.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.fr: Pierre se mit à leur exposer d''une manière suivie ce qui s''était passé. Il dit:
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን ከመጀመሪያው ጀምሮ በተራ ገለጠላቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.fr: J''étais dans la ville de Joppé, et, pendant que je priais, je tombai en extase et j''eus une vision: un objet, semblable à une grande nappe attachée par les quatre coins, descendait du ciel et vint jusqu''à moi.
verses.am: እኔ በኢዮጴ ከተማ ስጸልይ ሳለሁ ተመስጬ ራእይን አየሁ፤ ታላቅ ሸማ የመሰለ ዕቃ በአራት ማዕዘን ተይዞ ከሰማይ ወረደና ወደ እኔ መጣ፤

verses.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.fr: Les regards fixés sur cette nappe, j''examinai, et je vis les quadrupèdes de la terre, les bêtes sauvages, les reptiles, et les oiseaux du ciel.
verses.am: ይህንም ትኵር ብዬ ስመለከት አራት እግር ያላቸውን የምድር እንስሶች አራዊትንም ተንቀሳቃሾችንም የሰማይ ወፎችንም አየሁ።

verses.en: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.fr: Et j''entendis une voix qui me disait: Lève-toi, Pierre, tue et mange.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ ተነሣና አርደህ ብላ የሚለኝንም ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.fr: Mais je dis: Non, Seigneur, car jamais rien de souillé ni d''impur n''est entré dans ma bouche.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አይሆንም፤ ርኵስ ወይም የሚያስጸይፍ ከቶ ወደ አፌ ገብቶ አያውቅምና አልሁ።

verses.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.fr: Et pour la seconde fois la voix se fit entendre du ciel: Ce que Dieu a déclaré pur, ne le regarde pas comme souillé.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም። እግዚአብሔር ያነጻውን አንተ አታርክሰው የሚል ድምፅ ከሰማይ መለሰልኝ።

verses.en: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.fr: Cela arriva jusqu''à trois fois; puis tout fut retiré dans le ciel.
verses.am: ይህም ሦስት ጊዜ ሆነ እንደ ገናም ሁሉ ወደ ሰማይ ተሳበ።

verses.en: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.fr: Et voici, aussitôt trois hommes envoyés de Césarée vers moi se présentèrent devant la porte de la maison où j''étais.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ያን ጊዜ ሦስት ሰዎች ከቂሣርያ ወደ እኔ ተልከው ወዳለሁበት ቤት ቀረቡ።

verses.en: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
verses.fr: L''Esprit me dit de partir avec eux sans hésiter. Les six hommes que voici m''accompagnèrent, et nous entrâmes dans la maison de Corneille.
verses.am: መንፈስም ሳልጠራጠር ከእነርሱ ጋር እሄድ ዘንድ ነገረኝ። እነዚህም ስድስቱ ወንድሞች ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር መጡ ወደዚያ ሰውም ቤት ገባን።

verses.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.fr: Cet homme nous raconta comment il avait vu dans sa maison l''ange se présentant à lui et disant: Envoie à Joppé, et fais venir Simon, surnommé Pierre,
verses.am: እርሱም መልአክ በቤቱ ቆሞ እንዳየና። ወደ ኢዮጴ ሰዎች ልከህ ጴጥሮስ የተባለውን ስምዖንን አስመጣ፤

verses.en: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.fr: qui te dira des choses par lesquelles tu seras sauvé, toi et toute ta maison.
verses.am: እርሱም አንተና የቤትህ ሰዎች ሁሉ የምትድኑበትን ነገር ይነግርሃል እንዳለው ነገረን።

verses.en: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.fr: Lorsque je me fus mis à parler, le Saint-Esprit descendit sur eux, comme sur nous au commencement.
verses.am: ለመናገርም በጀመርሁ ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ለእኛ ደግሞ በመጀመሪያ እንደ ወረደ ለእነርሱ ወረደላቸው።

verses.en: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Et je me souvins de cette parole du Seigneur: Jean a baptisé d''eau, mais vous, vous serez baptisés du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ በውኃ አጠመቀ እናንተ ግን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ትጠመቃላችሁ ያለውም የጌታ ቃል ትዝ አለኝ።

verses.en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.fr: Or, puisque Dieu leur a accordé le même don qu''à nous qui avons cru au Seigneur Jésus-Christ, pouvais-je, moi, m''opposer à Dieu?
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ላመነው ለእኛ ደግሞ እንደ ሰጠን ያን ስጦታ ለእነርሱ ከሰጠ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ለመከልከል እችል ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነበርሁ?

verses.en: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu cela, ils se calmèrent, et ils glorifièrent Dieu, en disant: Dieu a donc accordé la repentance aussi aux païens, afin qu''ils aient la vie.
verses.am: ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜም ዝም አሉና። እንኪያስ እግዚአብሔር ለአሕዛብ ደግሞ ለሕይወት የሚሆን ንስሐን ሰጣቸው እያሉ እግዚአብሔርን አከበሩ።

verses.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient été dispersés par la persécution survenue à l''occasion d''Etienne allèrent jusqu''en Phénicie, dans l''île de Chypre, et à Antioche, annonçant la parole seulement aux Juifs.
verses.am: በእስጢፋኖስም ላይ በተደረገው መከራ የተበተኑት እስከ ፊንቄ እስከ ቆጵሮስም እስከ አንጾኪያም ድረስ ዞሩ፥ ቃሉንም ለአይሁድ ብቻ እንጂ ለአንድ ስንኳ አይናገሩም ነበር።

verses.en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: Il y eut cependant parmi eux quelques hommes de Chypre et de Cyrène, qui, étant venus à Antioche, s''adressèrent aussi aux Grecs, et leur annoncèrent la bonne nouvelle du Seigneur Jésus.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ግን የቆጵሮስና የቀሬና ሰዎች የነበሩት አንዳንዶቹ ወደ አንጾኪያ መጥተው የጌታን የኢየሱስን ወንጌል እየሰበኩ ለግሪክ ሰዎች ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.fr: La main du Seigneur était avec eux, et un grand nombre de personnes crurent et se convertirent au Seigneur.
verses.am: የጌታም እጅ ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ፤ ቍጥራቸውም እጅግ የሚሆን ሰዎች አምነው ወደ ጌታ ዘወር አሉ።

verses.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.fr: Le bruit en parvint aux oreilles des membres de l''Eglise de Jérusalem, et ils envoyèrent Barnabas jusqu''à Antioche.
verses.am: ወሬውም በኢየሩሳሌም ባለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስለ እነርሱ ተሰማ፥ በርናባስንም ወደ አንጾኪያ ላኩት፤

verses.en: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut arrivé, et qu''il eut vu la grâce de Dieu, il s''en réjouit, et il les exhorta tous à rester d''un coeur ferme attachés au Seigneur.
verses.am: እርሱም መጥቶ የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ባየ ጊዜ ደስ አለው፥ ሁሉንም በልባቸው ፈቃድ በጌታ ጸንተው ይኖሩ ዘንድ መከራቸው፤

verses.en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Car c''était un homme de bien, plein d''Esprit-Saint et de foi. Et une foule assez nombreuse se joignit au Seigneur.
verses.am: ደግ ሰውና መንፈስ ቅዱስ እምነትም የሞላበት ነበረና። ብዙ ሕዝብም ወደ ጌታ ተጨመሩ።

verses.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.fr: Barnabas se rendit ensuite à Tarse, pour chercher Saul;
verses.am: በርናባስም ሳውልን ሊፈልግ ወደ ጠርሴስ መጣ፤

verses.en: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.fr: et, l''ayant trouvé, il l''amena à Antioche. Pendant toute une année, ils se réunirent aux assemblées de l''Eglise, et ils enseignèrent beaucoup de personnes. Ce fut à Antioche que, pour la première fois, les disciples furent appelés chrétiens.
verses.am: ባገኘውም ጊዜ ወደ አንጾኪያ አመጣው። በቤተ ክርስቲያንም አንድ ዓመት ሙሉ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ብዙ ሕዝብንም አስተማሩ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርትም መጀመሪያ በአንጾኪያ ክርስቲያን ተባሉ።

verses.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, des prophètes descendirent de Jérusalem à Antioche.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ነቢያት ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረዱ፤

verses.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.fr: L''un d''eux, nommé Agabus, se leva, et annonça par l''Esprit qu''il y aurait une grande famine sur toute la terre. Elle arriva, en effet, sous Claude.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አጋቦስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ተነሥቶ በዓለም ሁሉ ታላቅ ራብ ሊሆን እንዳለው በመንፈስ አመለከተ፤ ይህም በቀላውዴዎስ ቄሣር ዘመን ሆነ።

verses.en: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.fr: Les disciples résolurent d''envoyer, chacun selon ses moyens, un secours aux frères qui habitaient la Judée.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርትም እያንዳንዳቸው እንደ ችሎታቸው መጠን አዋጥተው በይሁዳ ለሚኖሩት ወንድሞች እርዳታን ይልኩ ዘንድ ወሰኑ፤

verses.en: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.fr: Ils le firent parvenir aux anciens par les mains de Barnabas et de Saul.
verses.am: እንዲህም ደግሞ አደረጉ፥ በበርናባስና በሳውልም እጅ ወደ ሽማግሌዎቹ ሰደዱት።

verses.en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
verses.fr: Vers le même temps, le roi Hérode se mit à maltraiter quelques membres de l''Eglise,
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ንጉሡ ሄሮድስ መከራ ያጸናባቸው ዘንድ ከቤተ ክርስቲያኑ በአንዳንዶቹ ላይ እጁን ጫነባቸው።

verses.en: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.fr: et il fit mourir par l''épée Jacques, frère de Jean.
verses.am: የዮሐንስንም ወንድም ያዕቆብን በሰይፍ ገደለው።

verses.en: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
verses.fr: Voyant que cela était agréable aux Juifs, il fit encore arrêter Pierre. -C''était pendant les jours des pains sans levain. -
verses.am: አይሁድንም ደስ እንዳሰኛቸው አይቶ ጨምሮ ጴጥሮስን ደግሞ ያዘው። የቂጣ በዓልም ወራት ነበረ።

verses.en: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir saisi et jeté en prison, il le mit sous la garde de quatre escouades de quatre soldats chacune, avec l''intention de le faire comparaître devant le peuple après la Pâque.
verses.am: በያዘውም ጊዜ ወደ ወኅኒ አገባው ከፋሲካም በኋላ ወደ ሕዝብ ያወጣው ዘንድ አስቦ እያንዳንዱ አራት ወታደሮች ሆነው እንዲጠብቁት ለአራት ጭፍራ ክፍል አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

verses.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
verses.fr: Pierre donc était gardé dans la prison; et l''Eglise ne cessait d''adresser pour lui des prières à Dieu.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም በወኅኒ ይጠበቅ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በቤተ ክርስቲያን ስለ እርሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸሎት አጥብቆ ይደረግ ነበር።

verses.en: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
verses.fr: La nuit qui précéda le jour où Hérode allait le faire comparaître, Pierre, lié de deux chaînes, dormait entre deux soldats; et des sentinelles devant la porte gardaient la prison.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ሊያወጣው ባሰበ ጊዜ፥ በዚያች ሌሊት ጴጥሮስ በሁለት ሰንሰለት ታስሮ ከሁለት ወታደሮች መካከል ተኝቶ ነበር፤ ጠባቂዎችም በደጁ ፊት ሆነው ወኅኒውን ይጠብቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
verses.fr: Et voici, un ange du Seigneur survint, et une lumière brilla dans la prison. L''ange réveilla Pierre, en le frappant au côté, et en disant: Lève-toi promptement! Les chaînes tombèrent de ses mains.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የጌታ መልአክ ቀረበ በቤትም ውስጥ ብርሃን በራ፤ ጴጥሮስንም ጎድኑን መትቶ አነቃውና። ፈጥነህ ተነሣ አለው። ሰንሰለቶቹም ከእጁ ወደቁ።

verses.en: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
verses.fr: Et l''ange lui dit: Mets ta ceinture et tes sandales. Et il fit ainsi. L''ange lui dit encore: Enveloppe-toi de ton manteau, et suis-moi.
verses.am: መልአኩም። ታጠቅና ጫማህን አግባ አለው፥ እንዲሁም አደረገ።

verses.en: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
verses.fr: Pierre sortit, et le suivit, ne sachant pas que ce qui se faisait par l''ange fût réel, et s''imaginant avoir une vision.
verses.am: ልብስህንም ልበስና ተከተለኝ አለው። ወጥቶም ተከተለው፤ ራእይንም የሚያይ ይመስለው ነበር እንጂ በመልአኩ የሚደረገው ነገር እውነት እንደ ሆነ አላወቀም።

verses.en: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent passé la première garde, puis la seconde, ils arrivèrent à la porte de fer qui mène à la ville, et qui s''ouvrit d''elle-même devant eux; ils sortirent, et s''avancèrent dans une rue. Aussitôt l''ange quitta Pierre.
verses.am: የመጀመሪያውንና የሁለተኛውንም ዘብ አልፈው ወደ ከተማ ወደሚያወጣው ወደ ብረቱ መዝጊያ ደረሱ፤ እርሱም አውቆ ተከፈተላቸው፤ ወጥተውም አንዲት ስላች አለፉ ወዲያውም መልአኩ ከእርሱ ተለየ።

verses.en: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.fr: Revenu à lui-même, Pierre dit: Je vois maintenant d''une manière certaine que le Seigneur a envoyé son ange, et qu''il m''a délivré de la main d''Hérode et de tout ce que le peuple juif attendait.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ልቡ ተመልሶ። ጌታ መልአኩን ልኮ ከሄሮድስ እጅና የአይሁድ ሕዝብ ይጠብቁት ከነበረው ሁሉ እንደ አዳነኝ አሁን በእውነት አወቅሁ አለ።

verses.en: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
verses.fr: Après avoir réfléchi, il se dirigea vers la maison de Marie, mère de Jean, surnommé Marc, où beaucoup de personnes étaient réunies et priaient.
verses.am: ባስተዋለም ጊዜ እጅግ ሰዎች ተከማችተው ይጸልዩበት ወደ ነበረው ማርቆስ ወደ ተባለው ወደ ዮሐንስ እናት ወደ ማርያም ቤት መጣ።

verses.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
verses.fr: Il frappa à la porte du vestibule, et une servante, nommée Rhode, s''approcha pour écouter.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም የደጁን መዝጊያ ባንኳኳ ጊዜ ሮዴ የሚሉአት አንዲት ገረድ ትሰማ ዘንድ ቀረበች፤

verses.en: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
verses.fr: Elle reconnut la voix de Pierre; et, dans sa joie, au lieu d''ouvrir, elle courut annoncer que Pierre était devant la porte.
verses.am: የጴጥሮስ ድምፅ መሆኑንም ባወቀች ጊዜ ከደስታዋ የተነሣ ደጁን አልከፈተችም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ውስጥ ሮጣ ጴጥሮስ በደጅ ፊት ቆሞ እንዳለ አወራች።

verses.en: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Tu es folle. Mais elle affirma que la chose était ainsi. Et ils dirent: C''est son ange.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አብደሻል አሉአት። እርስዋ ግን እንዲሁ እንደ ሆነ ታስረግጥ ነበር። እነርሱም። መልአኩ ነው አሉ።

verses.en: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.fr: Cependant Pierre continuait à frapper. Ils ouvrirent, et furent étonnés de le voir.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን ማንኳኳቱን አዘወተረ፤ ከፍተውም አዩትና ተገረሙ።

verses.en: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
verses.fr: Pierre, leur ayant de la main fait signe de se taire, leur raconta comment le Seigneur l''avait tiré de la prison, et il dit: Annoncez-le à Jacques et aux frères. Puis il sortit, et s''en alla dans un autre lieu.
verses.am: ግን ዝም እንዲሉ በእጁ ጠቅሶ ጌታ ከወኅኒ እንዴት እንዳወጣው ተረከላቸውና። ይህን ለያዕቆብና ለወንድሞች ንገሩ አላቸው። ወጥቶም ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ ሄደ።

verses.en: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
verses.fr: Quand il fit jour, les soldats furent dans une grande agitation, pour savoir ce que Pierre était devenu.
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ። ጴጥሮስን ምን አግኝቶት ይሆን? ብለው በጭፍሮች ዘንድ ብዙ ሁከት ሆነ።

verses.en: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
verses.fr: Hérode, s''étant mis à sa recherche et ne l''ayant pas trouvé, interrogea les gardes, et donna l''ordre de les mener au supplice. Ensuite il descendit de la Judée à Césarée, pour y séjourner.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም አስፈልጎ ባጣው ጊዜ ጠባቂዎችን መረመረ ይገድሉአቸውም ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ ከይሁዳም ወደ ቂሣርያ ወርዶ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
verses.fr: Hérode avait des dispositions hostiles à l''égard des Tyriens et des Sidoniens. Mais ils vinrent le trouver d''un commun accord; et, après avoir gagné Blaste, son chambellan, ils sollicitèrent la paix, parce que leur pays tirait sa subsistance de celui du roi.
verses.am: ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ሰዎችም ጋር ተጣልቶ ነበር፤ በአንድ ልብ ሆነውም ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ የንጉሥንም ቢትወደድ ብላስጦስን እሺ አሰኝተው ዕርቅ ለመኑ፥ አገራቸው ከንጉሥ አገር ምግብ ያገኝ ነበረና።

verses.en: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.fr: A un jour fixé, Hérode, revêtu de ses habits royaux, et assis sur son trône, les harangua publiquement.
verses.am: በተቀጠረ ቀንም ሄሮድስ ልብሰ መንግሥቱን ለብሶ በዙፋን ተቀመጠ እነርሱንም ተናገራቸው፤

verses.en: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.fr: Le peuple s''écria: Voix d''un dieu, et non d''un homme!
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ነው የሰውም አይደለም ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.fr: Au même instant, un ange du Seigneur le frappa, parce qu''il n''avait pas donné gloire à Dieu. Et il expira, rongé des vers.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ስላልሰጠ ያን ጊዜ የጌታ መልአክ መታው በትልም ተበልቶ ሞተ።

verses.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.fr: Cependant la parole de Dieu se répandait de plus en plus, et le nombre des disciples augmentait.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን ያድግና ይበዛ ነበር።

verses.en: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.fr: Barnabas et Saul, après s''être acquittés de leur message, s''en retournèrent de Jérusalem, emmenant avec eux Jean, surnommé Marc.
verses.am: በርናባስና ሳውልም አገልግሎታቸውን ፈጽመው ከኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ ማርቆስ የተባለውን ዮሐንስንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይዘውት መጡ።

verses.en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.fr: Il y avait dans l''Eglise d''Antioche des prophètes et des docteurs: Barnabas, Siméon appelé Niger, Lucius de Cyrène, Manahen, qui avait été élevé avec Hérode le tétrarque, et Saul.
verses.am: በአንጾኪያም ባለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነቢያትና መምህራን ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም በርናባስ፥ ኔጌር የተባለው ስምዖንም፥ የቀሬናው ሉክዮስም፥ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ የሄሮድስም ባለምዋል ምናሔ፥ ሳውልም ነበሩ።

verses.en: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils servaient le Seigneur dans leur ministère et qu''ils jeûnaient, le Saint-Esprit dit: Mettez-moi à part Barnabas et Saul pour l''oeuvre à laquelle je les ai appelés.
verses.am: እነዚህም ጌታን ሲያመልኩና ሲጦሙ መንፈስ ቅዱስ። በርናባስንና ሳውልን ለጠራኋቸው ሥራ ለዩልኝ አለ።

verses.en: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.fr: Alors, après avoir jeûné et prié, ils leur imposèrent les mains, et les laissèrent partir.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ከጦሙ ከጸለዩም እጃቸውንም ከጫኑ በኋላ አሰናበቱአቸው።

verses.en: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.fr: Barnabas et Saul, envoyés par le Saint-Esprit, descendirent à Séleucie, et de là ils s''embarquèrent pour l''île de Chypre.
verses.am: እነርሱም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተልከው ወደ ሴሌውቅያ ወረዱ፤ ከዚያም በመርከብ ወደ ቆጵሮስ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
verses.fr: Arrivés à Salamine, ils annoncèrent la parole de Dieu dans les synagogues des Juifs. Ils avaient Jean pour aide.
verses.am: በስልማናም በነበሩ ጊዜ በአይሁድ ምኵራቦች የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰበኩ፤ አገልጋይም ዮሐንስ ነበራቸው።

verses.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
verses.fr: Ayant ensuite traversé toute l''île jusqu''à Paphos, ils trouvèrent un certain magicien, faux prophète juif, nommé Bar-Jésus,
verses.am: ደሴቲቱንም ሁሉ እስከ ጳፉ በዞሩ ጊዜ፥ በርያሱስ የሚሉትን ጠንቋይና ሐሰተኛ ነቢይ የሆነውን አንድ አይሁዳዊ ሰው አገኙ፤

verses.en: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.fr: qui était avec le proconsul Sergius Paulus, homme intelligent. Ce dernier fit appeler Barnabas et Saul, et manifesta le désir d''entendre la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱም አስተዋይ ሰው ከሆነው ሰርግዮስ ጳውሎስ ከሚባለው አገረ ገዥ ጋር ነበረ። ይህም በርናባስንና ሳውልን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሊሰማ ፈለገ።

verses.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.fr: Mais Elymas, le magicien, -car c''est ce que signifie son nom, -leur faisait opposition, cherchant à détourner de la foi le proconsul.
verses.am: ጠንቋዩ ግን ኤልማስ፥ ስሙ እንዲሁ ይተረጐማልና፥ አገረ ገዡን ከማመን ሊያጣምም ፈልጎ ተቃወማቸው።

verses.en: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him.
verses.fr: Alors Saul, appelé aussi Paul, rempli du Saint-Esprit, fixa les regards sur lui,
verses.am: ጳውሎስ የተባለው ሳውል ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተሞልቶ ትኵር ብሎ ሲመለከተው።

verses.en: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.fr: et dit: Homme plein de toute espèce de ruse et de fraude, fils du diable, ennemi de toute justice, ne cesseras-tu point de pervertir les voies droites du Seigneur?
verses.am: አንተ ተንኰል ሁሉ ክፋትም ሁሉ የሞላብህ፥ የዲያብሎስ ልጅ፥ የጽድቅም ሁሉ ጠላት፥ የቀናውን የጌታን መንገድ ከማጣመም አታርፍምን?

verses.en: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.fr: Maintenant voici, la main du Seigneur est sur toi, tu seras aveugle, et pour un temps tu ne verras pas le soleil. Aussitôt l''obscurité et les ténèbres tombèrent sur lui, et il cherchait, en tâtonnant, des personnes pour le guider.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ እጅ በአንተ ላይ ናት፥ ዕውርም ትሆናለህ እስከ ጊዜውም ፀሐይን አታይም አለው። ያን ጊዜም ጭጋግና ጨለማ ወደቀበት፥ በእጁም የሚመራውን እየዞረ ፈለገ።

verses.en: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
