verses.fr: Alors le proconsul, voyant ce qui était arrivé, crut, étant frappé de la doctrine du Seigneur.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አገረ ገዡ የተደረገውን ባየ ጊዜ ከጌታ ትምህርት የተነሣ ተገርሞ አመነ።

verses.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Paul et ses compagnons, s''étant embarqués à Paphos, se rendirent à Perge en Pamphylie. Jean se sépara d''eux, et retourna à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ከጓደኞቹ ጋር ከጳፉ ተነሥቶ የጵንፍልያ ወደምትሆን ወደ ጴርጌን መጣ፤ ዮሐንስም ከእነርሱ ተለይቶ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሰ።

verses.en: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.fr: De Perge ils poursuivirent leur route, et arrivèrent à Antioche de Pisidie. Etant entrés dans la synagogue le jour du sabbat, ils s''assirent.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ከጴርጌን አልፈው የጲስድያ ወደምትሆን ወደ አንጾኪያ ደረሱ፤ በሰንበትም ቀን ወደ ምኵራብ ገብተው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.fr: Après la lecture de la loi et des prophètes, les chefs de la synagogue leur envoyèrent dire: Hommes frères, si vous avez quelque exhortation à adresser au peuple, parlez.
verses.am: ሕግና ነቢያትም ከተነበቡ በኋላ የምኵራቡ አለቆች። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሕዝብን የሚመክር ቃል እንዳላችሁ ተናገሩ ብለው ላኩባቸው።

verses.en: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.fr: Paul se leva, et, ayant fait signe de la main, il dit: Hommes Israélites, et vous qui craignez Dieu, écoutez!
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ተነሣና በእጁ ጠቅሶ እንዲህ አለ። የእስራኤል ሰዎችና እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥ ስሙ።

verses.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.fr: Le Dieu de ce peuple d''Israël a choisi nos pères. Il mit ce peuple en honneur pendant son séjour au pays d''Egypte, et il l''en fit sortir par son bras puissant.
verses.am: የዚህ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ አምላክ አባቶቻችንን መርጦ በግብፅ አገር በእንግድነት ሳሉ ሕዝቡን ከፍ ከፍ አደረጋቸው፥ ከፍ ባለችውም ክንዱ ከዚያ አወጣቸው።

verses.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Il les nourrit près de quarante ans dans le désert;
verses.am: በበረሀም አርባ ዓመት ያህል መገባቸው።

verses.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.fr: et, ayant détruit sept nations au pays de Canaan, il leur en accorda le territoire comme propriété.
verses.am: በከነዓንም አገር ሰባት አሕዛብን አጥፍቶ ምድራቸውን አወረሳቸው።

verses.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.fr: Après cela, durant quatre cent cinquante ans environ, il leur donna des juges, jusqu''au prophète Samuel.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ እስከ ነቢዩ እስከ ሳሙኤል ድረስ አራት መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ያህል መሳፍንትን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.fr: Ils demandèrent alors un roi. Et Dieu leur donna, pendant quarante ans, Saül, fils de Kis, de la tribu de Benjamin;
verses.am: ከዚያም ወዲያ ንጉሥን ያነግሥላቸው ዘንድ ለመኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከብንያም ወገን የሚሆን ሰው የቂስን ልጅ ሳኦልን አርባ ዓመት ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave their testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.fr: puis, l''ayant rejeté, il leur suscita pour roi David, auquel il a rendu ce témoignage: J''ai trouvé David, fils d''Isaï, homme selon mon coeur, qui accomplira toutes mes volontés.
verses.am: እርሱንም ከሻረው በኋላ ዳዊትን በእነርሱ ላይ እንዲነግሥ አስነሣው፥ ሲመሰክርለትም። እንደ ልቤ የሆነ ሰው ፈቃዴንም ሁሉ የሚያደርግ የእሴይን ልጅ ዳዊትን አገኘሁ አለ።

verses.en: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.fr: C''est de la postérité de David que Dieu, selon sa promesse, a suscité à Israël un Sauveur, qui est Jésus.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሰው ዘር እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተስፋው ቃል ለእስራኤል መድኃኒትን እርሱም ኢየሱስን አመጣ።

verses.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.fr: Avant sa venue, Jean avait prêché le baptême de repentance à tout le peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: ከመምጣቱ በፊት ዮሐንስ አስቀድሞ ለእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ የንስሐን ጥምቀት ሰብኮ ነበር።

verses.en: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.fr: Et lorsque Jean achevait sa course, il disait: Je ne suis pas celui que vous pensez; mais voici, après moi vient celui des pieds duquel je ne suis pas digne de délier les souliers.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም ሩጫውን ሲፈጽም ሳለ። እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ታስባላችሁ? እኔስ እርሱን አይደለሁም፤ ነገር ግን እነሆ፥ የእግሩን ጫማ እፈታ ዘንድ ከማይገባኝ ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል ይል ነበር።

verses.en: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.fr: Hommes frères, fils de la race d''Abraham, et vous qui craignez Dieu, c''est à vous que cette parole de salut a été envoyée.
verses.am: እናንተ ወንድሞቻችን፥ የአብርሃም ዘር ልጆች ከእናንተ መካከልም እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሆይ፥ ለእናንተ የዚህ የመዳን ቃል ተላከ።

verses.en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.fr: Car les habitants de Jérusalem et leurs chefs ont méconnu Jésus, et, en le condamnant, ils ont accompli les paroles des prophètes qui se lisent chaque sabbat.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ ሰዎችና አለቆቻቸው እርሱንና በየሰንበቱ የሚነበቡትን የነቢያትን ድምፆች ስላላወቁ በፍርዳቸው ፈጽመዋልና፤

verses.en: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.fr: Quoiqu''ils ne trouvassent en lui rien qui fût digne de mort, ils ont demandé à Pilate de le faire mourir.
verses.am: ለሞትም የሚያደርስ ምክንያት አንድ ስንኳ ባያገኙበት፥ ይገድለው ዘንድ ጲላጦስን ለመኑት፤

verses.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.fr: Et, après qu''ils eurent accompli tout ce qui est écrit de lui, ils le descendirent de la croix et le déposèrent dans un sépulcre.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም የተጻፈውን ሁሉ በፈጸሙ ጊዜ ከእንጨት አውርደው በመቃብር አኖሩት።

verses.en: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.fr: Mais Dieu l''a ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሙታን አስነሣው፤

verses.en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.fr: Il est apparu pendant plusieurs jours à ceux qui étaient montés avec lui de la Galilée à Jérusalem, et qui sont maintenant ses témoins auprès du peuple.
verses.am: በሕዝብም ዘንድ ምስክሮቹ ለሆኑት ከእርሱ ጋር ከገሊላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለወጡት ብዙ ቀን ታያቸው።

verses.en: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.fr: Et nous, nous vous annonçons cette bonne nouvelle que la promesse faite à nos pères,
verses.am: እኛም ለአባቶች የተሰጠውን ተስፋ የምስራቹን ለእናንተ እንሰብካለን፤

verses.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.fr: Dieu l''a accomplie pour nous leurs enfants, en ressuscitant Jésus, selon ce qui est écrit dans le Psaume deuxième: Tu es mon Fils, Je t''ai engendré aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ይህን ተስፋ እግዚአብሔር በሁለተኛው መዝሙር ደግሞ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ እኔ ዛሬ ወለድሁህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ ኢየሱስን አስነሥቶ ለእኛ ለልጆቻቸው ፈጽሞአልና።

verses.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.fr: Qu''il l''ait ressuscité des morts, de telle sorte qu''il ne retournera pas à la corruption, c''est ce qu''il a déclaré, en disant: Je vous donnerai Les grâces saintes promises à David, ces grâces qui sont assurées.
verses.am: እንደገናም ወደ መበስበስ እንዳይመለስ ከሙታን እንደ አስነሣው፥ እንዲህ። የታመነውን የዳዊትን ቅዱስ ተስፋ እሰጣችኋለሁ ብሎአል።

verses.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi il dit encore ailleurs: Tu ne permettras pas que ton Saint voie la corruption.
verses.am: ደግሞ በሌላ ስፍራ። ቅዱስህን መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትሰጠውም ይላልና።

verses.en: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.fr: Or, David, après avoir en son temps servi au dessein de Dieu, est mort, a été réuni à ses pères, et a vu la corruption.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በራሱ ዘመን የእግዚአብሔርን አሳብ ካገለገለ በኋላ አንቀላፋ፥ ከአባቶቹም ጋር ተጨምሮ መበስበስን አየ፤

verses.en: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.fr: Mais celui que Dieu a ressuscité n''a pas vu la corruption.
verses.am: ይህ እግዚአብሔር ያስነሣው ግን መበስበስን አላየም።

verses.en: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.fr: Sachez donc, hommes frères, que c''est par lui que le pardon des péchés vous est annoncé,
verses.am: በወጡም ጊዜ ይህን ነገር በሚመጣው ሰንበት ይነግሩአቸው ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።

verses.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.fr: et que quiconque croit est justifié par lui de toutes les choses dont vous ne pouviez être justifiés par la loi de Moïse.
verses.am: በወጡም ጊዜ ይህን ነገር በሚመጣው ሰንበት ይነግሩአቸው ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።

verses.en: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.fr: Ainsi, prenez garde qu''il ne vous arrive ce qui est dit dans les prophètes:
verses.am: በወጡም ጊዜ ይህን ነገር በሚመጣው ሰንበት ይነግሩአቸው ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።

verses.en: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.fr: Voyez, contempteurs, Soyez étonnés et disparaissez; Car je vais faire en vos jours une oeuvre, Une oeuvre que vous ne croiriez pas si on vous la racontait.
verses.am: ጉባኤውም ከተፈታ በኋላ ከአይሁድና ወደ ይሁዲነት ገብተው ከሚያመልኩ ብዙዎች ጳውሎስንና በርናባስን ተከተሉአቸው፥ እነርሱም ሲነግሩአቸው በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ጸንተው እንዲኖሩ አስረዱአቸው።

verses.en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils sortirent, on les pria de parler le sabbat suivant sur les mêmes choses;
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ሰንበት ከጥቂቶቹ በቀር የከተማው ሰው ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይሰሙ ዘንድ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.fr: et, à l''issue de l''assemblée, beaucoup de Juifs et de prosélytes pieux suivirent Paul et Barnabas, qui s''entretinrent avec eux, et les exhortèrent à rester attachés à la grâce de Dieu.
verses.am: አይሁድም ብዙ ሕዝብ ባዩ ጊዜ ቅንዓት ሞላባቸው፥ እየተሳደቡም ጳውሎስ የተናገረውን ቃል ተቃወሙ።

verses.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.fr: Le sabbat suivant, presque toute la ville se rassembla pour entendre la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: ጳውሎስና በርናባስም ገልጠው። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል አስቀድሞ ለእናንተ ይነገር ዘንድ ያስፈልጋል፤ ከገፋችሁትና የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳይገባችሁ በራሳችሁ ከፈረዳችሁ ግን፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ አሕዛብ ዘወር እንላለን።

verses.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.fr: Les Juifs, voyant la foule, furent remplis de jalousie, et ils s''opposaient à ce que disait Paul, en le contredisant et en l''injuriant.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ጌታ። እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ለማዳን ትሆን ዘንድ ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን አድርጌሃለሁ ብሎ አዞናልና አሉ።

verses.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Paul et Barnabas leur dirent avec assurance: C''est à vous premièrement que la parole de Dieu devait être annoncée; mais, puisque vous la repoussez, et que vous vous jugez vous-mêmes indignes de la vie éternelle, voici, nous nous tournons vers les païens.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ሰምተው ደስ አላቸው የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል አከበሩ፥ ለዘላለም ሕይወትም የተዘጋጁ ሁሉ አመኑ፤

verses.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.fr: Car ainsi nous l''a ordonné le Seigneur: Je t''ai établi pour être la lumière des nations, Pour porter le salut jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: የጌታም ቃል በአገሩ ሁሉ ተስፋፋ።

verses.en: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.fr: Les païens se réjouissaient en entendant cela, ils glorifiaient la parole du Seigneur, et tous ceux qui étaient destinés à la vie éternelle crurent.
verses.am: አይሁድ ግን የሚያመልኩትን የከበሩትንም ሴቶችና የከተማውን መኳንንት አወኩ፥ በጳውሎስና በበርናባስም ላይ ስደትን አስነሥተው ከአገራቸው አወጡአቸው።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.fr: La parole du Seigneur se répandait dans tout le pays.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን የእግራቸውን ትቢያ አራግፈውባቸው ወደ ኢቆንዮን መጡ።

verses.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.fr: Mais les Juifs excitèrent les femmes dévotes de distinction et les principaux de la ville; ils provoquèrent une persécution contre Paul et Barnabas, et ils les chassèrent de leur territoire.
verses.am: በደቀ መዛሙርትም ደስታና መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው።

verses.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.fr: Paul et Barnabas secouèrent contre eux la poussière de leurs pieds, et allèrent à Icone,
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን የእግራቸውን ትቢያ አራግፈውባቸው ወደ ኢቆንዮን መጡ።

verses.en: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: tandis que les disciples étaient remplis de joie et du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: በደቀ መዛሙርትም ደስታና መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.fr: A Icone, Paul et Barnabas entrèrent ensemble dans la synagogue des Juifs, et ils parlèrent de telle manière qu''une grande multitude de Juifs et de Grecs crurent.
verses.am: በኢቆንዮንም እንደ ቀድሞ ወደ አይሁድ ምኵራብ ገብተው ከአይሁድና ከግሪክ ሰዎች ብዙ እስኪያምኑ ድረስ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.fr: Mais ceux des Juifs qui ne crurent point excitèrent et aigrirent les esprits des païens contre les frères.
verses.am: ያላመኑት አይሁድ ግን የአሕዛብን ልብ በወንድሞች ላይ አነሣሡ አስከፉም።

verses.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.fr: Ils restèrent cependant assez longtemps à Icone, parlant avec assurance, appuyés sur le Seigneur, qui rendait témoignage à la parole de sa grâce et permettait qu''il se fît par leurs mains des prodiges et des miracles.
verses.am: ምልክትና ድንቅ በእጃቸው ይደረግ ዘንድ እየሰጠ ለጸጋው ቃል ስለ መሰከረው ስለ ጌታ ገልጠው እየተናገሩ ረጅም ወራት ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.fr: La population de la ville se divisa: les uns étaient pour les Juifs, les autres pour les apôtres.
verses.am: የከተማውም ሕዝብ ተከፍለው እኵሌቶቹ ከአይሁድ እኵሌቶቹም ከሐዋርያት ጋር ሆኑ።

verses.en: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.fr: Et comme les païens et les Juifs, de concert avec leurs chefs, se mettaient en mouvement pour les outrager et les lapider,
verses.am: አሕዛብና አይሁድ ግን ከአለቆቻቸው ጋር ሊያንገላቱአቸውና ሊወግሩአቸው ባሰቡ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.fr: Paul et Barnabas, en ayant eu connaissance, se réfugièrent dans les villes de la Lycaonie, à Lystre et à Derbe, et dans la contrée d''alentour.
verses.am: አውቀው ልስጥራንና ደርቤን ወደሚባሉት ወደ ሊቃኦንያ ከተማዎች በእነርሱም ዙሪያ ወዳለው አገር ሸሹ፤

verses.en: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.fr: Et ils y annoncèrent la bonne nouvelle.
verses.am: በዚያም ወንጌልን ይሰብኩ ነበር።

verses.en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
verses.fr: A Lystre, se tenait assis un homme impotent des pieds, boiteux de naissance, et qui n''avait jamais marché.
verses.am: በልስጥራንም እግሩ የሰለለ፥ ከእናቱም ማኅፀን ጀምሮ አንካሳ የሆነ፥ ከቶም ሄዶ የማያውቅ አንድ ሰው ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.en: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.fr: Il écoutait parler Paul. Et Paul, fixant les regards sur lui et voyant qu''il avait la foi pour être guéri,
verses.am: ይህም ሰው ጳውሎስ ሲናገር ይሰማ ነበር፤ እርሱም ትኵር ብሎ ተመለከተውና ይድን ዘንድ እምነት እንዳለው ባየ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.fr: dit d''une voix forte: Lève-toi droit sur tes pieds. Et il se leva d''un bond et marcha.
verses.am: በታላቅ ድምፅ። ቀጥ ብለህ በእግርህ ቁም አለው። ብድግ ብሎም ተንሥቶ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.fr: A la vue de ce que Paul avait fait, la foule éleva la voix, et dit en langue lycaonienne: Les dieux sous une forme humaine sont descendus vers nous.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ጳውሎስ ያደረገውን ባዩ ጊዜ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው በሊቃኦንያ ቋንቋ። አማልክት ሰዎችን መስለው ወደ እኛ ወርደዋል አሉ፤

verses.en: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.fr: Ils appelaient Barnabas Jupiter, et Paul Mercure, parce que c''était lui qui portait la parole.
verses.am: በርናባስንም ድያ አሉት፤ ጳውሎስንም እርሱ በመናገር ዋና ስለ ነበረ ሄርሜን አሉት።

verses.en: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.fr: Le prêtre de Jupiter, dont le temple était à l''entrée de la ville, amena des taureaux avec des bandelettes vers les portes, et voulait, de même que la foule, offrir un sacrifice.
verses.am: በከተማውም ፊት ቤተ መቅደስ ያለው የድያ ካህን ኮርማዎችንና የአበባን አክሊሎች ወደ ደጃፍ አምጥቶ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ሆኖ ሊሠዋላቸው ወደደ።

verses.en: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.fr: Les apôtres Barnabas et Paul, ayant appris cela, déchirèrent leurs vêtements, et se précipitèrent au milieu de la foule,
verses.am: ሐዋርያት በርናባስና ጳውሎስ ግን ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ልብሳቸውን ቀደው ወደ ሕዝቡ መካከል እየጮኹ ሮጡ፥

verses.en: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.fr: en s''écriant: O hommes, pourquoi agissez-vous de la sorte? Nous aussi, nous sommes des hommes de la même nature que vous; et, vous apportant une bonne nouvelle, nous vous exhortons à renoncer à ces choses vaines, pour vous tourner vers le Dieu vivant, qui a fait le ciel, la terre, la mer, et tout ce qui s''y trouve.
verses.am: እንዲህም አሉ። እናንተ ሰዎች፥ ይህን ስለ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? እኛ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ የምንሰማ ሰዎች ነን፥ ከዚህም ከንቱ ነገር ሰማይንና ምድርን ባሕርንም በእነርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ወደ ፈጠረ ወደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ዘወር ትሉ ዘንድ ወንጌልን እንሰብካለን።

verses.en: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.fr: Ce Dieu, dans les âges passés, a laissé toutes les nations suivre leurs propres voies,
verses.am: እርሱ ባለፉት ትውልዶች አሕዛብን ሁሉ በገዛ ራሳቸው ጐዳና ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተዋቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.fr: quoiqu''il n''ait cessé de rendre témoignage de ce qu''il est, en faisant du bien, en vous dispensant du ciel les pluies et les saisons fertiles, en vous donnant la nourriture avec abondance et en remplissant vos coeurs de joie.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር መልካም ሥራ እየሠራ፥ ከሰማይ ዝናብን ፍሬ የሚሆንበትንም ወራት ሲሰጠን፥ ልባችንንም በመብልና በደስታ ሲሞላው ራሱን ያለ ምስክር አልተወም።

verses.en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.fr: A peine purent-ils, par ces paroles, empêcher la foule de leur offrir un sacrifice.
verses.am: ይህንም ብለው እንዳይሠዉላቸው ሕዝቡን በጭንቅ አስተዉአቸው።

verses.en: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.fr: Alors survinrent d''Antioche et d''Icone des Juifs qui gagnèrent la foule, et qui, après avoir lapidé Paul, le traînèrent hors de la ville, pensant qu''il était mort.
verses.am: አይሁድ ግን ከአንጾኪያና ከኢቆንዮን መጡ፤ ሕዝቡንም አባብለው ጳውሎስን ወገሩ የሞተም መስሎአቸው ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ ጐተቱት።

verses.en: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.fr: Mais, les disciples l''ayant entouré, il se leva, et entra dans la ville. Le lendemain, il partit pour Derbe avec Barnabas.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ከበውት ሳሉ፥ ተነስቶ ወደ ከተማ ገባ። በነገውም ከበርናባስ ጋር ወደ ደርቤን ወጣ።

verses.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.fr: Quand ils eurent évangélisé cette ville et fait un certain nombre de disciples, ils retournèrent à Lystre, à Icone et à Antioche,
verses.am: በየቤተ ክርስቲያኑም ሽማግሌዎችን ከሾሙላቸው በኋላ ጦመውም ከጸለዩ በኋላ፥ ላመኑበት ለጌታ አደራ ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: fortifiant l''esprit des disciples, les exhortant à persévérer dans la foi, et disant que c''est par beaucoup de tribulations qu''il nous faut entrer dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: በየቤተ ክርስቲያኑም ሽማግሌዎችን ከሾሙላቸው በኋላ ጦመውም ከጸለዩ በኋላ፥ ላመኑበት ለጌታ አደራ ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.fr: Ils firent nommer des anciens dans chaque Eglise, et, après avoir prié et jeûné, ils les recommandèrent au Seigneur, en qui ils avaient cru.
verses.am: በጲስድያም አልፈው ወደ ጵንፍልያ መጡ፥

verses.en: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.fr: Traversant ensuite la Pisidie, ils vinrent en Pamphylie,
verses.am: በጴርጌንም ቃሉን ከተናገሩ በኋላ ወደ አጣልያ ወረዱ፥

verses.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.fr: annoncèrent la parole à Perge, et descendirent à Attalie.
verses.am: ከዚያም ስለ ፈጸሙት ሥራ ለእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ አደራ ወደ ተሰጡበት ወደ አንጾኪያ በመርከብ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.fr: De là ils s''embarquèrent pour Antioche, d''où ils avaient été recommandés à la grâce de Dieu pour l''oeuvre qu''ils venaient d''accomplir.
verses.am: በደረሱም ጊዜ ቤተ ክርስቲያኑን ሰብስበው እግዚአብሔር ከእነርሱ ጋር ያደረገውን ሁሉ ለአሕዛብም የሃይማኖትን ደጅ እንደ ከፈተላቸው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Après leur arrivée, ils convoquèrent l''Eglise, et ils racontèrent tout ce que Dieu avait fait avec eux, et comment il avait ouvert aux nations la porte de la foi.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርትም ጋር አያሌ ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.fr: Et ils demeurèrent assez longtemps avec les disciples.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርትም ጋር አያሌ ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.fr: Quelques hommes, venus de la Judée, enseignaient les frères, en disant: Si vous n''êtes circoncis selon le rite de Moïse, vous ne pouvez être sauvés.
verses.am: አንዳንዶችም ከይሁዳ ወረዱና። እንደ ሙሴ ሥርዓት ካልተገረዛችሁ ትድኑ ዘንድ አትችሉም ብለው ወንድሞችን ያስተምሩ ነበር።

verses.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.fr: Paul et Barnabas eurent avec eux un débat et une vive discussion; et les frères décidèrent que Paul et Barnabas, et quelques-uns des leurs, monteraient à Jérusalem vers les apôtres et les anciens, pour traiter cette question.
verses.am: በእነርሱና በጳውሎስ በበርናባስም መካከል ብዙ ጥልና ክርክር በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ስለዚህ ክርክር ጳውሎና በርናባስ ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶች ሌሎች ሰዎች ወደ ሐዋርያት ወደ ሽማግሌዎችም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይወጡ ዘንድ ተቈረጠ።

verses.en: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.fr: Après avoir été accompagnés par l''Eglise, ils poursuivirent leur route à travers la Phénicie et la Samarie, racontant la conversion des païens, et ils causèrent une grande joie à tous les frères.
verses.am: ቤተ ክርስቲያኑም በመንገድ እየረዳቸው እነርሱ የአሕዛብን መመለስ እየተረኩ በፊንቄና በሰማርያ አለፉ፥ ወንድሞችንም ሁሉ እጅግ ደስ አሰኙአቸው።

verses.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.fr: Arrivés à Jérusalem, ils furent reçus par l''Eglise, les apôtres et les anciens, et ils racontèrent tout ce que Dieu avait fait avec eux.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም በደረሱ ጊዜ ቤተ ክርስቲያንና ሐዋርያት ሽማግሌዎችም ተቀበሉአቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ያደረገውን ሁሉ አወሩ።

verses.en: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.fr: Alors quelques-uns du parti des pharisiens, qui avaient cru, se levèrent, en disant qu''il fallait circoncire les païens et exiger l''observation de la loi de Moïse.
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያን ወገን ግን ያመኑት አንዳንዶቹ ተነሥተው። ትገርዙአቸው ዘንድና የሙሴን ሕግ እንዲጠብቁ ታዙአቸው ዘንድ ይገባል አሉ።

verses.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.fr: Les apôtres et les anciens se réunirent pour examiner cette affaire.
verses.am: ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎችም ስለዚህ ነገር ለመማከር ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.fr: Une grande discussion s''étant engagée, Pierre se leva, et leur dit: Hommes frères, vous savez que dès longtemps Dieu a fait un choix parmi vous, afin que, par ma bouche, les païens entendissent la parole de l''Evangile et qu''ils crussent.
verses.am: ከብዙ ክርክርም በኋላ ጴጥሮስ ተነሥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ አሕዛብ ከአፌ የወንጌልን ቃል ሰምተው ያምኑ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር በመጀመሪያው ዘመን ከእናንተ እኔን እንደ መረጠኝ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
verses.fr: Et Dieu, qui connaît les coeurs, leur a rendu témoignage, en leur donnant le Saint-Esprit comme à nous;
verses.am: ልብንም የሚያውቅ አምላክ ለእኛ ደግሞ እንደ ሰጠን መንፈስ ቅዱስን በመስጠት መሰከረላቸው፤

verses.en: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.fr: il n''a fait aucune différence entre nous et eux, ayant purifié leurs coeurs par la foi.
verses.am: ልባቸውንም በእምነት ሲያነጻ በእኛና በእነርሱ መካከል አንዳች አልለየም።

verses.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.fr: Maintenant donc, pourquoi tentez-vous Dieu, en mettant sur le cou des disciples un joug que ni nos pères ni nous n''avons pu porter?
verses.am: እንግዲህ አባቶቻችንና እኛ ልንሸከመው ያልቻልነውን ቀንበር በደቀ መዛሙርት ጫንቃ ላይ በመጫን እግዚአብሔርን አሁን ስለ ምን ትፈታተናላችሁ?

verses.en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.fr: Mais c''est par la grâce du Seigneur Jésus que nous croyons être sauvés, de la même manière qu''eux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ እንደ እነርሱ ደግሞ እንድን ዘንድ እናምናለን።

verses.en: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée garda le silence, et l''on écouta Barnabas et Paul, qui racontèrent tous les miracles et les prodiges que Dieu avait faits par eux au milieu des païens.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዝም አሉ፥ በርናባስና ጳውሎስም እግዚአብሔር በእጃቸው በአሕዛብ መካከል ያደረገውን ምልክትና ድንቅ ሁሉ ሲተርኩላቸው ይሰሙ ነበር።

verses.en: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent cessé de parler, Jacques prit la parole, et dit: Hommes frères, écoutez-moi!
verses.am: እነርሱም ዝም ካሉ በኋላ ያዕቆብ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ።

verses.en: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.fr: Simon a raconté comment Dieu a d''abord jeté les regards sur les nations pour choisir du milieu d''elles un peuple qui portât son nom.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለስሙ የሚሆንን ወገን ከአሕዛብ ይወስድ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ እንዴት እንደ ጐበኘ ስምዖን ተርኮአል።

verses.en: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.fr: Et avec cela s''accordent les paroles des prophètes, selon qu''il est écrit:
verses.am: ከዚህም ጋር የነቢያት ቃል ይሰማማል፥ እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.en: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.fr: Après cela, je reviendrai, et je relèverai de sa chute la tente de David, J''en réparerai les ruines, et je la redresserai,
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ሥራው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታወቀ ነው።

verses.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.fr: Afin que le reste des hommes cherche le Seigneur, Ainsi que toutes les nations sur lesquelles mon nom est invoqué, Dit le Seigneur, qui fait ces choses,
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ሥራው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታወቀ ነው።

verses.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.fr: Et à qui elles sont connues de toute éternité.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከአሕዛብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የዞሩትን እንዳናስቸግራቸው፥

verses.en: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je suis d''avis qu''on ne crée pas des difficultés à ceux des païens qui se convertissent à Dieu,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከጣዖት ርኵሰትና ከዝሙት ከታነቀም ከደምም ይርቁ ዘንድ እንድንጽፍላቸው እቈርጣለሁ።

verses.en: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
verses.fr: mais qu''on leur écrive de s''abstenir des souillures des idoles, de l''impudicité, des animaux étouffés et du sang.
verses.am: ሙሴስ ከቀደሙት ትውልድ ጀምሮ በሰንበት በሰንበት በምኵራቦቹ ሲያነቡ በየከተማው እርሱን የሚሰብኩ አሉት።

verses.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.fr: Car, depuis bien des générations, Moïse a dans chaque ville des gens qui le prêchent, puisqu''on le lit tous les jours de sabbat dans les synagogues.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች ከቤተ ክርስቲያኑ ሁሉ ጋር ከእነርሱ የተመረጡትን ሰዎች ከጳውሎስና ከበርናባስ ጋር ወደ አንጾኪያ ይልኩ ዘንድ ፈቀዱ፤ እነርሱም በወንድሞች መካከል ዋናዎች ሆነው በርስያን የተባለው ይሁዳና ሲላስ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.fr: Alors il parut bon aux apôtres et aux anciens, et à toute l''Eglise, de choisir parmi eux et d''envoyer à Antioche, avec Paul et Barnabas, Jude appelé Barsabas et Silas, hommes considérés entre les frères.
verses.am: እንዲህም ጽፈው በእነርሱ እጅ ላኩ። ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች ወንድሞችም በአንጾኪያና በሶርያ በኪልቅያም ለሚኖሩ ከአሕዛብ ወገን ለሆኑ ወንድሞች ሰላምታ ያቀርባሉ።

verses.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.
verses.fr: Ils les chargèrent d''une lettre ainsi conçue: Les apôtres, les anciens, et les frères, aux frères d''entre les païens, qui sont à Antioche, en Syrie, et en Cilicie, salut!
verses.am: ያላዘዝናቸው ሰዎች ከእኛ ወጥተው። ትገረዙ ዘንድና ሕግን ትጠብቁ ዘንድ ይገባችኋል ብለው ልባችሁን እያወኩ በቃል እንዳናወጡአችሁ ስለ ሰማን፥

verses.en: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
verses.fr: Ayant appris que quelques hommes partis de chez nous, et auxquels nous n''avions donné aucun ordre, vous ont troublés par leurs discours et ont ébranlé vos âmes,
verses.am: ራሳቸውም ደግሞ በቃላቸው ያንኑ ይነግሩአችሁ ዘንድ ይሁዳንና ሲላስን ልከናል።

verses.en: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.fr: nous avons jugé à propos, après nous être réunis tous ensemble, de choisir des délégués et de vous les envoyer avec nos bien-aimés Barnabas et Paul,
verses.am: ራሳቸውም ደግሞ በቃላቸው ያንኑ ይነግሩአችሁ ዘንድ ይሁዳንና ሲላስን ልከናል።

verses.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: ces hommes qui ont exposé leur vie pour le nom de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እነርሱም ተሰናብተው ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረዱ፥ ሕዝቡንም ሰብስበው ደብዳቤውን ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
verses.fr: Nous avons donc envoyé Jude et Silas, qui vous annonceront de leur bouche les mêmes choses.
verses.am: እነርሱም ተሰናብተው ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረዱ፥ ሕዝቡንም ሰብስበው ደብዳቤውን ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.fr: Car il a paru bon au Saint-Esprit et à nous de ne vous imposer d''autre charge que ce qui est nécessaire,
verses.am: ባነበቡትም ጊዜ ከምክሩ የተነሣ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
verses.fr: savoir, de vous abstenir des viandes sacrifiées aux idoles, du sang, des animaux étouffés, et de l''impudicité, choses contre lesquelles vous vous trouverez bien de vous tenir en garde. Adieu.
verses.am: ይሁዳና ሲላስም ደግሞ ነቢያት ነበሩና ወንድሞችን በብዙ ቃል መክረው አጸኑአቸው።

verses.en: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.fr: Eux donc, ayant pris congé de l''Eglise, allèrent à Antioche, où ils remirent la lettre à la multitude assemblée.
verses.am: አያሌ ቀንም ከተቀመጡ በኋላ ከወንድሞች በሰላም ተሰናብተው ወደ ሐዋርያት ሄዱ።

verses.en: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir lue, les frères furent réjouis de l''encouragement qu''elle leur apportait.
verses.am: ሲላስ ግን በዚያ ይኖር ዘንድ ፈቀደ።

verses.en: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.fr: Jude et Silas, qui étaient eux-mêmes prophètes, les exhortèrent et les fortifièrent par plusieurs discours.
verses.am: ጳውሎስና በርናባስም ከሌሎች ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋር ደግሞ የጌታን ቃል እያስተማሩና ወንጌልን እየሰበኩ በአንጾኪያ ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.fr: Au bout de quelque temps, les frères les laissèrent en paix retourner vers ceux qui les avaient envoyés.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ጳውሎስ በርናባስን። ተመልሰን የጌታን ቃል በተናገርንበት በየከተማው ሁሉ ወንድሞችን እንጐብኛቸው፥ እንዴት እንዳሉም እንወቅ አለው።

verses.en: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.fr: Toutefois Silas trouva bon de rester.
verses.am: በርናባስም ማርቆስ የተባለውን ዮሐንስን ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይወስድ ዘንድ አሰበ፤

verses.en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.fr: Paul et Barnabas demeurèrent à Antioche, enseignant et annonçant, avec plusieurs autres, la bonne nouvelle de la parole du Seigneur.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን ይህን ከእነርሱ ጋር ሊወስድ አልፈቀደም፥ ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ከጵንፍልያ ተለይቶ ነበርና፥ ወደ ሥራም ከእነርሱ ጋር አልመጣም ነበርና።

verses.en: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
verses.fr: Quelques jours s''écoulèrent, après lesquels Paul dit à Barnabas: Retournons visiter les frères dans toutes les villes où nous avons annoncé la parole du Seigneur, pour voir en quel état ils sont.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እርስ በርሳቸው እስኪለያዩ ድረስ መከፋፋት ሆነ፥ በርናባስም ማርቆስን ይዞ በመርከብ ወደ ቆጵሮስ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.fr: Barnabas voulait emmener aussi Jean, surnommé Marc;
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን ሲላስን መረጠ፥ ወንድሞችም ለእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ አደራ ከሰጡት በኋላ ወጣ፤

verses.en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.fr: mais Paul jugea plus convenable de ne pas prendre avec eux celui qui les avait quittés depuis la Pamphylie, et qui ne les avait point accompagnés dans leur oeuvre.
verses.am: አብያተ ክርስትያናትንም እያጸና በሶርያና በኪልቅያ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verses.fr: Ce dissentiment fut assez vif pour être cause qu''ils se séparèrent l''un de l''autre. Et Barnabas, prenant Marc avec lui, s''embarqua pour l''île de Chypre.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እርስ በርሳቸው እስኪለያዩ ድረስ መከፋፋት ሆነ፥ በርናባስም ማርቆስን ይዞ በመርከብ ወደ ቆጵሮስ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
verses.fr: Paul fit choix de Silas, et partit, recommandé par les frères à la grâce du Seigneur.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን ሲላስን መረጠ፥ ወንድሞችም ለእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ አደራ ከሰጡት በኋላ ወጣ፤

verses.en: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.fr: Il parcourut la Syrie et la Cilicie, fortifiant les Eglises.
verses.am: አብያተ ክርስትያናትንም እያጸና በሶርያና በኪልቅያ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
verses.fr: Il se rendit ensuite à Derbe et à Lystre. Et voici, il y avait là un disciple nommé Timothée, fils d''une femme juive fidèle et d''un père grec.
verses.am: ወደ ደርቤንና ወደ ልስጥራንም ደረሰ። እነሆም፥ በዚያ የአንዲት ያመነች አይሁዳዊት ልጅ ጢሞቴዎስ የሚባል አንድ ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረ፤ አባቱ ግን የግሪክ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.fr: Les frères de Lystre et d''Icone rendaient de lui un bon témoignage.
verses.am: ለእርሱም በልስጥራንና በኢቆንዮን ያሉ ወንድሞች መሰከሩለት።

verses.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
verses.fr: Paul voulut l''emmener avec lui; et, l''ayant pris, il le circoncit, à cause des Juifs qui étaient dans ces lieux-là, car tous savaient que son père était grec.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ይህ ከእርሱ ጋር ይወጣ ዘንድ ወደደ፥ በእነዚያም ስፍራዎች ስለ ነበሩ አይሁድ ይዞ ገረዘው፤ አባቱ የግሪክ ሰው እንደ ሆነ ሁሉ ያውቁ ነበርና።

verses.en: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: En passant par les villes, ils recommandaient aux frères d''observer les décisions des apôtres et des anciens de Jérusalem.
verses.am: በከተማዎችም ሲዞሩ በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩት ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች የቈረጡትን ሥርዓት ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.fr: Les Eglises se fortifiaient dans la foi, et augmentaient en nombre de jour en jour.
verses.am: አብያተ ክርስቲያናትም በሃያማኖት ይበረቱ ነበር፥ በቍጥርም ዕለት ዕለት ይበዙ ነበር።

verses.en: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
verses.fr: Ayant été empêchés par le Saint-Esprit d''annoncer la parole dans l''Asie, ils traversèrent la Phrygie et le pays de Galatie.
verses.am: በእስያም ቃሉን እንዳይናገሩ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ስለ ከለከላቸው በፍርግያና በገላትያ አገር አለፉ፤

verses.en: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
verses.fr: Arrivés près de la Mysie, ils se disposaient à entrer en Bithynie; mais l''Esprit de Jésus ne le leur permit pas.
verses.am: በሚስያም አንጻር በደረሱ ጊዜ ወደ ቢታንያ ይሄዱ ዘድን ሞከሩ፥ የኢየሱስ መንፈስም አልፈቀደላቸውም፤

verses.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
verses.fr: Ils franchirent alors la Mysie, et descendirent à Troas.
verses.am: በሚስያም አጠገብ አልፈው ወደ ጢሮአዳ ወረዱ።

verses.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.fr: Pendant la nuit, Paul eut une vision: un Macédonien lui apparut, et lui fit cette prière: Passe en Macédoine, secours-nous!
verses.am: ራእይም ለጳውሎስ በሌሊት ታየው፤ አንድ የመቄዶንያ ሰው። ወደ መቄዶንያ ተሻገርና እርዳን እያለ ቆሞ ሲለምነው ነበር።

verses.en: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
verses.fr: Après cette vision de Paul, nous cherchâmes aussitôt à nous rendre en Macédoine, concluant que le Seigneur nous appelait à y annoncer la bonne nouvelle.
verses.am: ራእዩንም ካየ በኋላ ወዲያው ወደ መቄዶንያ ልንወጣ ፈለግን፥ ወንጌልን እንሰብክላቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጠራን መስሎናልና።

verses.en: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
verses.fr: Etant partis de Troas, nous fîmes voile directement vers la Samothrace, et le lendemain nous débarquâmes à Néapolis.
verses.am: ከጢሮአዳም ተነሥተን በቀጥታ ወደ ሳሞትራቄ በነገውም ወደ ናጱሌ በመርከብ ሄድን፤

verses.en: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
verses.fr: De là nous allâmes à Philippes, qui est la première ville d''un district de Macédoine, et une colonie. Nous passâmes quelques jours dans cette ville.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ፊልጵስዩስ ደረስን፤ እርስዋም የመቄዶንያ ከተማ ሆና የወረዳ ዋና ከተማና ቅኝ አገር ናት፤ በዚህችም ከተማ አንዳንድ ቀን እንቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
verses.fr: Le jour du sabbat, nous nous rendîmes, hors de la porte, vers une rivière, où nous pensions que se trouvait un lieu de prière. Nous nous assîmes, et nous parlâmes aux femmes qui étaient réunies.
verses.am: በሰንበት ቀንም ከከተማው በር ውጭ የጸሎት ስፍራ በዚያ መሆኑን ስላሰብን ወደ ወንዝ አጠገብ ወጣን፤ ተቀምጠንም ለተሰበሰቡት ሴቶች ተናገርን።

verses.en: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verses.fr: L''une d''elles, nommée Lydie, marchande de pourpre, de la ville de Thyatire, était une femme craignant Dieu, et elle écoutait. Le Seigneur lui ouvrit le coeur, pour qu''elle fût attentive à ce que disait Paul.
verses.am: ከትያጥሮን ከተማም የመጣች ቀይ ሐር ሻጭ እግዚአብሔርን የምታመልክ ልድያ የሚሉአት አንዲት ሴት ትሰማ ነበረች፤ ጳውሎስም የሚናገረውን ታዳምጥ ዘንድ ጌታ ልብዋን ከፈተላት።

verses.en: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle eut été baptisée, avec sa famille, elle nous fit cette demande: Si vous me jugez fidèle au Seigneur, entrez dans ma maison, et demeurez-y. Et elle nous pressa par ses instances.
verses.am: እርስዋም ከቤተ ሰዎችዋ ጋር ከተጠመቀች በኋላ። በጌታ የማምን እንድሆን ከፈረዳችሁልኝ፥ ወደ ቤቴ ገብታችሁ ኑሩ ብላ ለመነችን፤ በግድም አለችን።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
verses.fr: Comme nous allions au lieu de prière, une servante qui avait un esprit de Python, et qui, en devinant, procurait un grand profit à ses maîtres, vint au-devant de nous,
verses.am: ወደ ጸሎት ስፍራም ስንሄድ፥ የምዋርተኝነት መንፈስ የነበረባት ለጌቶችዋም እየጠነቈለች ብዙ ትርፍ ታመጣ የነበረች አንዲት ገረድ አገኘችን።

verses.en: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
verses.fr: et se mit à nous suivre, Paul et nous. Elle criait: Ces hommes sont les serviteurs du Dieu Très-Haut, et ils vous annoncent la voie du salut.
verses.am: እርስዋ ጳውሎስንና እኛን እየተከተለች። የመዳንን መንገድ የሚነግሩአችሁ እነዚህ ሰዎች የልዑል አምላክ ባሪያዎች ናቸው ብላ ትጮኽ ነበር።

verses.en: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
verses.fr: Elle fit cela pendant plusieurs jours. Paul fatigué se retourna, et dit à l''esprit: Je t''ordonne, au nom de Jésus-Christ, de sortir d''elle. Et il sortit à l''heure même.
verses.am: ይህንም እጅግ ቀን አደረገች። ጳውሎስ ግን ተቸገረና ዘወር ብሎ መንፈሱን። ከእርስዋ እንድትወጣ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም አዝሃለሁ አለው፤ በዚያም ሰዓት ወጣ።

verses.en: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
verses.fr: Les maîtres de la servante, voyant disparaître l''espoir de leur gain, se saisirent de Paul et de Silas, et les traînèrent sur la place publique devant les magistrats.
verses.am: ጌቶችዋም የትርፋቸው ተስፋ እንደ ወጣ ባዩ ጊዜ ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን ይዘው ወደ ገበያ በሹማምት ፊት ጐተቱአቸው፤

verses.en: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
verses.fr: Ils les présentèrent aux préteurs, en disant: Ces hommes troublent notre ville; ce sont des Juifs,
verses.am: ወደ ገዢዎችም አቅርበው። እነዚህ ሰዎች አይሁድ ሆነው ከተማችንን እጅግ ያናውጣሉ።

verses.en: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
verses.fr: qui annoncent des coutumes qu''il ne nous est permis ni de recevoir ni de suivre, à nous qui sommes Romains.
verses.am: እኛም የሮሜ ሰዎች ሆነን እንቀበላቸውና እናደርጋቸው ዘንድ ያልተፈቀደልንን ልማዶች ይናገራሉ አሉ።

verses.en: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
verses.fr: La foule se souleva aussi contre eux, et les préteurs, ayant fait arracher leurs vêtements, ordonnèrent qu''on les battît de verges.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም አብረው ተነሡባቸው፥ ገዢዎቹም ልብሳቸውን ገፈው በበትር ይመቱአቸው ዘንድ አዘዙ፤

verses.en: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
verses.fr: Après qu''on les eut chargés de coups, ils les jetèrent en prison, en recommandant au geôlier de les garder sûrement.
verses.am: በብዙም ከደበደቡአቸው በኋላ ወደ ወኅኒ ጣሉአቸው፥ የወኅኒውንም ጠባቂ ተጠንቅቆ እንዲጠብቃቸው አዘዙት።

verses.en: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
verses.fr: Le geôlier, ayant reçu cet ordre, les jeta dans la prison intérieure, et leur mit les ceps aux pieds.
verses.am: እርሱም የዚህን ዓይነት ትእዛዝ ተቀብሎ ወደ ውስጠኛው ወኅኒ ጣላቸው፥ እግራቸውንም በግንድ አጣብቆ ጠረቃቸው።

verses.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verses.fr: Vers le milieu de la nuit, Paul et Silas priaient et chantaient les louanges de Dieu, et les prisonniers les entendaient.
verses.am: በመንፈቀ ሌሊት ግን ጳውሎስና ሲላስ እየጸለዩ እግዚአብሔርን በዜማ ያመሰግኑ ነበር፥ እስረኞቹም ያደምጡአቸው ነበር

verses.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
verses.fr: Tout à coup il se fit un grand tremblement de terre, en sorte que les fondements de la prison furent ébranlés; au même instant, toutes les portes s''ouvrirent, et les liens de tous les prisonniers furent rompus.
verses.am: ድንገትም የወኅኒው መሠረት እስኪናወጥ ድረስ ታላቅ የምድር መንቀጥቀጥ ሆነ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ደጆቹ ሁሉ ተከፈቱ የሁሉም እስራት ተፈታ።

verses.en: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
verses.fr: Le geôlier se réveilla, et, lorsqu''il vit les portes de la prison ouvertes, il tira son épée et allait se tuer, pensant que les prisonniers s''étaient enfuis.
verses.am: የወኅኒውም ጠባቂ ከእንቅልፉ ነቅቶ የወኅኒው ደጆች ተከፍተው ባየ ጊዜ፥ እስረኞቹ ያመለጡ መስሎት ራሱን ይገድል ዘንድ አስቦ ሰይፉን መዘዘ።

verses.en: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
verses.fr: Mais Paul cria d''une voix forte: Ne te fais point de mal, nous sommes tous ici.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን በታላቅ ድምፅ። ሁላችን ከዚህ አለንና በራስህ ክፉ ነገር አታድርግ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
verses.fr: Alors le geôlier, ayant demandé de la lumière, entra précipitamment, et se jeta tout tremblant aux pieds de Paul et de Silas;
verses.am: መብራትም ለምኖ ወደ ውስጥ ሮጠ፥ እየተንቀጠቀጠም ከጳውሎስና ከሲላስ ፊት ተደፋ፤

verses.en: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
verses.fr: il les fit sortir, et dit: Seigneurs, que faut-il que je fasse pour être sauvé?
verses.am: ወደ ውጭም አውጥቶ። ጌቶች ሆይ፥ እድን ዘንድ ምን ማድረግ ይገባኛል? ኣላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
verses.fr: Paul et Silas répondirent: Crois au Seigneur Jésus, et tu seras sauvé, toi et ta famille.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እመን አንተና ቤተ ሰዎችህ ትድናላችሁ አሉት።

verses.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
verses.fr: Et ils lui annoncèrent la parole du Seigneur, ainsi qu''à tous ceux qui étaient dans sa maison.
verses.am: ለእርሱና በቤቱም ላሉት ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
verses.fr: Il les prit avec lui, à cette heure même de la nuit, il lava leurs plaies, et aussitôt il fut baptisé, lui et tous les siens.
verses.am: በሌሊትም በዚያች ሰዓት ወስዶ ቍስላቸውን አጠበላቸው፥ ያን ጊዜውንም እርሱ ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ተጠመቀ፤

verses.en: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
verses.fr: Les ayant conduits dans son logement, il leur servit à manger, et il se réjouit avec toute sa famille de ce qu''il avait cru en Dieu.
verses.am: ወደ ቤቱም አውጥቶ ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስላመነ ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ሐሤት አደረገ።

verses.en: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
verses.fr: Quand il fit jour, les préteurs envoyèrent les licteurs pour dire au geôlier: Relâche ces hommes.
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ ገዢዎቹ። እነዚያን ሰዎች ፍታቸው ብለው ሎሌዎቻቸውን ላኩ።

verses.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
verses.fr: Et le geôlier annonça la chose à Paul: Les préteurs ont envoyé dire qu''on vous relâchât; maintenant donc sortez, et allez en paix.
verses.am: የወኅኒውም ጠባቂ። ትፈቱ ዘንድ ገዢዎቹ ልከዋል፤ እንግዲህ አሁን ወጥታችሁ በሰላም ሂዱ ብሎ ይህን ቃል ለጳውሎስ ነገረው።

verses.en: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
verses.fr: Mais Paul dit aux licteurs: Après nous avoir battus de verges publiquement et sans jugement, nous qui sommes Romains, ils nous ont jetés en prison, et maintenant ils nous font sortir secrètement! Il n''en sera pas ainsi. Qu''ils viennent eux-mêmes nous mettre en liberté.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን። እኛ የሮሜ ሰዎች ስንሆን ያለ ፍርድ በሕዝብ ፊት ደብድበው በወኅኒ ጣሉን፤ አሁንም በስውር ይጥሉናልን? አይሆንም ራሳቸው ግን መጥተው ያውጡን አላቸው።

verses.en: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
verses.fr: Les licteurs rapportèrent ces paroles aux préteurs, qui furent effrayés en apprenant qu''ils étaient Romains.
verses.am: ሎሌዎቹም ይህን ነገር ለገዢዎች ነገሩ። የሮሜ ሰዎችም እንደ ሆኑ በሰሙ ጊዜ ፈሩ፤

verses.en: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
verses.fr: Ils vinrent les apaiser, et ils les mirent en liberté, en les priant de quitter la ville.
verses.am: መጥተውም ማለዱአቸው፥ አውጥተውም ከከተማ ይወጡ ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።

verses.en: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
verses.fr: Quand ils furent sortis de la prison, ils entrèrent chez Lydie, et, après avoir vu et exhorté les frères, ils partirent.
verses.am: ከወኅኒውም ወጥተው ወደ ልድያ ቤት ገቡ፥ ወንድሞችንም ባዩ ጊዜ አጽናኑአቸውና ሄዱ።

verses.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
verses.fr: Paul et Silas passèrent par Amphipolis et Apollonie, et ils arrivèrent à Thessalonique, où les Juifs avaient une synagogue.
verses.am: በአንፊጶልና በአጶሎንያም ካለፉ በኋላ ወደ ተሰሎንቄ መጡ፥ በዚያም የአይሁድ ምኵራብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
verses.fr: Paul y entra, selon sa coutume. Pendant trois sabbats, il discuta avec eux, d''après les Ecritures,
verses.am: ጳውሎስም እንደ ልማዱ ወደ እነርሱ ገባ፥ ሦስት ሰንበትም ያህል ከእነርሱ ጋር ከመጻሕፍት እየጠቀሰ ይነጋገር ነበር፤

verses.en: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
verses.fr: expliquant et établissant que le Christ devait souffrir et ressusciter des morts. Et Jésus que je vous annonce, disait-il, c''est lui qui est le Christ.
verses.am: ሲተረጉምም ክርስቶስ መከራ እንዲቀበልና ከሙታን እንዲነሣ ይገባው ዘንድ እያስረዳ። ይህ እኔ የምሰብክላችሁ ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ነው ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns d''entre eux furent persuadés, et se joignirent à Paul et à Silas, ainsi qu''une grande multitude de Grecs craignant Dieu, et beaucoup de femmes de qualité.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ተረድተው ከሚያመልኩም ከግሪክ ሰዎች ብዙ ከከበሩትም ሴቶች ጥቂቶች ያይደሉ፥ ከጳውሎስና ከሲላስ ጋር ተባበሩ።

verses.en: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.fr: Mais les Juifs, jaloux prirent avec eux quelques méchants hommes de la populace, provoquèrent des attroupements, et répandirent l''agitation dans la ville. Ils se portèrent à la maison de Jason, et ils cherchèrent Paul et Silas, pour les amener vers le peuple.
verses.am: አይሁድ ግን ቀንተው ከሥራ ፈቶች ክፉ ሰዎችን አመጡ ሕዝብንም ሰብስበው ከተማውን አወኩ፥ ወደ ሕዝብም ያወጡአቸው ዘንድ ፈልገው ወደ ኢያሶን ቤት ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.fr: Ne les ayant pas trouvés, ils traînèrent Jason et quelques frères devant les magistrats de la ville, en criant: Ces gens, qui ont bouleversé le monde, sont aussi venus ici,
verses.am: ባላገኙአቸውም ጊዜ ኢያሶንንና ከወንድሞች አንዳንዶችን ወደ ከተማው አለቆች ጎትተው። ዓለምን ያወኩ እነዚህ ወደዚህ ደግሞ መጥተዋል፥ ኢያሶንም ተቀብሎአቸዋል፤

verses.en: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
verses.fr: et Jason les a reçus. Ils agissent tous contre les édits de César, disant qu''il y a un autre roi, Jésus.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁሉ። ኢየሱስ የሚሉት ሌላ ንጉሥ አለ እያሉ የቄሣርን ትእዛዝ ይቃወማሉ ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.en: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.fr: Par ces paroles ils émurent la foule et les magistrats,
verses.am: ሕዝቡና የከተማውም አለቆች ይህን ነገር በሰሙ ጊዜ ታወኩ፥

verses.en: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
verses.fr: qui ne laissèrent aller Jason et les autres qu''après avoir obtenu d''eux une caution.
verses.am: ከኢያሶንና ከሌሎቹም ዋስ ተቀብለው ለቀቁአቸው።

verses.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.fr: Aussitôt les frères firent partir de nuit Paul et Silas pour Bérée. Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés, ils entrèrent dans la synagogue des Juifs.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ወንድሞች ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን በሌሊት ወደ ቤርያ ሰደዱአቸው፥ በደረሱም ጊዜ ወደ አይሁድ ምኵራብ ገቡ፤

verses.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.fr: Ces Juifs avaient des sentiments plus nobles que ceux de Thessalonique; ils reçurent la parole avec beaucoup d''empressement, et ils examinaient chaque jour les Ecritures, pour voir si ce qu''on leur disait était exact.
verses.am: እነዚህም በተሰሎንቄ ከሚኖሩት ይልቅ ልበ ሰፊዎች ነበሩና። ነገሩ እንደዚሁ ይሆንን? ብለው ዕለት ዕለት መጻሕፍትን እየመረመሩ ቃሉን በሙሉ ፈቃድ ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
verses.fr: Plusieurs d''entre eux crurent, ainsi que beaucoup de femmes grecques de distinction, et beaucoup d''hommes.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ከእነርሱ ብዙ፥ ከግሪኮችም የከበሩት ሴቶችና ወንዶች ጥቂት ያይደሉ፥ አመኑ።

verses.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
verses.fr: Mais, quand les Juifs de Thessalonique surent que Paul annonçait aussi à Bérée la parole de Dieu, ils vinrent y agiter la foule.
verses.am: በተሰሎንቄ ያሉት አይሁድ ግን ጳውሎስ በቤርያ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ ሰበከ ባወቁ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚያው ደግሞ መጡና ሕዝቡን አወኩ።

verses.en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
verses.fr: Alors les frères firent aussitôt partir Paul du côté de la mer; Silas et Timothée restèrent à Bérée.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ወንድሞቹ ወዲያው ጳውሎስን እስከ ባሕር ድረስ ይሄድ ዘንድ ሰደዱት፤ ሲላስና ጢሞቴዎስም በዚያው ቀሩ።

verses.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.fr: Ceux qui accompagnaient Paul le conduisirent jusqu''à Athènes. Puis ils s''en retournèrent, chargés de transmettre à Silas et à Timothée l''ordre de le rejoindre au plus tôt.
verses.am: ጳውሎስን የሸኙት ግን እስከ አቴና አደረሱት፥ እንደሚቻላቸውም በፍጥነት ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ዘንድ ወደ ሲላስና ወደ ጢሞቴዎስ ትእዛዝ ተቀብለው ሄዱ።

verses.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
verses.fr: Comme Paul les attendait à Athènes, il sentait au dedans de lui son esprit s''irriter, à la vue de cette ville pleine d''idoles.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም በአቴና ሲጠብቃቸው ሳለ፥ በከተማው ጣዖት መሙላቱን እየተመለከተ መንፈሱ ተበሳጨበት።

verses.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
verses.fr: Il s''entretenait donc dans la synagogue avec les Juifs et les hommes craignant Dieu, et sur la place publique chaque jour avec ceux qu''il rencontrait.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በምኵራብ ከአይሁድና እግዚአብሔርን ከሚያመልኩ ሰዎች ጋር በየቀኑም በገበያ ከሚያገኛቸው ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር።

verses.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
verses.fr: Quelques philosophes épicuriens et stoïciens se mirent à parler avec lui. Et les uns disaient: Que veut dire ce discoureur? D''autres, l''entendant annoncer Jésus et la résurrection, disaient: Il semble qu''il annonce des divinités étrangères.
verses.am: ከኤፊቆሮስ ወገንና ኢስጦኢኮችም ከተባሉት ፈላስፎች አንዳንዶቹ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገናኙ። አንዳንዶቹም። ይህ ለፍላፊ ምን ሊናገር ይወዳል? አሉ፤ ሌሎችም የኢየሱስንና የትንሣኤውን ወንጌል ስለ ሰበከላቸው። አዲሶችን አማልክት የሚያወራ ይመስላል አሉ።

verses.en: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
verses.fr: Alors ils le prirent, et le menèrent à l''Aréopage, en disant: Pourrions-nous savoir quelle est cette nouvelle doctrine que tu enseignes?
verses.am: የአቴና ሰዎች ሁሉና በዚያ የኖሩ እንግዶች አዲስ ነገርን ከመናገርና ከመስማት በቀር በሌላ ጉዳይ አይውሉም ነበርና።

verses.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.fr: Car tu nous fais entendre des choses étranges. Nous voudrions donc savoir ce que cela peut être.
verses.am: የአቴና ሰዎች ሁሉና በዚያ የኖሩ እንግዶች አዲስ ነገርን ከመናገርና ከመስማት በቀር በሌላ ጉዳይ አይውሉም ነበርና።

verses.en: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
verses.fr: Or, tous les Athéniens et les étrangers demeurant à Athènes ne passaient leur temps qu''à dire ou à écouter des nouvelles.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም በአርዮስፋጎስ መካከል ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። የአቴና ሰዎች ሆይ፥ እናንተ በሁሉ ነገር አማልክትን እጅግ እንደምትፈሩ እመለከታለሁ።

verses.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
verses.fr: Paul, debout au milieu de l''Aréopage, dit: Hommes Athéniens, je vous trouve à tous égards extrêmement religieux.
verses.am: የምታመልኩትን እየተመለከትሁ ሳልፍ። ለማይታወቅ አምላክ የሚል ጽሕፈት ያለበትን መሠዊያ ደግሞ አግኝቼአለሁና። እንግዲህ ይህን ሳታውቁ የምታመልኩትን እኔ እነግራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, To The Unknown God. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
verses.fr: Car, en parcourant votre ville et en considérant les objets de votre dévotion, j''ai même découvert un autel avec cette inscription: A un dieu inconnu! Ce que vous révérez sans le connaître, c''est ce que je vous annonce.
verses.am: ዓለሙንና በእርሱ ያለውን ሁሉ የፈጠረ አምላክ እርሱ የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ ነውና እጅ በሠራው መቅደስ አይኖርም፤

verses.en: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.fr: Le Dieu qui a fait le monde et tout ce qui s''y trouve, étant le Seigneur du ciel et de la terre, n''habite point dans des temples faits de main d''homme;
verses.am: እርሱም ሕይወትንና እስትንፋስን ሁሉንም ለሁሉ ይሰጣልና አንዳች እንደሚጎድለው በሰው እጅ አይገለገልም።

verses.en: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
verses.fr: il n''est point servi par des mains humaines, comme s''il avait besoin de quoi que ce soit, lui qui donne à tous la vie, la respiration, et toutes choses.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ከባለ ቅኔዎች አንዳንዶች ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ዘመዶቹ ነንና ብለው እንደ ተናገሩ፥ በእርሱ ሕያዋን ነንና እንንቀሳቀሳለን እንኖርማለን።

verses.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.fr: Il a fait que tous les hommes, sortis d''un seul sang, habitassent sur toute la surface de la terre, ayant déterminé la durée des temps et les bornes de leur demeure;
verses.am: ከእናንተ ከባለ ቅኔዎች አንዳንዶች ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ዘመዶቹ ነንና ብለው እንደ ተናገሩ፥ በእርሱ ሕያዋን ነንና እንንቀሳቀሳለን እንኖርማለን።

verses.en: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.fr: il a voulu qu''ils cherchassent le Seigneur, et qu''ils s''efforçassent de le trouver en tâtonnant, bien qu''il ne soit pas loin de chacun de nous,
verses.am: እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔር ዘመዶች ከሆንን፥ አምላክ በሰው ብልሃትና አሳብ የተቀረጸውን ወርቅ ወይም ብር ወይም ድንጋይ እንዲመስል እናስብ ዘንድ አይገባንም።

verses.en: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.fr: car en lui nous avons la vie, le mouvement, et l''être. C''est ce qu''ont dit aussi quelques-uns de vos poètes: De lui nous sommes la race...
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር ያለማወቅን ወራት አሳልፎ አሁን በየቦታቸው ንስሐ ይገቡ ዘንድ ሰውን ሁሉ ያዛል፤

verses.en: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, étant la race de Dieu, nous ne devons pas croire que la divinité soit semblable à de l''or, à de l''argent, ou à de la pierre, sculptés par l''art et l''industrie de l''homme.
verses.am: ቀን ቀጥሮአልና፥ በዚያም ቀን ባዘጋጀው ሰው እጅ በዓለሙ ላይ በጽድቅ ሊፈርድ አለው፤ ስለዚህም እርሱን ከሙታን በማስነሣቱ ሁሉን አረጋግጦአል።

verses.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verses.fr: Dieu, sans tenir compte des temps d''ignorance, annonce maintenant à tous les hommes, en tous lieux, qu''ils aient à se repentir,
verses.am: የሙታንንም ትንሣኤ በሰሙ ጊዜ እኵሌቶቹ አፌዙበት፥ እኵሌቶቹ ግን። ስለዚህ ነገር ሁለተኛ እንሰማሃለን አሉት።

verses.en: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
verses.fr: parce qu''il a fixé un jour où il jugera le monde selon la justice, par l''homme qu''il a désigné, ce dont il a donné à tous une preuve certaine en le ressuscitant des morts...
verses.am: እንዲሁም ጳውሎስ ከመካከላቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils entendirent parler de résurrection des morts, les uns se moquèrent, et les autres dirent: Nous t''entendrons là-dessus une autre fois.
verses.am: አንዳንዶች ወንዶች ግን ተባብረው አመኑ፤ ከእነርሱ ደግሞ በአርዮስፋጎስ ያለው የፍርድ ቤት ፈራጅ ዲዮናስዮስ ደማሪስ የሚሉአትም አንዲት ሴት ሌሎችም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.en: So Paul departed from among them.
verses.fr: Ainsi Paul se retira du milieu d''eux.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ጳውሎስ ከመካከላቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns néanmoins s''attachèrent à lui et crurent, Denys l''aréopagite, une femme nommée Damaris, et d''autres avec eux.
verses.am: አንዳንዶች ወንዶች ግን ተባብረው አመኑ፤ ከእነርሱ ደግሞ በአርዮስፋጎስ ያለው የፍርድ ቤት ፈራጅ ዲዮናስዮስ ደማሪስ የሚሉአትም አንዲት ሴት ሌሎችም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
verses.fr: Après cela, Paul partit d''Athènes, et se rendit à Corinthe.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ጳውሎስ ከአቴና ወጥቶ ወደ ቆሮንቶስ መጣ።

verses.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
verses.fr: Il y trouva un Juif nommé Aquilas, originaire du Pont, récemment arrivé d''Italie avec sa femme Priscille, parce que Claude avait ordonné à tous les Juifs de sortir de Rome. Il se lia avec eux;
verses.am: በወገኑም የጳንጦስ ሰው የሚሆን አቂላ የሚሉትን አንድ አይሁዳዊ አገኘ፤ እርሱም ከጥቂት ጊዜ በፊት ከሚስቱ ከጵርስቅላ ጋር ከኢጣልያ መጥቶ ነበር፥ አይሁድ ከሮሜ ይወጡ ዘንድ ቀላውዴዎስ አዞ ነበርና፤ ወደ እነርሱ ቀረበ፥

verses.en: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
verses.fr: et, comme il avait le même métier, il demeura chez eux et y travailla: ils étaient faiseurs de tentes.
verses.am: ሥራቸውም አንድ ስለ ነበረ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ተቀምጦ በአንድ ላይ ሠሩ፤ ሥራቸው ድንኳን መስፋት ነበረና።

verses.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
verses.fr: Paul discourait dans la synagogue chaque sabbat, et il persuadait des Juifs et des Grecs.
verses.am: በየሰንበቱም ሁሉ በምኵራብ ይነጋገር ነበር፥ አይሁድንና የግሪክንም ሰዎች ያስረዳ ነበር።

verses.en: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
verses.fr: Mais quand Silas et Timothée furent arrivés de la Macédoine, il se donna tout entier à la parole, attestant aux Juifs que Jésus était le Christ.
verses.am: ሲላስና ጢሞቴዎስም ከመቄዶንያ በወረዱ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስ ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ለአይሁድ እየመሰከረ ለቃሉ ይተጋ ነበር።

verses.en: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean; from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Les Juifs faisant alors de l''opposition et se livrant à des injures, Paul secoua ses vêtements, et leur dit: Que votre sang retombe sur votre tête! J''en suis pur. Dès maintenant, j''irai vers les païens.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በተቃወሙትና በተሳደቡ ጊዜ፥ ልብሱን እያራገፈ። ደማችሁ በራሳችሁ ነው፤ እኔ ንጹሕ ነኝ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ወደ አሕዛብ እሄዳለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
verses.fr: Et sortant de là, il entra chez un nommé Justus, homme craignant Dieu, et dont la maison était contiguë à la synagogue.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወጥቶ ኢዮስጦስ ወደሚባል እግዚአብሔርን ወደሚያመልክ ሰው ቤት ገባ ቤቱም በምኩራብ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
verses.fr: Cependant Crispus, le chef de la synagogue, crut au Seigneur avec toute sa famille. Et plusieurs Corinthiens, qui avaient entendu Paul, crurent aussi, et furent baptisés.
verses.am: የምኵራብ አለቃ ቀርስጶስም ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር በጌታ አመነ፥ ከቆሮንቶስ ሰዎችም ብዙ በሰሙ ጊዜ አምነው ተጠመቁ።

verses.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
verses.fr: Le Seigneur dit à Paul en vision pendant la nuit: Ne crains point; mais parle, et ne te tais point,
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እያስተማረ ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
verses.fr: Car je suis avec toi, et personne ne mettra la main sur toi pour te faire du mal: parle, car j''ai un peuple nombreux dans cette ville.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እያስተማረ ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.fr: Il y demeura un an et six mois, enseignant parmi les Corinthiens la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: ጋልዮስም በአካይያ አገረ ገዥ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ አይሁድ በአንድ ልብ ሆነው በጳውሎስ ላይ ተነሡ፥ ወደ ፍርድ ወንበርም አምጥተው።

verses.en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
verses.fr: Du temps que Gallion était proconsul de l''Achaïe, les Juifs se soulevèrent unanimement contre Paul, et le menèrent devant le tribunal,
verses.am: ይህ ሕግን ተቃውሞ እግዚአብሔርን ያመልኩት ዘንድ ሰዎችን ያባብላል አሉ።

verses.en: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
verses.fr: en disant: Cet homme excite les gens à servir Dieu d''une manière contraire à la loi.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም አፉን ሊከፍት ባሰበ ጊዜ፥ ጋልዮስ አይሁድን። አይሁድ ሆይ፥ ዓመፅ ወይም ክፉ በደል በሆነ እንድታገሣችሁ በተገባኝ፤

verses.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
verses.fr: Paul allait ouvrir la bouche, lorsque Gallion dit aux Juifs: S''il s''agissait de quelque injustice ou de quelque méchante action, je vous écouterais comme de raison, ô Juifs;
verses.am: ስለ ቃልና ስለ ስሞች ስለ ሕጋችሁም የምትከራከሩ ከሆነ ግን፥ ራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ እኔ በዚህ ነገር ፈራጅ እሆን ዘንድ አልፈቅድምና አላቸው።

verses.en: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
verses.fr: mais, s''il s''agit de discussions sur une parole, sur des noms, et sur votre loi, cela vous regarde: je ne veux pas être juge de ces choses.
verses.am: ከፍርድ ወንበርም ፊት አስወጣቸው።

verses.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
verses.fr: Et il les renvoya du tribunal.
verses.am: የግሪክ ሰዎችም ሁሉ የምኩራብ አለቃ ሶስቴንስን ይዘው በወንበሩ ፊት መቱት፤ በእነዚህም ነገሮች ጋልዮስ ግድ የለውም ነበር።

verses.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
verses.fr: Alors tous, se saisissant de Sosthène, le chef de la synagogue, le battirent devant le tribunal, sans que Gallion s''en mît en peine.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ጳውሎስ እጅግ ቀን ተቀምጦ ወንድሞቹንም ተሰናብቶ በመርከብ ወደ ሶርያ ሄደ፤ ስለትም ነበረበትና ራሱን በክንክራኦስ ተላጨ፤ ጵርስቅላና አቂላም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
verses.fr: Paul resta encore assez longtemps à Corinthe. Ensuite il prit congé des frères, et s''embarqua pour la Syrie, avec Priscille et Aquilas, après s''être fait raser la tête à Cenchrées, car il avait fait un voeu.
verses.am: ወደ ኤፌሶንም በደረሱ ጊዜ እነዚያን ከዚያ ተዋቸው፥ ራሱ ግን ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ ከአይሁድ ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር።

verses.en: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent à Ephèse, et Paul y laissa ses compagnons. Etant entré dans la synagogue, il s''entretint avec les Juifs,
verses.am: እነርሱም ብዙ ጊዜ እንዲቀመጥላቸው ሲለምኑት እሺ አላለም፤

verses.en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
verses.fr: qui le prièrent de prolonger son séjour. Mais il n''y consentit point,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሲሰናበታቸው። የሚመጣውን በዓል በኢየሩሳሌም አደርግ ዘንድ ይገባኛል እግዚአብሔር ቢፈቅድ ግን ወደ እናንተ ደግሞ እመለሳለሁ አላቸው። ከኤፌሶንም በመርከብ ተነሣ።

verses.en: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
verses.fr: et il prit congé d''eux, en disant: Il faut absolument que je célèbre la fête prochaine à Jérusalem. Je reviendrai vers vous, si Dieu le veut. Et il partit d''Ephèse.
verses.am: ወደ ቂሣርያም በደረሰ ጊዜ ወጥቶ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ ከሰጠ በኋላ ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረደ።

verses.en: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
verses.fr: Etant débarqué à Césarée, il monta à Jérusalem, et, après avoir salué l''Eglise, il descendit à Antioche.
verses.am: ጥቂት ቀንም ቆይቶ ወጣ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትንም ሁሉ እያጸና በገላትያ አገርና በፍርግያ በተራ አለፈ።

verses.en: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut passé quelque temps à Antioche, Paul se mit en route, et parcourut successivement la Galatie et la Phrygie, fortifiant tous les disciples.
verses.am: በወገኑም የእስክንድርያ ሰው የሆነ ነገር አዋቂ የነበረ አጵሎስ የሚሉት አንድ አይሁዳዊ ሰው ወደ ኤፌሶን ወረደ፤ እርሱም በመጻሕፍት እውቀት የበረታ ነበረ።

verses.en: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
verses.fr: Un Juif nommé Apollos, originaire d''Alexandrie, homme éloquent et versé dans les Ecritures, vint à Ephèse.
verses.am: እርሱ የጌታን መንገድ የተማረ ነበረ፥ የዮሐንስንም ጥምቀት ብቻ አውቆ በመንፈስ ሲቃጠል ስለ ኢየሱስ ይናገርና በትክክል ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
verses.fr: Il était instruit dans la voie du Seigneur, et, fervent d''esprit, il annonçait et enseignait avec exactitude ce qui concerne Jésus, bien qu''il ne connût que le baptême de Jean.
verses.am: እርሱም በምኵራብ ገልጦ ይናገር ጀመር። ጵርስቅላና አቂላም በሰሙት ጊዜ፥ ወስደው የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ከፊት ይልቅ በትክክል ገለጡለት።

verses.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
verses.fr: Il se mit à parler librement dans la synagogue. Aquilas et Priscille, l''ayant entendu, le prirent avec eux, et lui exposèrent plus exactement la voie de Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ አካይያ ማለፍ በፈቀደ ጊዜ፥ ወንድሞቹ አጸናኑት፥ ይቀበሉትም ዘንድ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርት ጻፉለት፤ በደረሰም ጊዜ አምነው የነበሩትን በጸጋ እጅግ ይጠቅማቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
verses.fr: Comme il voulait passer en Achaïe, les frères l''y encouragèrent, et écrivirent aux disciples de le bien recevoir. Quand il fut arrivé, il se rendit, par la grâce de Dieu, très utile à ceux qui avaient cru;
verses.am: ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ከመጻሕፍት እየገለጠ ለአይሁድ በሁሉ ፊት በጽኑ ያስረዳቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publicly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
verses.fr: Car il réfutait vivement les Juifs en public, démontrant par les Ecritures que Jésus est le Christ.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ከመጻሕፍት እየገለጠ ለአይሁድ በሁሉ ፊት በጽኑ ያስረዳቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
verses.fr: Pendant qu''Apollos était à Corinthe, Paul, après avoir parcouru les hautes provinces de l''Asie, arriva à Ephèse. Ayant rencontré quelques disciples,
verses.am: አጵሎስም በቆሮንቶስ ሳለ ጳውሎስ በላይኛው አገር አልፎ ወደ ኤፌሶን መጣ፥

verses.en: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: il leur dit: Avez-vous reçu le Saint-Esprit, quand vous avez cru? Ils lui répondirent: Nous n''avons pas même entendu dire qu''il y ait un Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: አንዳንድ ደቀ መዛሙርትንም አገኘ። ባመናችሁ ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበላችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አልተቀበልንም መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዳለ ስንኳ አልሰማንም አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
verses.fr: Il dit: De quel baptême avez-vous donc été baptisés? Et ils répondirent: Du baptême de Jean.
verses.am: እንኪያ በምን ተጠመቃችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት አሉት።

verses.en: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Alors Paul dit: Jean a baptisé du baptême de repentance, disant au peuple de croire en celui qui venait après lui, c''est-à-dire, en Jésus.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም። ዮሐንስስ ከእርሱ በኋላ በሚመጣው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ያምኑ ዘንድ ለሕዝብ እየተናገረ በንስሐ ጥምቀት አጠመቀ አላቸው።

verses.en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: Sur ces paroles, ils furent baptisés au nom du Seigneur Jésus.
verses.am: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም ተጠመቁ፤

verses.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
verses.fr: Lorsque Paul leur eut imposé les mains, le Saint-Esprit vint sur eux, et ils parlaient en langues et prophétisaient.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም እጁን በጫነባቸው ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ወረደባቸው በልሳኖችም ተናገሩ፥ ትንቢትም ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And all the men were about twelve.
verses.fr: Ils étaient en tout environ douze hommes.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት ያህሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Ensuite Paul entra dans la synagogue, où il parla librement. Pendant trois mois, il discourut sur les choses qui concernent le royaume de Dieu, s''efforçant de persuader ceux qui l''écoutaient.
verses.am: ወደ ምኵራብም ገብቶ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እየተነጋገረና እያስረዳቸው ሦስት ወር ያህል በግልጥ ይናገር ነበር።

verses.en: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
verses.fr: Mais, comme quelques-uns restaient endurcis et incrédules, décriant devant la multitude la voie du Seigneur, il se retira d''eux, sépara les disciples, et enseigna chaque jour dans l''école d''un nommé Tyrannus.
verses.am: አንዳንዶች ግን እልከኞች ሆነው በሕዝብ ፊት መንገዱን እየሰደቡ ባላመኑ ጊዜ፥ ከእነርሱ ርቆ ደቀ መዛሙርትን ለየ፥ ጢራኖስም በሚሉት በትምህርት ቤት ዕለት ዕለት ይነጋገር ነበር።
