verses.en: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.fr: Cela dura deux ans, de sorte que tous ceux qui habitaient l''Asie, Juifs et Grecs, entendirent la parole du Seigneur.
verses.am: በእስያም የኖሩት ሁሉ አይሁድም የግሪክ ሰዎችም የጌታን ቃል እስኪሰሙ ድረስ ሁለት ዓመት ያህል እንዲህ ሆነ።

verses.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
verses.fr: Et Dieu faisait des miracles extraordinaires par les mains de Paul,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጳውሎስ እጅ የሚያስገርም ተአምራት ያደርግ ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ከአካሉ ጨርቅ ወይም ልብስ ወደ ድውዮች ይወስዱ ነበር፥

verses.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verses.fr: au point qu''on appliquait sur les malades des linges ou des mouchoirs qui avaient touché son corps, et les maladies les quittaient, et les esprits malins sortaient.
verses.am: ደዌያቸውም ይለቃቸው ነበር ክፉዎች መናፍስትም ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
verses.fr: Quelques exorcistes juifs ambulants essayèrent d''invoquer sur ceux qui avaient des esprits malins le nom du Seigneur Jésus, en disant: Je vous conjure par Jésus que Paul prêche!
verses.am: አጋንንትንም እያወጡ ይዞሩ ከነበሩት አይሁድ አንዳንዶች። ጳውሎስ በሚሰብከው በኢየሱስ እናምላችኋለን እያሉ ክፉዎች መናፍስት ባሉባቸው ላይ የጌታን የኢየሱስን ስም ይጠሩባቸው ዘንድ ሞከሩ።

verses.en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
verses.fr: Ceux qui faisaient cela étaient sept fils de Scéva, Juif, l''un des principaux sacrificateurs.
verses.am: የካህናትም አለቃ ለሆነ አስቄዋ ለሚሉት ለአንድ አይሁዳዊ ይህን ያደረጉ ሰባት ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
verses.fr: L''esprit malin leur répondit: Je connais Jésus, et je sais qui est Paul; mais vous, qui êtes-vous?
verses.am: ክፉው መንፈስ ግን መልሶ። ኢየሱስንስ አውቀዋለሁ ጳውሎስንም አውቀዋለሁ፤ እናንተሳ እነማን ናችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.fr: Et l''homme dans lequel était l''esprit malin s''élança sur eux, se rendit maître de tous deux, et les maltraita de telle sorte qu''ils s''enfuirent de cette maison nus et blessés.
verses.am: ክፉው መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው ዘለለባቸው ቆስለውም ከዚያ ቤት ዕራቁታቸውን እስኪሸሹ ድረስ በረታባቸው አሸነፋቸውም።

verses.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.fr: Cela fut connu de tous les Juifs et de tous les Grecs qui demeuraient à Ephèse, et la crainte s''empara d''eux tous, et le nom du Seigneur Jésus était glorifié.
verses.am: ይህም በኤፌሶን በሚኖሩት ሁሉ በአይሁድና በግሪክ ሰዎች ዘንድ የታወቀ ሆነ፥ በሁላቸውም ላይ ፍርሃት ወደቀባቸው፥ የጌታም የኢየሱስ ስም ተከበረ፤

verses.en: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
verses.fr: Plusieurs de ceux qui avaient cru venaient confesser et déclarer ce qu''ils avaient fait.
verses.am: አምነውም ከነበሩት እጅግ ሰዎች ያደረጉትን እየተናዘዙና እየተናገሩ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.fr: Et un certain nombre de ceux qui avaient exercé les arts magiques, ayant apporté leurs livres, les brûlèrent devant tout le monde: on en estima la valeur à cinquante mille pièces d''argent.
verses.am: ከአስማተኞችም ብዙዎቹ መጽሐፋቸውን ሰብስበው በሰው ሁሉ ፊት አቃጠሉት፤ ዋጋውም ቢታሰብ አምሳ ሺህ ብር ሆኖ ተገኘ።

verses.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que la parole du Seigneur croissait en puissance et en force.
verses.am: እንዲህም የጌታ ቃል በኃይል ያድግና ያሸንፍ ነበር።

verses.en: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
verses.fr: Après que ces choses se furent passées, Paul forma le projet d''aller à Jérusalem, en traversant la Macédoine et l''Achaïe. Quand j''aurai été là, se disait-il, il faut aussi que je voie Rome.
verses.am: ይህም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ጳውሎስ። ወደዚያ ደርሼ ሮሜን ደግሞ አይ ዘንድ ይገባኛል ብሎ በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ አልፎ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲሄድ በመንፈስ አሰበ።

verses.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
verses.fr: Il envoya en Macédoine deux de ses aides, Timothée et Eraste, et il resta lui-même quelque temps encore en Asie.
verses.am: ከሚያገለግሉትም ሁለቱን ጢሞቴዎስንና ኤርስጦንን ወደ መቄዶንያ ልኮ ራሱ በእስያ ጥቂት ቀን ቆየ።

verses.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
verses.fr: Il survint, à cette époque, un grand trouble au sujet de la voie du Seigneur.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ስለዚህ መንገድ ብዙ ሁከት ሆነ።

verses.en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
verses.fr: Un nommé Démétrius, orfèvre, fabriquait en argent des temples de Diane, et procurait à ses ouvriers un gain considérable.
verses.am: ብር ሠሪ የሆነ ድሜጥሮስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው የአርጤምስን ቤተ መቅደስ ምስሎች በብር እየሠራ ለአንጥረኞች እጅግ ትርፍ ያገኝ ነበርና፤

verses.en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
verses.fr: Il les rassembla, avec ceux du même métier, et dit: O hommes, vous savez que notre bien-être dépend de cette industrie;
verses.am: እነዚህንም ይህንም የሚመስለውን ሥራ የሠሩትን ሰብስቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ትርፋችን በዚህ ሥራ እንደ ሆነ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
verses.fr: et vous voyez et entendez que, non seulement à Ephèse, mais dans presque toute l''Asie, ce Paul a persuadé et détourné une foule de gens, en disant que les dieux faits de main d''homme ne sont pas des dieux.
verses.am: ይህም ጳውሎስ። በእጅ የተሠሩቱ አማልክት አይደሉም ብሎ፥ በኤፌሶን ብቻ ሳይሆን ከጥቂት ክፍል በቀር በእስያ ሁሉ ብዙ ሕዝብን እንደ አስረዳና እንደ አሳተ አይታችኋል ሰምታችሁማል።

verses.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
verses.fr: Le danger qui en résulte, ce n''est pas seulement que notre industrie ne tombe en discrédit; c''est encore que le temple de la grande déesse Diane ne soit tenu pour rien, et même que la majesté de celle qui est révérée dans toute l''Asie et dans le monde entier ne soit réduite à néant.
verses.am: ሥራችንም እንዲናቅ ብቻ አይደለም፥ እስያ ሁሉ ዓለሙም የሚያመልካት የታላቂቱ አምላክ የአርጤምስ መቅደስ ምናምን ሆኖ እንዲቆጠር እንጂ፥ ታላቅነትዋም ደግሞ እንዳይሻር ያስፈራል።

verses.en: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.fr: Ces paroles les ayant remplis de colère, ils se mirent à crier: Grande est la Diane des Ephésiens!
verses.am: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ ቍጣ ሞላባቸው። የኤፌሶን አርጤምስ ታላቅ ናት እያሉም ጮኹ።

verses.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
verses.fr: Toute la ville fut dans la confusion. Ils se précipitèrent tous ensemble au théâtre, entraînant avec eux Gaïus et Aristarque, Macédoniens, compagnons de voyage de Paul.
verses.am: ከተማውም በሙሉው ተደባለቀ፥ የመቄዶንያም ሰዎች የጳውሎስን ጓደኞች ጋይዮስንና አርስጥሮኮስን ከእነርሱ ጋር ነጥቀው በአንድ ልብ ሆነው ወደ ጨዋታ ስፍራ ሮጡ።

verses.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
verses.fr: Paul voulait se présenter devant le peuple, mais les disciples l''en empêchèrent;
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ወደ ሕዝቡ ይገባ ዘንድ በፈቀደ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርት ከለከሉት።

verses.en: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
verses.fr: quelques-uns même des Asiarques, qui étaient ses amis, envoyèrent vers lui, pour l''engager à ne pas se rendre au théâtre.
verses.am: ከእስያም አለቆች ወዳጆቹ የሆኑት አንዳንዶች ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ልከው ወደ ጨዋታ ስፍራ ራሱን እንዳይሰጥ ለመኑት።

verses.en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused: and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
verses.fr: Les uns criaient d''une manière, les autres d''une autre, car le désordre régnait dans l''assemblée, et la plupart ne savaient pas pourquoi ils s''étaient réunis.
verses.am: ወዲያና ወዲህም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር፤ በጉባኤው ድብልቅልቅ ሆኖ የሚበልጡት ስንኳ ስለ ምን እንደተሰበሰቡ አላወቁም ነበርና።

verses.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
verses.fr: Alors on fit sortir de la foule Alexandre, que les Juifs poussaient en avant; et Alexandre, faisant signe de la main, voulait parler au peuple.
verses.am: አይሁድም ሲያቀርቡት፥ እስክንድሮስን ከሕዝቡ መካከል ወደ ፊት ገፉት፤ እስክንድሮስም በእጁ ጠቅሶ በሕዝብ ፊት እንዲምዋገትላቸው ወደደ።

verses.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.fr: Mais quand ils reconnurent qu''il était Juif, tous d''une seule voix crièrent pendant près de deux heures: Grande est la Diane des Ephésiens!
verses.am: አይሁዳዊ ግን እንደ ሆነ ባወቁ ጊዜ፥ ሁሉ በአንድ ድምፅ። የኤፌሶን አርጤምስ ታላቅ ናት እያሉ ሁለት ሰዓት ያህል ጮኹ።

verses.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
verses.fr: Cependant le secrétaire, ayant apaisé la foule, dit: Hommes Ephésiens, quel est celui qui ignore que la ville d''Ephèse est la gardienne du temple de la grande Diane et de son simulacre tombé du ciel?
verses.am: የከተማይቱም ጸሐፊ ሕዝቡን ጸጥ አሰኝቶ እንዲህ አለ። የኤፌሶን ሰዎች ሆይ፥ የኤፌሶን ከተማ ለታላቂቱ አርጤምስ ከሰማይም ለወረደው ጣዖትዋ የመቅደስ ጠባቂ መሆንዋን የማያውቅ ሰው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
verses.fr: Cela étant incontestable, vous devez vous calmer, et ne rien faire avec précipitation.
verses.am: ይህንም የሚክደው ከሌለ፥ ጸጥ እንድትሉና አንዳች በችኮላ እንዳታደርጉ ይገባል።

verses.en: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.fr: Car vous avez amené ces hommes, qui ne sont coupables ni de sacrilège, ni de blasphème envers notre déesse.
verses.am: የመቅደስን ዕቃ ያልሰረቁ አምላካችንንም ያልሰደቡ እነዚህን ሰዎች አምጥታችኋቸዋልና።

verses.en: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
verses.fr: Si donc Démétrius et ses ouvriers ont à se plaindre de quelqu''un, il y a des jours d''audience et des proconsuls; qu''ils s''appellent en justice les uns les autres.
verses.am: ድሜጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉት አንጥረኞች ግን በሰው ላይ ነገር እንዳላቸው፥ የመጋቢያ ቀንና አገረ ገዢዎች አሉ፤ እርስ በርሳቸው ይምዋገቱ።

verses.en: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
verses.fr: Et si vous avez en vue d''autres objets, ils se régleront dans une assemblée légale.
verses.am: ስለ ሌላ ነገር እንደ ሆነ ግን አንዳች ብትፈልጉ፥ በተደነገገው ጉባኤ ይፈታል።

verses.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
verses.fr: Nous risquons, en effet, d''être accusés de sédition pour ce qui s''est passé aujourd''hui, puisqu''il n''existe aucun motif qui nous permette de justifier cet attroupement.
verses.am: ዛሬ ስለ ተደረገው። ሁከት ነው ሲሉ እንዳይከሱን ያስፈራልና፤ ስለዚህም ስብሰባ ምላሽ መስጠት አንችልም፥ ምክንያት የለምና።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.fr: Après ces paroles, il congédia l''assemblée.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ ጉባኤውን ፈታው።

verses.en: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
verses.fr: Lorsque le tumulte eut cessé, Paul réunit les disciples, et, après les avoir exhortés, prit congé d''eux, et partit pour aller en Macédoine.
verses.am: ሁከቱም ከቀረ በኋላ ጳውሎስ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አስመጥቶ መከራቸው፥ ተሰናብቶአቸውም ወደ መቄዶንያ ይሄድ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
verses.fr: Il parcourut cette contrée, en adressant aux disciples de nombreuses exhortations. Puis il se rendit en Grèce,
verses.am: ያንም አገር እያለፈ በብዙ ቃል ከመከራቸው በኋላ ወደ ግሪክ አገር መጣ።

verses.en: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
verses.fr: où il séjourna trois mois. Il était sur le point de s''embarquer pour la Syrie, quand les Juifs lui dressèrent des embûches. Alors il se décida à reprendre la route de la Macédoine.
verses.am: በዚያም ሦስት ወር ተቀምጦ ወደ ሶርያ በመርከብ ሊሄድ ባሰበ ጊዜ፥ አይሁድ ሴራ ስላደረጉበት በመቄዶንያ አልፎ ይመለስ ዘንድ ቆረጠ።

verses.en: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
verses.fr: Il avait pour l''accompagner jusqu''en Asie: Sopater de Bérée, fils de Pyrrhus, Aristarque et Second de Thessalonique, Gaïus de Derbe, Timothée, ainsi que Tychique et Trophime, originaires d''Asie.
verses.am: የሸኙትም የቤርያው ሱሲጳጥሮስ ከተሰሎንቄ ሰዎችም አርስጥሮኮስና ሲኮንዱስ የደርቤኑም ጋይዮስና ጢሞቴዎስ የእስያ ሰዎችም ቲኪቆስ ጥሮፊሞስም ነበሩ፤

verses.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
verses.fr: Ceux-ci prirent les devants, et nous attendirent à Troas.
verses.am: እነዚህም ወደ ፊታችን አልፈው በጢሮአዳ ቆዩን።

verses.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
verses.fr: Pour nous, après les jours des pains sans levain, nous nous embarquâmes à Philippes, et, au bout de cinq jours, nous les rejoignîmes à Troas, où nous passâmes sept jours.
verses.am: እኛ ግን ከቂጣ በዓል ቀን በኋላ ከፊልጵስዩስ በመርከብ ተነሥተን በአምስት ቀን ወደ ጢሮአዳ ወደ እነርሱ ደረስንና በዚያ ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጥን።

verses.en: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
verses.fr: Le premier jour de la semaine, nous étions réunis pour rompre le pain. Paul, qui devait partir le lendemain, s''entretenait avec les disciples, et il prolongea son discours jusqu''à minuit.
verses.am: ከሳምንቱም በመጀመሪያ ቀን እንጀራ ለመቁረስ ተሰብስበን ሳለን፥ ጳውሎስ በነገው ሊሄድ ስላሰበ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር፥ እስከ መንፈቀ ሌሊትም ነገሩን አስረዘመ።

verses.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
verses.fr: Il y avait beaucoup de lampes dans la chambre haute où nous étions assemblés.
verses.am: ተሰብስበንም በነበርንበት ሰገነት እጅግ መብራት ነበረ።

verses.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
verses.fr: Or, un jeune homme nommé Eutychus, qui était assis sur la fenêtre, s''endormit profondément pendant le long discours de Paul; entraîné par le sommeil, il tomba du troisième étage en bas, et il fut relevé mort.
verses.am: አውጤኪስ የሚሉትም አንድ ጎበዝ በመስኮት ተቀምጦ ታላቅ እንቅልፍ አንቀላፍቶ ነበር፤ ጳውሎስም ነገርን ባስረዘመ ጊዜ እንቅልፍ ከብዶት ከሦስተኛው ደርብ ወደ ታች ወደቀ፥ ሞቶም አነሡት።

verses.en: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
verses.fr: Mais Paul, étant descendu, se pencha sur lui et le prit dans ses bras, en disant: Ne vous troublez pas, car son âme est en lui.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ወርዶ በላዩ ወደቀ፥ አቅፎም። ነፍሱ አለችበትና አትንጫጩ አላቸው።

verses.en: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
verses.fr: Quand il fut remonté, il rompit le pain et mangea, et il parla longtemps encore jusqu''au jour. Après quoi il partit.
verses.am: ወጥቶም እንጀራ ቆርሶም በላ፤ ብዙ ጊዜም እስኪነጋ ድረስ ተነጋገረ እንዲህም ሄደ።

verses.en: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
verses.fr: Le jeune homme fut ramené vivant, et ce fut le sujet d''une grande consolation.
verses.am: ብላቴናውንም ደኅና ሆኖ ወሰዱት እጅግም ተጽናኑ።

verses.en: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
verses.fr: Pour nous, nous précédâmes Paul sur le navire, et nous fîmes voile pour Assos, où nous étions convenus de le reprendre, parce qu''il devait faire la route à pied.
verses.am: እኛ ግን ጳውሎስን ከዚያ እንቀበለው ዘንድ ስላለን ወደ መርከብ ቀድመን ሄድንና ወደ አሶን ተነሣን፤ እርሱ በመሬት ይሄድ ዘንድ ስላሰበ እንደዚህ አዞ ነበርና።

verses.en: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il nous eut rejoints à Assos, nous le prîmes à bord, et nous allâmes à Mytilène.
verses.am: በአሶንም ባገኘን ጊዜ ተቀብለነው ወደ ሚጢሊኒ መጣን፤

verses.en: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
verses.fr: De là, continuant par mer, nous arrivâmes le lendemain vis-à-vis de Chios. Le jour suivant, nous cinglâmes vers Samos, et le jour d''après nous vînmes à Milet.
verses.am: በማግሥቱም ከዚያ በባሕር ተነሥተን በኪዩ ፊት ለፊት ደረስን፥ በነገውም ወደ ሳሞን ተሻገርን በትሮጊሊዮም አድረን በማግሥቱ ወደ ሚሊጢን መጣን።

verses.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
verses.fr: Paul avait résolu de passer devant Ephèse sans s''y arrêter, afin de ne pas perdre de temps en Asie; car il se hâtait pour se trouver, si cela lui était possible, à Jérusalem le jour de la Pentecôte.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ በእስያ እጅግ እንዳይቀመጥ ኤፌሶንን ይተው ዘንድ ቆርጦ ነበርና ቢቻለውም በዓለ ኀምሳን በኢየሩሳሌም ይውል ዘንድ ይቸኩል ነበርና።

verses.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
verses.fr: Cependant, de Milet Paul envoya chercher à Ephèse les anciens de l''Eglise.
verses.am: ከሚሊጢንም ወደ ኤፌሶን ልኮ የቤተክርስቲያንን ሽማግሌዎች አስጠራቸው፤

verses.en: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés vers lui, il leur dit: Vous savez de quelle manière, depuis le premier jour où je suis entré en Asie, je me suis sans cesse conduit avec vous,
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በመንፈስ ታስሬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ፥ በዚያም የሚያገኘኝ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም፤

verses.en: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
verses.fr: servant le Seigneur en toute humilité, avec larmes, et au milieu des épreuves que me suscitaient les embûches des Juifs.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በመንፈስ ታስሬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ፥ በዚያም የሚያገኘኝ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም፤

verses.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publicly, and from house to house,
verses.fr: Vous savez que je n''ai rien caché de ce qui vous était utile, et que je n''ai pas craint de vous prêcher et de vous enseigner publiquement et dans les maisons,
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በመንፈስ ታስሬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ፥ በዚያም የሚያገኘኝ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም፤

verses.en: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: annonçant aux Juifs et aux Grecs la repentance envers Dieu et la foi en notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስ። እስራትና መከራ ይቆይሃል ብሎ በየከተማው ሁሉ ይመሰክርልኛል።

verses.en: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
verses.fr: Et maintenant voici, lié par l''Esprit, je vais à Jérusalem, ne sachant pas ce qui m''y arrivera;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሩጫዬንና ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ የተቀበልሁትን አገልግሎት እርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ወንጌልን መመስከር እፈጽም ዘንድ ነፍሴን በእኔ ዘንድ እንደማትከብር እንደ ከንቱ ነገር እቆጥራለሁ።

verses.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
verses.fr: seulement, de ville en ville, l''Esprit-Saint m''avertit que des liens et des tribulations m''attendent.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እየሰበክሁ በመካከላችሁ የዞርሁ ሁላችሁ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ፊቴን እንዳትዩ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.fr: Mais je ne fais pour moi-même aucun cas de ma vie, comme si elle m''était précieuse, pourvu que j''accomplisse ma course avec joie, et le ministère que j''ai reçu du Seigneur Jésus, d''annoncer la bonne nouvelle de la grâce de Dieu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኔ ከሰው ሁሉ ደም ንጹሕ እንደ ሆንሁ ዛሬ በዚች ቀን እመሰክርላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
verses.fr: Et maintenant voici, je sais que vous ne verrez plus mon visage, vous tous au milieu desquels j''ai passé en prêchant le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ምክር ሁሉ ነግሬአችኋለሁና፥ ምንም አላስቀረሁባችሁም።

verses.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous déclare aujourd''hui que je suis pur du sang de vous tous,
verses.am: በገዛ ደሙ የዋጃትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ትጠብቁአት ዘንድ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እናንተን ጳጳሳት አድርጎ ለሾመባት ለመንጋው ሁሉና ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
verses.fr: car je vous ai annoncé tout le conseil de Dieu, sans en rien cacher.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሦስት ዓመት ሌሊትና ቀን በእንባ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከመገሠጽ እንዳላቋረጥሁ እያሰባችሁ ትጉ።

verses.en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
verses.fr: Prenez donc garde à vous-mêmes, et à tout le troupeau sur lequel le Saint-Esprit vous a établis évêques, pour paître l''Eglise du Seigneur, qu''il s''est acquise par son propre sang.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሦስት ዓመት ሌሊትና ቀን በእንባ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከመገሠጽ እንዳላቋረጥሁ እያሰባችሁ ትጉ።

verses.en: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.fr: Je sais qu''il s''introduira parmi vous, après mon départ, des loups cruels qui n''épargneront pas le troupeau,
verses.am: አሁንም ለእግዚአብሔርና ያንጻችሁ ዘንድ በቅዱሳንም ሁሉ መካከል ርስትን ይሰጣችሁ ዘንድ ለሚችል ለጸጋው ቃል አደራ ሰጥቻችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
verses.fr: et qu''il s''élèvera du milieu de vous des hommes qui enseigneront des choses pernicieuses, pour entraîner les disciples après eux.
verses.am: ከማንም ብር ወይም ወርቅ ወይም ልብስ አልተመኘሁም፤

verses.en: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
verses.fr: Veillez donc, vous souvenant que, durant trois années, je n''ai cessé nuit et jour d''exhorter avec larmes chacun de vous.
verses.am: እነዚህ እጆቼ በሚያስፈልገኝ ነገር ለእኔና ከእኔ ጋር ላሉት እንዳገለገሉ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
verses.fr: Et maintenant je vous recommande à Dieu et à la parole de sa grâce, à celui qui peut édifier et donner l''héritage avec tous les sanctifiés.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እየደከማችሁ ድውዮችን ልትረዱና እርሱ ራሱ። ከሚቀበል ይልቅ የሚሰጥ ብፁዕ ነው እንዳለ የጌታን የኢየሱስን ቃል ልታስቡ ይገባችሁ ዘንድ በሁሉ አሳየኋችሁ።

verses.en: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
verses.fr: Je n''ai désiré ni l''argent, ni l''or, ni les vêtements de personne.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ ተንበርክኮ ከሁላቸው ጋር ጸለየ።

verses.en: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
verses.fr: Vous savez vous-mêmes que ces mains ont pourvu à mes besoins et à ceux des personnes qui étaient avec moi.
verses.am: ሁሉም እጅግ አለቀሱ፥ ጳውሎስንም አንገቱን አቅፈው ይስሙት ነበር፤

verses.en: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.fr: Je vous ai montré de toutes manières que c''est en travaillant ainsi qu''il faut soutenir les faibles, et se rappeler les paroles du Seigneur, qui a dit lui-même: Il y a plus de bonheur à donner qu''à recevoir.
verses.am: ይልቁንም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ፊቴን አታዩም ስላላቸው ነገር እጅግ አዘኑ። እስከ መርከብም ድረስ ሸኙት።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
verses.fr: Après avoir ainsi parlé, il se mit à genoux, et il pria avec eux tous.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ ተንበርክኮ ከሁላቸው ጋር ጸለየ።

verses.en: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,
verses.fr: Et tous fondirent en larmes, et, se jetant au cou de Paul, ils l''embrassaient,
verses.am: ሁሉም እጅግ አለቀሱ፥ ጳውሎስንም አንገቱን አቅፈው ይስሙት ነበር፤

verses.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
verses.fr: affligés surtout de ce qu''il avait dit qu''ils ne verraient plus son visage. Et ils l''accompagnèrent jusqu''au navire.
verses.am: ይልቁንም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ፊቴን አታዩም ስላላቸው ነገር እጅግ አዘኑ። እስከ መርከብም ድረስ ሸኙት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
verses.fr: Nous nous embarquâmes, après nous être séparés d''eux, et nous allâmes directement à Cos, le lendemain à Rhodes, et de là à Patara.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ተለይተን ተነሣን፤ በቀጥታም ሄደን ወደ ቆስ በነገውም ወደ ሩድ ከዚያም ወደ ጳጥራ መጣን፤

verses.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
verses.fr: Et ayant trouvé un navire qui faisait la traversée vers la Phénicie, nous montâmes et partîmes.
verses.am: ወደ ፊንቄም የሚሻገር መርከብ አግኝተን ገባንና ተነሣን።

verses.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
verses.fr: Quand nous fûmes en vue de l''île de Chypre, nous la laissâmes à gauche, poursuivant notre route du côté de la Syrie, et nous abordâmes à Tyr, où le bâtiment devait décharger sa cargaison.
verses.am: ቆጵሮስንም ባየናት ጊዜ በስተ ግራችን ተውናት ወደ ሶርያም ሄደን ወደ ጢሮስ ደረስን፥ መርከቡ ሸክሙን በዚያ የሚያራግፍ ነበርና።

verses.en: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Nous trouvâmes les disciples, et nous restâmes là sept jours. Les disciples, poussés par l''Esprit, disaient à Paul de ne pas monter à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርትንም ባገኘን ጊዜ በዚያ ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጥን፤ እነርሱም ጳውሎስን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዳይወጣ በመንፈስ አሉት።

verses.en: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
verses.fr: Mais, lorsque nous fûmes au terme des sept jours, nous nous acheminâmes pour partir, et tous nous accompagnèrent avec leurs femmes et leurs enfants jusque hors de la ville. Nous nous mîmes à genoux sur le rivage, et nous priâmes.
verses.am: ጊዜውንም በፈጸምን ጊዜ ወጥተን ሄድን፤ ሁላቸውም ከሚስቶቻቸውና ከልጆቻቸው ጋር እስከ ከተማው ውጭ ድረስ ሸኙን፥ በባሕሩም ዳር ተንበርክከን ጸለይን፤

verses.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
verses.fr: Puis, ayant pris congé les uns des autres, nous montâmes sur le navire, et ils retournèrent chez eux.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችንም ተሰነባብተን ወደ መርከብ ወጣን፥ እነዚያም ወደ ቤታቸው ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
verses.fr: Achevant notre navigation, nous allâmes de Tyr à Ptolémaïs, où nous saluâmes les frères, et passâmes un jour avec eux.
verses.am: እኛም የባሕሩን መንገድ ጨርሰን ከጢሮስ ወደ አካ ደረስን፥ ለወንድሞችም ሰላምታ ሰጥተን ከእነርሱ ዘንድ አንድ ቀን ተቀመጥን።

verses.en: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
verses.fr: Nous partîmes le lendemain, et nous arrivâmes à Césarée. Etant entrés dans la maison de Philippe l''évangéliste, qui était l''un des sept, nous logeâmes chez lui.
verses.am: በነገውም ወጥተን ወደ ቂሣርያ መጣን፥ ከሰባቱም አንድ በሚሆን በወንጌላዊው ፊልጶስ ቤት ገብተን በእርሱ ዘንድ ተቀመጥን።

verses.en: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
verses.fr: Il avait quatre filles vierges qui prophétisaient.
verses.am: ለእርሱም ትንቢት የሚናገሩ አራት ደናግል ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
verses.fr: Comme nous étions là depuis plusieurs jours, un prophète, nommé Agabus, descendit de Judée,
verses.am: አያሌ ቀንም ተቀምጠን ሳለን ነቢይ የነበረ አጋቦስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ከይሁዳ ወረደ።

verses.en: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
verses.fr: et vint nous trouver. Il prit la ceinture de Paul, se lia les pieds et les mains, et dit: Voici ce que déclare le Saint-Esprit: L''homme à qui appartient cette ceinture, les Juifs le lieront de la même manière à Jérusalem, et le livreront entre les mains des païens.
verses.am: ወደ እኛም መጣና የጳውሎስን መታጠቂያ ወስዶ የገዛ እጁንና እግሩን አስሮ። እንዲሁ መንፈስ ቅዱስ። ይህ መታጠቂያ ያለውን ሰው አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌም እንደዚህ ያስሩታል በአሕዛብም እጅ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል ይላል አለ።

verses.en: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Quand nous entendîmes cela, nous et ceux de l''endroit, nous priâmes Paul de ne pas monter à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ይህንም በሰማን ጊዜ እኛም በዚያ የሚኖሩትም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዳይወጣ ለመንነው።

verses.en: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: Alors il répondit: Que faites-vous, en pleurant et en me brisant le coeur? Je suis prêt, non seulement à être lié, mais encore à mourir à Jérusalem pour le nom du Seigneur Jésus.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን መልሶ። እያለቀሳችሁ ልቤንም እየሰበራችሁ ምን ማድረጋችሁ ነው? እኔ ስለ ጌታ ስለ ኢየሱስ ስም በኢየሩሳሌም ለመሞት እንኳ ተሰናድቼአለሁ እንጂ ለእስራት ብቻ አይደለም አለ።

verses.en: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
verses.fr: Comme il ne se laissait pas persuader, nous n''insistâmes pas, et nous dîmes: Que la volonté du Seigneur se fasse!
verses.am: ምክርንም ሊቀበል እምቢ ባለ ጊዜ። የጌታ ፈቃድ ይሁን ብለን ዝም አልን።

verses.en: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Après ces jours-là, nous fîmes nos préparatifs, et nous montâmes à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ከዚህም ቀን በኋላ ተዘጋጅተን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣን።

verses.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
verses.fr: Quelques disciples de Césarée vinrent aussi avec nous, et nous conduisirent chez un nommé Mnason, de l''île de Chypre, ancien disciple, chez qui nous devions loger.
verses.am: በቂሣርያም ከነበሩ ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዳንዶች ደግሞ ከእኛ ጋር መጡ፥ እነርሱም ወደምናድርበት ወደ ቀደመው ደቀ መዝሙር ወደ ቆጵሮሱ ምናሶን ወደሚሉት ቤት መሩን።

verses.en: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
verses.fr: Lorsque nous arrivâmes à Jérusalem, les frères nous reçurent avec joie.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በደረስን ጊዜ ወንድሞች በደስታ ተቀበሉን።

verses.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Paul se rendit avec nous chez Jacques, et tous les anciens s''y réunirent.
verses.am: በነገውም ጳውሎስ ከእኛ ጋር ወደ ያዕቆብ ዘንድ ገባ ሽማግሌዎችም ሁሉ መጡ።

verses.en: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
verses.fr: Après les avoir salués, il raconta en détail ce que Dieu avait fait au milieu des païens par son ministère.
verses.am: ሰላምታም ካቀረበላቸው በኋላ በእርሱ ማገልገል እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ መካከል ያደረገውን በእያንዳንዱ ተረከላቸው።

verses.en: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
verses.fr: Quand ils l''eurent entendu, ils glorifièrent Dieu. Puis ils lui dirent: Tu vois, frère, combien de milliers de Juifs ont cru, et tous sont zélés pour la loi.
verses.am: እነርሱም በሰሙ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ አሉትም። ወንድም ሆይ፥ በአይሁድ መካከል አምነው የነበሩት ስንት አእላፋት እንደ ሆኑ ታያለህ፤ ሁላቸውም ለሕግ የሚቀኑ ናቸው።

verses.en: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
verses.fr: Or, ils ont appris que tu enseignes à tous les Juifs qui sont parmi les païens à renoncer à Moïse, leur disant de ne pas circoncire les enfants et de ne pas se conformer aux coutumes.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውንም እንዳይገርዙ በሥርዓትም እንዳይሄዱ ብለህ በአሕዛብ መካከል ያሉት አይሁድ ሁሉ ሙሴን ይክዱ ዘንድ እንድታስተምር ስለ አንተ ነግረዋቸዋል።

verses.en: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
verses.fr: Que faire donc? Sans aucun doute la multitude se rassemblera, car on saura que tu es venu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን ይሁን? የአንተን መምጣት ይሰማሉና ብዙዎች የግድ ሳይሰበሰቡ አይቀሩም።

verses.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi fais ce que nous allons te dire. Il y a parmi nous quatre hommes qui ont fait un voeu;
verses.am: እንግዲህ ይህን የምንልህን አድርግ፤ ስለት ያለባቸው አራት ሰዎች በእኛ ዘንድ አሉ።

verses.en: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
verses.fr: prends-les avec toi, purifie-toi avec eux, et pourvois à leur dépense, afin qu''ils se rasent la tête. Et ainsi tous sauront que ce qu''ils ont entendu dire sur ton compte est faux, mais que toi aussi tu te conduis en observateur de la loi.
verses.am: እነዚህንም ይዘህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ንጻ፥ ራሳቸውንም እንዲላጩ ገንዘብ ክፈልላቸው፤ ሁሉም ስለ አንተ የተማሩት ከንቱ እንደ ሆነና አንተ ራስህ ደግሞ ሕጉን እየጠበቅህ በሥርዓት እንድትመላለስ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
verses.fr: A l''égard des païens qui ont cru, nous avons décidé et nous leur avons écrit qu''ils eussent à s''abstenir des viandes sacrifiées aux idoles, du sang, des animaux étouffés, et de l''impudicité.
verses.am: አምነው ስለ ነበሩ አሕዛብ ግን ለጣዖት ከተሠዋ ከደምም ከታነቀም ከዝሙትም ነፍሳቸውን እንዲጠብቁ ፈርደን እኛ ጽፈንላቸዋል።

verses.en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
verses.fr: Alors Paul prit ces hommes, se purifia, et entra le lendemain dans le temple avec eux, pour annoncer à quel jour la purification serait accomplie et l''offrande présentée pour chacun d''eux.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ ሰዎችን ይዞ በማግሥቱ ከእነርሱ ጋር እየነጻ፥ መንጻታቸውን የሚፈጽሙበትን ቀን አስታውቆ ወደ መቅደስ ገባ። በዚያም ቀን ስለ እያንዳንዳቸው መሥዋዕትን አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
verses.fr: Sur la fin des sept jours, les Juifs d''Asie, ayant vu Paul dans le temple, soulevèrent toute la foule, et mirent la main sur lui,
verses.am: በፊት የኤፌሶኑን ጥሮፊሞስን ከእርሱ ጋር በከተማ አይተውት ነበርና ጳውሎስም ወደ መቅደስ ያገባው መስሎአቸው ነው።

verses.en: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
verses.fr: en criant: Hommes Israélites, au secours! Voici l''homme qui prêche partout et à tout le monde contre le peuple, contre la loi et contre ce lieu; il a même introduit des Grecs dans le temple, et a profané ce saint lieu.
verses.am: በፊት የኤፌሶኑን ጥሮፊሞስን ከእርሱ ጋር በከተማ አይተውት ነበርና ጳውሎስም ወደ መቅደስ ያገባው መስሎአቸው ነው።

verses.en: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
verses.fr: Car ils avaient vu auparavant Trophime d''Ephèse avec lui dans la ville, et ils croyaient que Paul l''avait fait entrer dans le temple.
verses.am: ከተማውም ሁሉ ታወከ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ ጳውሎስንም ይዘው ከመቅደስ ውጭ ጎተቱት፥ ወዲያውም ደጆች ተዘጉ።

verses.en: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
verses.fr: Toute la ville fut émue, et le peuple accourut de toutes parts. Ils se saisirent de Paul, et le traînèrent hors du temple, dont les portes furent aussitôt fermées.
verses.am: ሊገድሉትም ሲፈልጉ። ኢየሩሳሌም ፈጽማ ታወከች የሚል ወሬ ወደ ጭፍራው ሻለቃ ወጣ፤

verses.en: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.fr: Comme ils cherchaient à le tuer, le bruit vint au tribun de la cohorte que tout Jérusalem était en confusion.
verses.am: እርሱም ያን ጊዜ ወታደሮችን ከመቶ አለቆች ጋር ይዞ እየሮጠ ወረደባቸው፤ እነርሱም የሻለቃውንና ወታደሮችን ባዩ ጊዜ ጳውሎስን መምታት ተዉ።

verses.en: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
verses.fr: A l''instant il prit des soldats et des centeniers, et courut à eux. Voyant le tribun et les soldats, ils cessèrent de frapper Paul.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የሻለቃው ቀርቦ ያዘውና በሁለት ሰንሰለት ይታሰር ዘንድ አዞ ማን እንደ ሆነና ምን እንዳደረገ ጠየቀ።

verses.en: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
verses.fr: Alors le tribun s''approcha, se saisit de lui, et le fit lier de deux chaînes. Puis il demanda qui il était, et ce qu''il avait fait.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም እኵሌቶቹ እንዲህ እኵሌቶቹም እንዲያ እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር፤ ስለ ጫጫታውም እርግጡን ማወቅ ባልተቻለ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ወታደሮች ሰፈር ይወስዱት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
verses.fr: Mais dans la foule les uns criaient d''une manière, les autres d''une autre; ne pouvant donc rien apprendre de certain, à cause du tumulte, il ordonna de le mener dans la forteresse.
verses.am: ወደ ደረጃውም በደረሰ ጊዜ ስለ ሕዝቡ ግፊያ ወታደሮች እንዲሸከሙት ሆነ፤

verses.en: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
verses.fr: Lorsque Paul fut sur les degrés, il dut être porté par les soldats, à cause de la violence de la foule;
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብ። አስወግደው እያሉና እየጮኹ ይከተሉ ነበርና።

verses.en: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
verses.fr: car la multitude du peuple suivait, en criant: Fais-le mourir!
verses.am: ወደ ሰፈርም ሊያገቡት በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስ የሻለቃውን። አንድ ነገር ብነግርህ ትፈቅዳለህን? አለው። እርሱም። የግሪክ ቋንቋ ታውቃለህን?

verses.en: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
verses.fr: Au moment d''être introduit dans la forteresse, Paul dit au tribun: M''est-il permis de te dire quelque chose? Le tribun répondit: Tu sais le grec?
verses.am: አንተ ከዚህ ዘመን አስቀድሞ ከነፍሰ ገዳዮቹ አራቱን ሺህ ሰዎች አሸፍተህ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ያወጣህ የግብፅ ሰው አይደለህምን? አለ።

verses.en: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
verses.fr: Tu n''es donc pas cet Egyptien qui s''est révolté dernièrement, et qui a emmené dans le désert quatre mille brigands?
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን። እኔስ አይሁዳዊ በኪልቅያ ያለው የጠርሴስ ሰው ሆኜ ስመ ጥር በሆነ ከተማ የምኖር ነኝ፤ ለሕዝቡ እናገር ዘንድ እንድትፈቅድልኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
verses.fr: Je suis Juif, reprit Paul, de Tarse en Cilicie, citoyen d''une ville qui n''est pas sans importance. Permets-moi, je te prie, de parler au peuple.
verses.am: በፈቀደለትም ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በደረጃው ላይ ቆሞ በእጁ ወደ ሕዝቡ ጠቀሰ እጅግም ጸጥታ በሆነ ጊዜ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ እየተናገረ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
verses.fr: Le tribun le lui ayant permis, Paul, debout sur les degrés, fit signe de la main au peuple. Un profond silence s''établit, et Paul, parlant en langue hébraïque, dit:
verses.am: በፈቀደለትም ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በደረጃው ላይ ቆሞ በእጁ ወደ ሕዝቡ ጠቀሰ እጅግም ጸጥታ በሆነ ጊዜ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ እየተናገረ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
verses.fr: Hommes frères et pères, écoutez ce que j''ai maintenant à vous dire pour ma défense!
verses.am: እናንተ ወንድሞች አባቶችም፥ አሁን ለእናንተ ነገሬን ስገልጥ ስሙኝ።

verses.en: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils entendirent qu''il leur parlait en langue hébraïque, ils redoublèrent de silence. Et Paul dit:
verses.am: በዕብራይስጥም ቋንቋ ሲናገር በሰሙ ጊዜ ከፊት ይልቅ ዝም አሉ። እርሱም አለ።

verses.en: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
verses.fr: je suis Juif, né à Tarse en Cilicie; mais j''ai été élevé dans cette ville-ci, et instruit aux pieds de Gamaliel dans la connaissance exacte de la loi de nos pères, étant plein de zèle pour Dieu, comme vous l''êtes tous aujourd''hui.
verses.am: እኔ የኪልቅያ በምትሆን በጠርሴስ የተወለድሁ፥ በዚችም ከተማ በገማልያል እግር አጠገብ ያደግሁ፥ የአባቶችንም ሕግ ጠንቅቄ የተማርሁ፥ ዛሬውንም እናንተ ሁሉ እንድትሆኑ ለእግዚአብሔር ቀናተኛ የሆንሁ አይሁዳዊ ሰው ነኝ

verses.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
verses.fr: J''ai persécuté à mort cette doctrine, liant et mettant en prison hommes et femmes.
verses.am: ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም እያሰርሁ ወደ ወኅኒም አሳልፌ እየሰጠሁ ይህን መንገድ እስከ ሞት ድረስ አሳደድሁ።

verses.en: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
verses.fr: Le souverain sacrificateur et tout le collège des anciens m''en sont témoins. J''ai même reçu d''eux des lettres pour les frères de Damas, où je me rendis afin d''amener liés à Jérusalem ceux qui se trouvaient là et de les faire punir.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሊቀ ካህናቱ ደግሞ ሽማግሌዎቹም ሁሉ ይመሰክሩልኛል፤ ከእነርሱ ደግሞ መልእክትን ለወንድሞቻቸው ተቀብዬ፥ በደማስቆ ያሉትን ደግሞ ታስረው እንዲቀጡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላመጣ ወደዚያ እሄድ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
verses.fr: Comme j''étais en chemin, et que j''approchais de Damas, tout à coup, vers midi, une grande lumière venant du ciel resplendit autour de moi.
verses.am: ስሄድም ወደ ደማስቆ በቀረብሁ ጊዜ፥ ቀትር ሲሆን ድንገት ከሰማይ ታላቅ ብርሃን በዙሪያዬ አንጸባረቀ፤

verses.en: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.fr: Je tombai par terre, et j''entendis une voix qui me disait: Saul, Saul, pourquoi me persécutes-tu?
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ ወድቄ። ሳውል ሳውል፥ ስለ ምን ታሳድደኛለህ? የሚለኝን ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
verses.fr: Je répondis: Qui es-tu, Seigneur? Et il me dit: Je suis Jésus de Nazareth, que tu persécutes.
verses.am: እኔም መልሼ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ማን ነህ? አልሁ። እርሱም። አንተ የምታሳድደኝ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ እኔ ነኝ አለኝ።

verses.en: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient avec moi virent bien la lumière, mais ils n''entendirent pas la voix de celui qui parlait.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር የነበሩትም ብርሃኑን አይተው ፈሩ፥ የሚናገረኝን የእርሱን ድምፅ ግን አልሰሙም።

verses.en: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
verses.fr: Alors je dis: Que ferai-je, Seigneur? Et le Seigneur me dit: Lève-toi, va à Damas, et là on te dira tout ce que tu dois faire.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግ? አልሁት። ጌታም። ተነሥተህ ወደ ደማስቆ ሂድና ታደርገው ዘንድ ስለ ታዘዘው ሁሉን በዚያ ይነግሩሃል አለኝ።

verses.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
verses.fr: Comme je ne voyais rien, à cause de l''éclat de cette lumière, ceux qui étaient avec moi me prirent par la main, et j''arrivai à Damas.
verses.am: ከዚያ ብርሃንም ክብር የተነሣ ማየት ባይሆንልኝ ከእኔ ጋር የነበሩት ሰዎች እጄን ይዘው እየመሩኝ ወደ ደማስቆ ደረስሁ።

verses.en: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
verses.fr: Or, un nommé Ananias, homme pieux selon la loi, et de qui tous les Juifs demeurant à Damas rendaient un bon témoignage,
verses.am: በዚያም የኖሩት አይሁድ ሁሉ የመሰከሩለት እንደ ሕጉም በጸሎት የተጋ ሐናንያ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
verses.fr: vint se présenter à moi, et me dit: Saul, mon frère, recouvre la vue. Au même instant, je recouvrai la vue et je le regardai.
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ እኔ መጥቶ በአጠገቤም ቆሞ። ወንድሜ ሳውል ሆይ፥ እይ አለኝ። እኔም ያን ጊዜውን ወደ እርሱ አየሁ።

verses.en: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
verses.fr: Il dit: Le Dieu de nos pères t''a destiné à connaître sa volonté, à voir le Juste, et à entendre les paroles de sa bouche;
verses.am: እርሱም አለኝ። የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ፈቃዱን ታውቅ ዘንድና ጻድቁን ታይ ዘንድ ከአፉም ድምፅን ትሰማ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ መርጦሃል

verses.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
verses.fr: car tu lui serviras de témoin, auprès de tous les hommes, des choses que tu as vues et entendues.
verses.am: ባየኸውና በሰማኸው በሰው ሁሉ ፊት ምስክር ትሆንለታለህና።

verses.en: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, que tardes-tu? Lève-toi, sois baptisé, et lavé de tes péchés, en invoquant le nom du Seigneur.
verses.am: አሁንስ ለምን ትዘገያለህ? ተነሣና ስሙን እየጠራህ ተጠመቅ ከኃጢአትህም ታጠብ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
verses.fr: De retour à Jérusalem, comme je priais dans le temple, je fus ravi en extase,
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ከተመለሱ በኋላ በመቅደስ ስጸልይ ተመስጦ መጣብኝ፥

verses.en: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
verses.fr: et je vis le Seigneur qui me disait: Hâte-toi, et sors promptement de Jérusalem, parce qu''ils ne recevront pas ton témoignage sur moi.
verses.am: እርሱም። ፍጠን ከኢየሩሳሌምም ቶሎ ውጣ፥ ስለ እኔ የምትመሰክረውን አይቀበሉህምና ሲለኝ አየሁት።

verses.en: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
verses.fr: Et je dis: Seigneur, ils savent eux-mêmes que je faisais mettre en prison et battre de verges dans les synagogues ceux qui croyaient en toi,
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በአንተ የሚያምኑትን በምኵራብ ሁሉ እኔ በወኅኒ አገባና እደበድብ እንደ ነበርሁ እነርሱ ያውቃሉ፤

verses.en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
verses.fr: et que, lorsqu''on répandit le sang d''Etienne, ton témoin, j''étais moi-même présent, joignant mon approbation à celle des autres, et gardant les vêtements de ceux qui le faisaient mourir.
verses.am: የሰማዕትህንም የእስጢፋኖስን ደም ባፈሰሱ ጊዜ፥ ራሴ ደግሞ በአጠገባቸው ስቆም ተስማምቼ የገዳዮችን ልብስ እጠብቅ ነበር አልሁ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Alors il me dit: Va, je t''enverrai au loin vers les nations....
verses.am: እርሱም። ሂድ፥ እኔ ወደ አሕዛብ ከዚህ ወደ ሩቅ እልክሃለሁና አለኝ።

verses.en: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
verses.fr: Ils l''écoutèrent jusqu''à cette parole. Mais alors ils élevèrent la voix, disant: Ote de la terre un pareil homme! Il n''est pas digne de vivre.
verses.am: እስከዚህም ቃል ድረስ ይሰሙት ነበር፥ ድምፃቸውንም ከፍ አድርገው። እንደዚህ ያለውን ሰው ከምድር አስወግደው፥ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ አይገባውምና አሉ።

verses.en: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
verses.fr: Et ils poussaient des cris, jetaient leurs vêtements, lançaient de la poussière en l''air.
verses.am: ሲጮኹና ልብሳቸውን ሲወረውሩ ትቢያንም ወደ ላይ ሲበትኑ፥

verses.en: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
verses.fr: Le tribun commanda de faire entrer Paul dans la forteresse, et de lui donner la question par le fouet, afin de savoir pour quel motif ils criaient ainsi contre lui.
verses.am: የሻለቃው ወደ ሰፈሩ እንዲያገቡት አዘዘ፥ እንደዚህም የጮኹበትን ምክንያት ያውቅ ዘንድ። እየገረፋችሁ መርምሩት አላቸው።

verses.en: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on l''eut exposé au fouet, Paul dit au centenier qui était présent: Vous est-il permis de battre de verges un citoyen romain, qui n''est pas même condamné?
verses.am: በጠፍርም በገተሩት ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በአጠገቡ የቆመውን የመቶ አለቃ። የሮሜን ሰው ያለ ፍርድ ትገርፉ ዘንድ ተፈቅዶላችኋልን? አለው።

verses.en: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
verses.fr: A ces mots, le centenier alla vers le tribun pour l''avertir, disant: Que vas-tu faire? Cet homme est Romain.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃውም በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ሻለቃው ቀርቦ። ይህ ሰው ሮማዊ ነውና ታደርገው ዘንድ ካለህ ተጠበቅ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
verses.fr: Et le tribun, étant venu, dit à Paul: Dis-moi, es-tu Romain? Oui, répondit-il.
verses.am: የሻለቃውም ቀርቦ። አንተ ሮማዊ ነህን? ንገረኝ አለው፤ እርሱም። አዎን አለ።

verses.en: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
verses.fr: Le tribun reprit: C''est avec beaucoup d''argent que j''ai acquis ce droit de citoyen. Et moi, dit Paul, je l''ai par ma naissance.
verses.am: የሻለቃውም መልሶ። እኔ ይህን ዜግነት በብዙ ገንዘብ አገኘሁት አለ። ጳውሎስም። እኔ ግን በእርስዋ ተወለድሁ አለ።

verses.en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
verses.fr: Aussitôt ceux qui devaient lui donner la question se retirèrent, et le tribun, voyant que Paul était Romain, fut dans la crainte parce qu''il l''avait fait lier.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ሊመረምሩት ያሰቡት ከእርሱ ወዲያው ተለዩ፤ የሻለቃውም ደግሞ ሮማዊ መሆኑን ባወቀ ጊዜ ፈራ፥ አሳስሮት ነበርና።

verses.en: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, voulant savoir avec certitude de quoi les Juifs l''accusaient, le tribun lui fit ôter ses liens, et donna l''ordre aux principaux sacrificateurs et à tout le sanhédrin de se réunir; puis, faisant descendre Paul, il le plaça au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: በማግሥቱም አይሁድ የከሰሱት በምን ምክንያት እንደ ሆነ እርግጡን ያውቅ ዘንድ አስቦ ፈታው፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ሸንጎውም ሁሉ ይሰበሰቡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፥ ጳውሎስንም አውርዶ በፊታቸው አቆመው።

verses.en: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
verses.fr: Paul, les regards fixés sur le sanhédrin, dit: Hommes frères, c''est en toute bonne conscience que je me suis conduit jusqu''à ce jour devant Dieu...
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ሸንጎውን ትኵር ብሎ ተመልክቶ። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ እስከዚች ቀን ድረስ በመልካም ሕሊና ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኖሬአለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
verses.fr: Le souverain sacrificateur Ananias ordonna à ceux qui étaient près de lui de le frapper sur la bouche.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ሐናንያ አፉን ይመቱት ዘንድ በአጠገቡ ቆመው የነበሩትን አዘዘ።

verses.en: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
verses.fr: Alors Paul lui dit: Dieu te frappera, muraille blanchie! Tu es assis pour me juger selon la loi, et tu violes la loi en ordonnant qu''on me frappe!
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ። አንተ በኖራ የተለሰነ ግድግዳ፥ እግዚአብሔር አንተን ይመታ ዘንድ አለው፤ አንተ በሕግ ልትፈርድብኝ ተቀምጠህ ሳለህ ያለ ሕግ እመታ ዘንድ ታዛለህን? አለው።

verses.en: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient près de lui dirent: Tu insultes le souverain sacrificateur de Dieu!
verses.am: በአጠገቡ የቆሙትም። የእግዚአብሔርን ሊቀ ካህናት ትሳደባለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
verses.fr: Et Paul dit: Je ne savais pas, frères, que ce fût le souverain sacrificateur; car il est écrit: Tu ne parleras pas mal du chef de ton peuple.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሊቀ ካህናት መሆኑን ባላውቅ ነው፤ በሕዝብህ አለቃ ላይ ክፉ ቃል አትናገር ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና አላቸው።

verses.en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
verses.fr: Paul, sachant qu''une partie de l''assemblée était composée de sadducéens et l''autre de pharisiens, s''écria dans le sanhédrin: Hommes frères, je suis pharisien, fils de pharisiens; c''est à cause de l''espérance et de la résurrection des morts que je suis mis en jugement.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን እኵሌቶቹ ሰዱቃውያን እኵሌቶቹም ፈሪሳውያን መሆናቸውን አይቶ። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ፈሪሳዊ የፈሪሳዊም ልጅ ነኝ፤ ስለ ተስፋና ስለ ሙታን መነሣት ይፈርዱብኛል ብሎ በሸንጎው ጮኸ።

verses.en: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
verses.fr: Quand il eut dit cela, il s''éleva une discussion entre les pharisiens et les sadducéens, et l''assemblée se divisa.
verses.am: ይህንም ባለ ጊዜ በፈሪሳውያንና በሰዱቃውያን መካከል ጥል ሆነ ሸንጎውም ተለያየ።

verses.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
verses.fr: Car les sadducéens disent qu''il n''y a point de résurrection, et qu''il n''existe ni ange ni esprit, tandis que les pharisiens affirment les deux choses.
verses.am: ሰዱቃውያን። ትንሣኤም መልአክም መንፈስም የለም የሚሉ ናቸውና፤ ፈሪሳውያን ግን ሁለቱን ያምናሉ።

verses.en: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
verses.fr: Il y eut une grande clameur, et quelques scribes du parti des pharisiens, s''étant levés, engagèrent un vif débat, et dirent: Nous ne trouvons aucun mal en cet homme; peut-être un esprit ou un ange lui a-t-il parlé.
verses.am: ታላቅ ጩኸትም ሆነ፥ ከፈሪሳውያንም ወገን የሆኑት ጻፎች ተነሥተው። በዚህ ሰው ላይ ምንም ክፉ ነገር አላገኘንበትም፤ መንፈስ ወይስ መልአክ ተናግሮት ይሆን? ብለው ተከራከሩ።

verses.en: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
verses.fr: Comme la discorde allait croissant, le tribun craignant que Paul ne fût mis en pièces par ces gens, fit descendre les soldats pour l''enlever du milieu d''eux et le conduire à la forteresse.
verses.am: ብዙ ጥልም በሆነ ጊዜ የሻለቃው ጳውሎስን እንዳይገነጣጥሉት ፈርቶ ጭፍሮቹ ወርደው ከመካከላቸው እንዲነጥቁት ወደ ሰፈሩም እንዲያገቡት አዘዘ።

verses.en: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verses.fr: La nuit suivante, le Seigneur apparut à Paul, et dit: Prends courage; car, de même que tu as rendu témoignage de moi dans Jérusalem, il faut aussi que tu rendes témoignage dans Rome.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ሌሊት ጌታ በአጠገቡ ቆሞ። ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ስለ እኔ እንደ መሰከርህ እንዲሁ በሮሜም ትመሰክርልኝ ዘንድ ይገባሃልና አይዞህ አለው።

verses.en: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
verses.fr: Quand le jour fut venu, les Juifs formèrent un complot, et firent des imprécations contre eux-mêmes, en disant qu''ils s''abstiendraient de manger et de boire jusqu''à ce qu''ils eussent tué Paul.
verses.am: በጠባም ጊዜ አይሁድ ጳውሎስን እስኪገድሉት ድረስ እንዳይበሉና እንዳይጠጡ በመሐላ ተስማሙ።

verses.en: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
verses.fr: Ceux qui formèrent ce complot étaient plus de quarante,
verses.am: ይህንም ሴራ ያደረጉት ሰዎች ከአርባ ይበዙ ነበር፤

verses.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
verses.fr: et ils allèrent trouver les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens, auxquels ils dirent: Nous nous sommes engagés, avec des imprécations contre nous-mêmes, à ne rien manger jusqu''à ce que nous ayons tué Paul.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ካህናት አለቆችና ወደ ሽማግሌዎቹ መጥተው። ጳውሎስን እስክንገድል ድረስ ምንም እንዳንቀምስ ተረጋግመን ተማምለናል።

verses.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
verses.fr: Vous donc, maintenant, adressez-vous avec le sanhédrin au tribun, pour qu''il l''amène devant vous, comme si vous vouliez examiner sa cause plus exactement; et nous, avant qu''il approche, nous sommes prêts à le tuer.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አሁን እናንተ ከሸንጎው ጋር ሆናችሁ ስለ እርሱ አጥብቃችሁ እንደምትመረምሩ መስላችሁ ወደ እናንተ እንዲያወርደው ለሻለቃው አመልክቱት፤ እኛም ሳይቀርብ እንድንገድለው የተዘጋጀን ነን አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
verses.fr: Le fils de la soeur de Paul, ayant eu connaissance du guet-apens, alla dans la forteresse en informer Paul.
verses.am: የጳውሎስ የእኅቱ ልጅ ግን ደባቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ፥ መጥቶ ወደ ሰፈሩ ገባና ለጳውሎስ ነገረው።

verses.en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
verses.fr: Paul appela l''un des centeniers, et dit: Mène ce jeune homme vers le tribun, car il a quelque chose à lui rapporter.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ከመቶ አለቆች አንዱን ጠርቶ። ይህን ብላቴና ወደ ሻለቃው ውሰድ፥ የሚያወራለት ነገር አለውና አለው።

verses.en: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
verses.fr: Le centenier prit le jeune homme avec lui, le conduisit vers le tribun, et dit: Le prisonnier Paul m''a appelé, et il m''a prié de t''amener ce jeune homme, qui a quelque chose à te dire.
verses.am: እርሱም ይዞት ወደ ሻለቃው ወሰደውና። ይህ ብላቴና የሚነግርህ ነገር ስላለው እስረኛው ጳውሎስ ጠርቶ ወደ አንተ እንድወስደው ለመነኝ አለው።

verses.en: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
verses.fr: Le tribun, prenant le jeune homme par la main, et se retirant à l''écart, lui demanda: Qu''as-tu à m''annoncer?
verses.am: የሻለቃውም እጁን ይዞ ፈቀቅ አለና ለብቻው ሆኖ። የምታወራልኝ ነገር ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Les Juifs sont convenus de te prier d''amener Paul demain devant le sanhédrin, comme si tu devais t''enquérir de lui plus exactement.
verses.am: እርሱም። አይሁድ ስለ ጳውሎስ ከፊት ይልቅ አጥብቀህ እንደምትመረምር መስለህ፥ ነገ ወደ ሸንጎ ታወርደው ዘንድ ሊለምኑህ ተስማምተዋል።

verses.en: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
verses.fr: Ne les écoute pas, car plus de quarante d''entre eux lui dressent un guet-apens, et se sont engagés, avec des imprécations contre eux-mêmes, à ne rien manger ni boire jusqu''à ce qu''ils l''aient tué; maintenant ils sont prêts, et n''attendent que ton consentement.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አንተ በጅ አትበላቸው፤ እስኪገድሉት ድረስ እንዳይበሉና እንዳይጠጡ ተማምለው ከእነርሱ ከአርባ የሚበዙ ሰዎች ያደቡበታልና፤ አሁንም የተዘጋጁ ናቸው የአንተንም ምላሽ ይጠብቃሉ አለው።

verses.en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
verses.fr: Le tribun renvoya le jeune homme, après lui avoir recommandé de ne parler à personne de ce rapport qu''il lui avait fait.
verses.am: የሻለቃውም። ይህን ነገር ለእኔ ማመልከትህን ለማንም እንዳትገልጥ ብሎ ካዘዘ በኋላ ብላቴናውን አሰናበተው።

verses.en: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
verses.fr: Ensuite il appela deux des centeniers, et dit: Tenez prêts, dès la troisième heure de la nuit, deux cents soldats, soixante-dix cavaliers et deux cents archers, pour aller jusqu''à Césarée.
verses.am: ከመቶ አለቆቹም ሁለት ጠርቶ። ወደ ቂሣርያ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ሁለት መቶ ወታደሮችንና ሰባ ፈረሰኞችን ሁለት መቶም ባለ ጦር መሣሪያዎችን ከሌሊቱ በሦስተኛው ሰዓት አዘጋጁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
verses.fr: Qu''il y ait aussi des montures pour Paul, afin qu''on le mène sain et sauf au gouverneur Félix.
verses.am: ጳውሎስንም ወደ አገረ ገዡ ወደ ፊልክስ በደኅና እንዲያደርሱት የሚያስቀምጡበትን ከብት ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
verses.fr: Il écrivit une lettre ainsi conçue:
verses.am: ደብዳቤም ጻፈ እንዲህ የሚል።

verses.en: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
verses.fr: Claude Lysias au très excellent gouverneur Félix, salut!
verses.am: ከቀላውዴዎስ ሉስዮስ ወደ ክቡር አገረ ገዡ ወደ ፊልክስ፤ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን።

verses.en: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
verses.fr: Cet homme, dont les Juifs s''étaient saisis, allait être tué par eux, lorsque je survins avec des soldats et le leur enlevai, ayant appris qu''il était Romain.
verses.am: ይህን ሰው አይሁድ ይዘው ሊገድሉት ባሰቡ ጊዜ ከጭፍሮቹ ጋር ደርሼ አዳንሁት፥ ሮማዊ እንደ ሆነ አውቄ ነበርና።

verses.en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
verses.fr: Voulant connaître le motif pour lequel ils l''accusaient, je l''amenai devant leur sanhédrin.
verses.am: የሚከሰስበትንም ምክንያት አውቅ ዘንድ አስቤ ወደ ሸንጎአቸው አወረድሁት፤

verses.en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
verses.fr: J''ai trouvé qu''il était accusé au sujet de questions relatives à leur loi, mais qu''il n''avait commis aucun crime qui mérite la mort ou la prison.
verses.am: በሕጋቸውም ስለ መከራከር እንደ ከሰሱት አገኘሁ እንጂ ለሞት ወይም ለእስራት የሚያደርስ ክስ አይደለም።

verses.en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.
verses.fr: Informé que les Juifs lui dressaient des embûches, je te l''ai aussitôt envoyé, en faisant savoir à ses accusateurs qu''ils eussent à s''adresser eux-mêmes à toi. Adieu.
verses.am: በዚህም ሰው አይሁድ ሴራ እንዲያደርጉበት ባመለከቱኝ ጊዜ ያን ጊዜውን ወደ አንተ ሰደድሁት፥ ከሳሾቹንም ደግሞ በፊትህ ይከሱት ዘንድ አዘዝኋቸው። ደኅና ሁን።

verses.en: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.
verses.fr: Les soldats, selon l''ordre qu''ils avaient reçu, prirent Paul, et le conduisirent pendant la nuit jusqu''à Antipatris.
verses.am: ወታደሮቹም እንደ ታዘዙት ጳውሎስን ይዘው በሌሊት ወደ አንቲጳጥሪስ አደረሱት፤

verses.en: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
verses.fr: Le lendemain, laissant les cavaliers poursuivre la route avec lui, ils retournèrent à la forteresse.
verses.am: በነገውም ከእርሱ ጋር ይሄዱ ዘንድ ፈረሰኞችን ትተው ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Who, when they came to Caesarea and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
verses.fr: Arrivés à Césarée, les cavaliers remirent la lettre au gouverneur, et lui présentèrent Paul.
verses.am: እነዚያም ወደ ቂሣርያ ገብተው ደብዳቤውን ለአገረ ገዡ በሰጡ ጊዜ ጳውሎስን ደግሞ በፊቱ አቆሙት።

verses.en: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;
verses.fr: Le gouverneur, après avoir lu la lettre, demanda de quelle province était Paul. Ayant appris qu''il était de la Cilicie:
verses.am: ካነበበውም በኋላ የወዴት አውራጃ እንደ ሆነ ጠየቀው፤ የኪልቅያ ሰው መሆኑንም ባወቀ ጊዜ።

verses.en: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
verses.fr: Je t''entendrai, dit-il, quand tes accusateurs seront venus. Et il ordonna qu''on le gardât dans le prétoire d''Hérode.
verses.am: ከሳሾችህ ደግሞ ሲመጡ እሰማሃለሁ አለው፤ በሄሮድስም ግቢ ውስጥ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
verses.fr: Cinq jours après, arriva le souverain sacrificateur Ananias, avec des anciens et un orateur nommé Tertulle. Ils portèrent plainte au gouverneur contre Paul.
verses.am: ከአምስት ቀንም በኋላ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ሐናንያ ከሽማግሌዎችና ጠርጠሉስ ከሚሉት ከአንድ ጠበቃ ጋር ወረደ፤ እነርሱም ስለ ጳውሎስ ለአገረ ገዡ አመለከቱት።

verses.en: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
verses.fr: Paul fut appelé, et Tertulle se mit à l''accuser, en ces termes:

verses.en: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.fr: Très excellent Félix, tu nous fais jouir d''une paix profonde, et cette nation a obtenu de salutaires réformes par tes soins prévoyants; c''est ce que nous reconnaissons en tout et partout avec une entière gratitude.
verses.am: በተጠራም ጊዜ ጠርጠሉስ ይከሰው ዘንድ ጀመረ እንዲህ እያለ። ክቡር ፊልክስ ሆይ፥ በአንተ በኩል ብዙ ሰላም ስለምናገኝ ለዚህም ሕዝብ በአሳብህ በየነገሩ በየስፍራውም መልካም መሻሻል ስለሚሆንለት፥ በፍጹም ምስጋና እንቀበለዋለን።

verses.en: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
verses.fr: Mais, pour ne pas te retenir davantage, je te prie d''écouter, dans ta bonté, ce que nous avons à dire en peu de mots.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እጅግ እንዳላቆይህ በቸርነትህ በአጭሩ ትሰማን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
verses.fr: Nous avons trouvé cet homme, qui est une peste, qui excite des divisions parmi tous les Juifs du monde, qui est chef de la secte des Nazaréens,
verses.am: ይህ ሰው በሽታ ሆኖ በዓለም ባሉት አይሁድ ሁሉ ሁከት ሲያስነሣ፥ የመናፍቃን የናዝራውያን ወገን መሪ ሆኖ አግኝተነዋልና፤

verses.en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
verses.fr: et qui même a tenté de profaner le temple. Et nous l''avons arrêté. Nous avons voulu le juger selon notre loi;
verses.am: መቅደስንም ደግሞ ሊያረክስ ሲሞክር ያዝነው፥ እንደ ሕጋችንም እንፈርድበት ዘንድ ወደድን።

verses.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,
verses.fr: mais le tribun Lysias étant survenu, l''a arraché de nos mains avec une grande violence,
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሻለቃው ሉስዮስ መጥቶ በብዙ ኃይል ከእጃችን ወሰደው፥

verses.en: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
verses.fr: en ordonnant à ses accusateurs de venir devant toi. Tu pourras toi-même, en l''interrogeant, apprendre de lui tout ce dont nous l''accusons.
verses.am: ከሳሾቹንም ወደ አንተ ይመጡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ አንተም ራስህ እርሱን መርምረህ እኛ ስለምንከስበት ነገር ሁሉ ልታውቅ ትችላለህ።

verses.en: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
verses.fr: Les Juifs se joignirent à l''accusation, soutenant que les choses étaient ainsi.
verses.am: አይሁድም ደግሞ። ይህ ነገር እንዲሁ ነው እያሉ ተስማሙ።

verses.en: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
verses.fr: Après que le gouverneur lui eut fait signe de parler, Paul répondit: Sachant que, depuis plusieurs années, tu es juge de cette nation, c''est avec confiance que je prends la parole pour défendre ma cause.
verses.am: ገዡም በጠቀሰው ጊዜ ጳውሎስ መለሰ እንዲህ ሲል። ከብዙ ዘመን ጀምረህ ለዚህ ሕዝብ አንተ ፈራጅ እንደ ሆንህ አውቃለሁና ደስ እያለኝ ስለ እኔ ነገር እመልሳለሁ፤

verses.en: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
verses.fr: Il n''y a pas plus de douze jours, tu peux t''en assurer, que je suis monté à Jérusalem pour adorer.
verses.am: እሰግድ ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ከወጣሁ ከአሥራ ሁለት ቀን እንዳይበልጥ ልታውቀው ትችላለህ።

verses.en: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
verses.fr: On ne m''a trouvé ni dans le temple, ni dans les synagogues, ni dans la ville, disputant avec quelqu''un, ou provoquant un rassemblement séditieux de la foule.
verses.am: ከአንድም ስንኳ ስነጋገር ወይም ሕዝብን ስሰበስብ በመቅደስ ቢሆን በምኵራብም ቢሆን በከተማም ቢሆን አላገኙኝም።

verses.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
verses.fr: Et ils ne sauraient prouver ce dont ils m''accusent maintenant.
verses.am: አሁንም ስለሚከሱኝ ያስረዱህ ዘንድ አይችሉም።

verses.en: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
verses.fr: Je t''avoue bien que je sers le Dieu de mes pères selon la voie qu''ils appellent une secte, croyant tout ce qui est écrit dans la loi et dans les prophètes,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን እመሰክርልሃለሁ፤ በሕጉ ያለውን በነቢያትም የተጻፉትን ሁሉ አምኜ የአባቶቼን አምላክ እነርሱ ኑፋቄ ብለው እንደሚጠሩት መንገድ አመልካለሁ፤

verses.en: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
verses.fr: et ayant en Dieu cette espérance, comme ils l''ont eux-mêmes, qu''il y aura une résurrection des justes et des injustes.
verses.am: እነዚህም ራሳቸው ደግሞ የሚጠብቁት፥ ጻድቃንም ዓመፀኞችም ከሙታን ይነሡ ዘንድ እንዳላቸው ተስፋ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አለኝ።

verses.en: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void to offence toward God, and toward men.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je m''efforce d''avoir constamment une conscience sans reproche devant Dieu et devant les hommes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት ሁልጊዜ ነውር የሌለባት ሕሊና ትኖረኝ ዘንድ እተጋለሁ።

verses.en: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
verses.fr: Après une absence de plusieurs années, je suis venu pour faire des aumônes à ma nation, et pour présenter des offrandes.
verses.am: ከብዙ ዓመትም በኋላ ለሕዝቤ ምጽዋትና መሥዋዕት አደርግ ዘንድ መጣሁ፤

verses.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
verses.fr: C''est alors que quelques Juifs d''Asie m''ont trouvé purifié dans le temple, sans attroupement ni tumulte.
verses.am: ይህንም ሳደርግ ሳለሁ ሕዝብ ሳይሰበሰብ ሁከትም ሳይሆን በመቅደስ ስነጻ አገኙኝ።

verses.en: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
verses.fr: C''était à eux de paraître en ta présence et de se porter accusateurs, s''ils avaient quelque chose contre moi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእኔ ላይ ነገር ያላቸው እንደ ሆነ፥ በፊትህ መጥተው ይከሱኝ ዘንድ የሚገባቸው ከእስያ የመጡ አንዳንድ አይሁድ አሉ።

verses.en: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
verses.fr: Ou bien, que ceux-ci déclarent de quel crime ils m''ont trouvé coupable, lorsque j''ai comparu devant le sanhédrin,
verses.am: ፊልክስ ግን የመንገዱን ነገር አጥብቆ አውቆአልና። የሻለቃው ሉስዮስ በወረደ ጊዜ ነገራችሁን እቆርጣለሁ ብሎ ወደ ፊት አዘገያቸው።

verses.en: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
verses.fr: moins que ce ne soit uniquement de ce cri que j''ai fait entendre au milieu d''eux: C''est à cause de la résurrection des morts que je suis aujourd''hui mis en jugement devant vous.
verses.am: ፊልክስ ግን የመንገዱን ነገር አጥብቆ አውቆአልና። የሻለቃው ሉስዮስ በወረደ ጊዜ ነገራችሁን እቆርጣለሁ ብሎ ወደ ፊት አዘገያቸው።

verses.en: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
verses.fr: Félix, qui savait assez exactement ce qui concernait cette doctrine, les ajourna, en disant: Quand le tribun Lysias sera venu, j''examinerai votre affaire.
verses.am: የመቶውንም አለቃ ጳውሎስን ሲጠብቅ እንዲያደላለት፥ ከወዳጆቹም ማንም ሲያገለግለው ወይም ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ እንዳይከለክልበት አዘዘው።

verses.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
verses.fr: Et il donna l''ordre au centenier de garder Paul, en lui laissant une certaine liberté, et en n''empêchant aucun des siens de lui rendre des services.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ፊልክስ አይሁዳዊት ከነበረች ድሩሲላ ከሚሉአት ከሚስቱ ጋር መጥቶ ጳውሎስን አስመጣ፥ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ስለ ማመን የሚናገረውን ሰማው።

verses.en: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
verses.fr: Quelques jours après, Félix vint avec Drusille, sa femme, qui était Juive, et il fit appeler Paul. Il l''entendit sur la foi en Christ.
verses.am: እርሱም ስለ ጽድቅና ራስን ስለ መግዛት ስለሚመጣውም ኵነኔ ሲነጋገር ሳለ፥ ፊልክስ ፈርቶ። አሁንስ ሂድ፥ በተመቸኝም ጊዜ ልኬ አስጠራሃለሁ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verses.fr: Mais, comme Paul discourait sur la justice, sur la tempérance, et sur le jugement à venir, Félix, effrayé, dit: Pour le moment retire-toi; quand j''en trouverai l''occasion, je te rappellerai.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜም ደግሞ እንዲፈታው ጳውሎስ ገንዘብ ይሰጠው ዘንድ ተስፋ አደረገ፤ ስለዚህ ደግሞ ብዙ ጊዜ እያስመጣ ያነጋግረው ነበር።

verses.en: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
verses.fr: Il espérait en même temps que Paul lui donnerait de l''argent; aussi l''envoyait-il chercher assez fréquemment, pour s''entretenir avec lui.
verses.am: ሁለት ዓመትም ከሞላ በኋላ ጶርቅዮስ ፊስጦስ በፊልክስ ፈንታ ተተካ። ፊልክስም አይሁድን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ወዶ ጳውሎስን እንደ ታሰረ ተወው።

verses.en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
verses.fr: Deux ans s''écoulèrent ainsi, et Félix eut pour successeur Porcius Festus. Dans le désir de plaire aux Juifs, Félix laissa Paul en prison.
verses.am: ሁለት ዓመትም ከሞላ በኋላ ጶርቅዮስ ፊስጦስ በፊልክስ ፈንታ ተተካ። ፊልክስም አይሁድን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ወዶ ጳውሎስን እንደ ታሰረ ተወው።

verses.en: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Festus, étant arrivé dans la province, monta trois jours après de Césarée à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ፊስጦስም ወደ አውራጃው ገብቶ ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ከቂሣርያ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et les principaux d''entre les Juifs lui portèrent plainte contre Paul. Ils firent des instances auprès de lui, et,
verses.am: የካህናቱ አለቆችና የአይሁድም ታላላቆች በጳውሎስ ላይ አመለከቱ፥

verses.en: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
verses.fr: dans des vues hostiles, lui demandèrent comme une faveur qu''il le fît venir à Jérusalem. Ils préparaient un guet-apens, pour le tuer en chemin.
verses.am: ጳውሎስንም ሲቃወም እንዲያደላላቸው እየለመኑ፥ በመንገድ ሸምቀው ይገድሉት ዘንድ አስበው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲያስመጣው ማለዱት።

verses.en: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.
verses.fr: Festus répondit que Paul était gardé à Césarée, et que lui-même devait partir sous peu.
verses.am: ፊስጦስ ግን ጳውሎስ በቂሳርያ እንዲጠበቅ እርሱም ራሱ ወደዚያ ፈጥኖ ይሄድ ዘንድ እንዳለው መለሰላቸው፤

verses.en: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
verses.fr: Que les principaux d''entre vous descendent avec moi, dit-il, et s''il y a quelque chose de coupable en cet homme, qu''ils l''accusent.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በዚህ ሰው ክፋት ቢሆን ከእናንተ ዘንድ ያሉት ባለ ስልጣኖች ከእኔ ጋር ወርደው ይክሰሱት አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
verses.fr: Festus ne passa que huit à dix jours parmi eux, puis il descendit à Césarée. Le lendemain, s''étant assis sur son tribunal, il donna l''ordre qu''on amenât Paul.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ዘንድ ከስምንት ወይም ከአስር የማይበልጥ ቀን ተቀምጦ ወደ ቂሳርያ ወረደ፤ በነገውም በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀምጦ ጳውሎስን ያመጡት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
verses.fr: Quand il fut arrivé, les Juifs qui étaient venus de Jérusalem l''entourèrent, et portèrent contre lui de nombreuses et graves accusations, qu''ils n''étaient pas en état de prouver.
verses.am: በቀረበም ጊዜ ከኢየሩሳሌም የወረዱት አይሁድ ከበውት ቆሙ፥ ይረቱበትም ዘንድ የማይችሉትን ብዙና ከባድ ክስ አነሱበት፤

verses.en: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.
verses.fr: Paul entreprit sa défense, en disant: Je n''ai rien fait de coupable, ni contre la loi des Juifs, ni contre le temple, ni contre César.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም ሲምዋገት። የአይሁድን ህግ ቢሆን መቅደስንም ቢሆን ቄሳርንም ቢሆን አንዳች ስንኳ አልበደልሁም አለ።

verses.en: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
verses.fr: Festus, désirant plaire aux Juifs, répondit à Paul: Veux-tu monter à Jérusalem, et y être jugé sur ces choses en ma présence?
verses.am: ፊስጦስ ግን አይሁድን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ወዶ ጳውሎስን። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጥተህ ስለዚህ ነገር ከዚያው በፊቴ ትፋረድ ዘንድ ትወዳለህን? ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
verses.fr: Paul dit: C''est devant le tribunal de César que je comparais, c''est là que je dois être jugé. Je n''ai fait aucun tort aux Juifs, comme tu le sais fort bien.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን። እፋረድበት ዘንድ በሚገባኝ በቄሳር ፍርድ ወንበር ፊት ቆሜአለሁ። አንተው ደግሞ ፈጽመህ እንደምታውቅ አይሁድን ምንም አልበደልሁም።

verses.en: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.
verses.fr: Si j''ai commis quelque injustice, ou quelque crime digne de mort, je ne refuse pas de mourir; mais, si les choses dont ils m''accusent sont fausses, personne n''a le droit de me livrer à eux. J''en appelle à César.
