verses.am: እንግዲህ በድዬ ወይም ሞት የሚገባውን ነገር አድርጌ እንደ ሆነ ከሞት ልዳን አልልም፤ እነዚህ የሚከሱኝ ክስ ከንቱ እንደሆነ ግን ለእነርሱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠኝ ዘንድ ማንም አይችልም፤ ወደ ቄሳር ይግባኝ ብዬአለሁ አለ።

verses.en: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.
verses.fr: Alors Festus, après avoir délibéré avec le conseil, répondit: Tu en as appelé à César; tu iras devant César.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ፊስጦስ ከአማካሪዎቹ ጋር ተማክሮ። ወደ ቄሳር ይግባኝ ብለሃል፤ ወደ ቄሳር ትሄዳለህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
verses.fr: Quelques jours après, le roi Agrippa et Bérénice arrivèrent à Césarée, pour saluer Festus.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ንጉሡ አግሪጳ በርኒቄም ለፊስጦስ ሰላምታ እንዲያቀርቡ ወደ ቂሳርያ ወረዱ።

verses.en: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
verses.fr: Comme ils passèrent là plusieurs jours, Festus exposa au roi l''affaire de Paul, et dit: Félix a laissé prisonnier un homme
verses.am: በዚያውም ብዙ ቀን ስለተቀመጡ ፊስጦስ የጳውሎስን ነገር ለንጉሡ እንዲህ ብሎ ገለጠ። ፊልክስ አስሮ የተወው አንድ ሰው በዚህ አለ፤

verses.en: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.
verses.fr: contre lequel, lorsque j''étais à Jérusalem, les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens des Juifs ont porté plainte, en demandant sa condamnation.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ሳለሁ የካህናት አለቆችና የአይሁድ ሽማግሌዎች እፈርድበት ዘንድ እየለመኑ ስለ እርሱ አመለከቱኝ።

verses.en: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.
verses.fr: Je leur ai répondu que ce n''est pas la coutume des Romains de livrer un homme avant que l''inculpé ait été mis en présence de ses accusateurs, et qu''il ait eu la faculté de se défendre sur les choses dont on l''accuse.
verses.am: እኔም። ተከሳሹ በከሳሾቹ ፊት ለፊት ሳይቆም ለተከሰሰበትም መልስ ይሰጥ ዘንድ ፈንታ ሳያገኝ፥ ማንንም ቢሆን አሳልፎ መስጠት የሮማውያን ሥርዓት አይደለም ብዬ መለስሁላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.
verses.fr: Ils sont donc venus ici, et, sans différer, je m''assis le lendemain sur mon tribunal, et je donnai l''ordre qu''on amenât cet homme.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በዚህ በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ፥ ሳልዘገይ በማግሥቱ በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀምጬ ያንን ሰው ያመጡት ዘንድ አዘዝሁ።

verses.en: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
verses.fr: Les accusateurs, s''étant présentés, ne lui imputèrent rien de ce que je supposais;
verses.am: ከሳሾቹም በቆሙ ጊዜ እኔ ያሰብሁትን ክፉ ነገር ክስ ምንም አላመጡበትም፤

verses.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
verses.fr: ils avaient avec lui des discussions relatives à leur religion particulière, et à un certain Jésus qui est mort, et que Paul affirmait être vivant.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስለ ገዛ ሃይማኖታቸውና ጳውሎስ። ሕያው ነው ስለሚለው ስለ ሞተው ኢየሱስ ስለ ተባለው ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
verses.fr: Ne sachant quel parti prendre dans ce débat, je lui demandai s''il voulait aller à Jérusalem, et y être jugé sur ces choses.
verses.am: እኔም ይህን ነገር እንዴት እንድመረምር አመንትቼ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄደህ በዚህ ነገር ከዚያ ልትፋረድ ትወዳለህን? አልሁት።

verses.en: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.
verses.fr: Mais Paul en ayant appelé, pour que sa cause fût réservée à la connaissance de l''empereur, j''ai ordonné qu''on le gardât jusqu''à ce que je l''envoyasse à César.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን አውግስጦስ ቄሣር እስኪቈርጥ ድረስ እንዲጠበቅ ይግባኝ ባለ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቄሣር እስክሰደው ድረስ ይጠበቅ ዘንድ አዘዝሁ።

verses.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
verses.fr: Agrippa dit à Festus: Je voudrais aussi entendre cet homme. Demain, répondit Festus, tu l''entendras.
verses.am: አግሪጳም ፊስጦስን። ያንንስ ሰው እኔ ዳግም እኮ እሰማው ዘንድ እወድ ነበር አለው። እርሱም። ነገ ትሰማዋለህ አለው።

verses.en: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.
verses.fr: Le lendemain donc, Agrippa et Bérénice vinrent en grande pompe, et entrèrent dans le lieu de l''audience avec les tribuns et les principaux de la ville. Sur l''ordre de Festus, Paul fut amené.
verses.am: በነገውም አግሪጳና በርኒቄ በብዙ ግርማ መጥተው ከሻለቆችና ከከተማው ታላላቆች ጋር ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ገቡ፤ ፊስጦስም ባዘዘ ጊዜ ጳውሎስን አመጡት።

verses.en: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
verses.fr: Alors Festus dit: Roi Agrippa, et vous tous qui êtes présents avec nous, vous voyez cet homme au sujet duquel toute la multitude des Juifs s''est adressée à moi, soit à Jérusalem, soit ici, en s''écriant qu''il ne devait plus vivre.
verses.am: ፊስጦስም አለ። አግሪጳ ንጉሥ ሆይ እናንተም ከእኛ ጋር ያላችሁ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ እንዳይገባው እየጮኹ የአይሁድ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም በዚህም ስለ እርሱ የለመኑኝን ይህን ሰው ታዩታላችሁ።

verses.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.
verses.fr: Pour moi, ayant reconnu qu''il n''a rien fait qui mérite la mort, et lui-même en ayant appelé à l''empereur, j''ai résolu de le faire partir.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ሞት የሚገባውን ነገር እንዳላደረገ አስተዋልሁ፥ እርሱም ወደ አውግስጦስ ይግባኝ ስላለ እሰደው ዘንድ ቈረጥሁ።

verses.en: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.
verses.fr: Je n''ai rien de certain à écrire à l''empereur sur son compte; c''est pourquoi je l''ai fait paraître devant vous, et surtout devant toi, roi Agrippa, afin de savoir qu''écrire, après qu''il aura été examiné.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም ወደ ጌታዬ የምጽፈው እርግጥ ነገር የለኝም፤ ስለዚህ ከተመረመረ በኋላ የምጽፈውን ነገር አገኝ ዘንድ በፊታችሁ ይልቁንም በፊትህ፥ ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ አመጣሁት፤

verses.en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.
verses.fr: Car il me semble absurde d''envoyer un prisonnier sans indiquer de quoi on l''accuse.
verses.am: እስረኛ ሲላክ የተከሰሰበትን ምክንያት ደግሞ አለማመልከት ሞኝነት መስሎኛልና።

verses.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:
verses.fr: Agrippa dit à Paul: Il t''est permis de parler pour ta défense. Et Paul, ayant étendu la main, se justifia en ces termes:
verses.am: አግሪጳም ጳውሎስን። ስለ ራስህ ትናገር ዘንድ ተፈቅዶልሃል አለው። በዚያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ እጁን ዘርግቶ መለሰ እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.en: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:
verses.fr: Je m''estime heureux, roi Agrippa, d''avoir aujourd''hui à me justifier devant toi de toutes les choses dont je suis accusé par les Juifs,

verses.en: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
verses.fr: car tu connais parfaitement leurs coutumes et leurs discussions. Je te prie donc de m''écouter avec patience.
verses.am: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ የአይሁድን ሥርዓት ክርክርንም ሁሉ አጥብቀህ አውቀሃልና በአይሁድ በተከሰስሁበት ነገር ሁሉ ዛሬ በፊትህ ስለምመልስ ራሴን እጅግ እንደ ተመረቀ አድርጌ እቈጥረዋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ በትዕግሥት ትሰማኝ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.en: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
verses.fr: Ma vie, dès les premiers temps de ma jeunesse, est connue de tous les Juifs, puisqu''elle s''est passée à Jérusalem, au milieu de ma nation.
verses.am: ከመጀመሪያ አንሥቶ በሕዝቤ መካከል በኢየሩሳሌም የሆነውን፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሬ የኖርሁትን ኑሮዬን አይሁድ ሁሉ ያውቃሉ፤

verses.en: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
verses.fr: Ils savent depuis longtemps, s''ils veulent le déclarer, que j''ai vécu pharisien, selon la secte la plus rigide de notre religion.
verses.am: ሊመሰክሩ ይወዱ እንደ ሆነ፥ በአምልኮአችን ከሁሉ ይልቅ ሕግን በመጠንቀቅ እንደሚተጋ ወገን ፈሪሳዊ ሆኜ እንደኖርሁ ከጥንት ጀምረው አውቀውኛልና።

verses.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God, unto our fathers:
verses.fr: Et maintenant, je suis mis en jugement parce que j''espère l''accomplissement de la promesse que Dieu a faite à nos pères,
verses.am: አሁንም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን ስለ ተሰጠው ስለ ተስፋ ቃል አለኝታ ልፋረድ ቆሜአለሁ።

verses.en: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
verses.fr: et à laquelle aspirent nos douze tribus, qui servent Dieu continuellement nuit et jour. C''est pour cette espérance, ô roi, que je suis accusé par des Juifs!
verses.am: ወደዚህም ወደ ተስፋ ቃል አሥራ ሁለቱ ወገኖቻችን ሌሊትና ቀን በትጋት እያመለኩ ይደርሱ ዘንድ አለኝታ አላቸው፤ ስለዚህም አለኝታ፥ ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ከአይሁድ እከሰሳለሁ።

verses.en: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
verses.fr: Quoi! vous semble-t-il incroyable que Dieu ressuscite les morts?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙታንን የሚያስነሣ እንደ ሆነ ስለ ምን በእናንተ ዘንድ የማይታመን ነገር ሆኖ ይቈጠራል?

verses.en: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.fr: Pour moi, j''avais cru devoir agir vigoureusement contre le nom de Jésus de Nazareth.
verses.am: እኔም ራሴ የናዝሬቱን የኢየሱስን ስም የሚቃወም እጅግ ነገር አደርግ ዘንድ እንዲገባኝ ይመስለኝ ነበር።

verses.en: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.
verses.fr: C''est ce que j''ai fait à Jérusalem. J''ai jeté en prison plusieurs des saints, ayant reçu ce pouvoir des principaux sacrificateurs, et, quand on les mettait à mort, je joignais mon suffrage à celui des autres.
verses.am: ይህንም ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም አደረግሁት፤ ከካህናት አለቆችም ሥልጣን ተቀብዬ እኔ ከቅዱሳን ብዙዎችን በወኅኒ አሳሰርኋቸው፥ ሲገድሉአቸውም አብሬ ተቸሁ።

verses.en: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.
verses.fr: je les ai souvent châtiés dans toutes les synagogues, et je les forçais à blasphémer. Dans mes excès de fureur contre eux, je les persécutais même jusque dans les villes étrangères.
verses.am: በምኵራብም ሁሉ ብዙ ጊዜ እየቀጣሁ ይሰድቡት ዘንድ ግድ አልኋቸው፤ ያለ ልክ ስቈጣባቸውም እስከ ውጭ አገር ከተማዎች ድረስ እንኳ አሳድድ ነበር።

verses.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
verses.fr: C''est dans ce but que je me rendis à Damas, avec l''autorisation et la permission des principaux sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ነገ ከካህናት አለቆች ሥልጣንና ትእዛዝ ተቀብዬ ወደ ደማስቆ ስሄድ፥

verses.en: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
verses.fr: Vers le milieu du jour, ô roi, je vis en chemin resplendir autour de moi et de mes compagnons une lumière venant du ciel, et dont l''éclat surpassait celui du soleil.
verses.am: ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በመንገድ ሳለሁ እኩል ቀን ሲሆን በዙሪያዬና ከእኔ ጋር በሄዱት ዙሪያ ከፀሐይ ብሩህነት የበለጠ ብርሃን ከሰማይ ሲበራ አየሁ፤

verses.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.fr: Nous tombâmes tous par terre, et j''entendis une voix qui me disait en langue hébraïque: Saul, Saul, pourquoi me persécutes-tu? Il te serait dur de regimber contre les aiguillons.
verses.am: ሁላችንም በምድር ላይ በወደቅን ጊዜ። ሳውል ሳውል፥ ስለ ምን ታሳድደኛለህ? የመውጊያውን ብረት ብትቃወም ለአንተ ይብስብሃል የሚል ድምፅ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ ሲናገረኝ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
verses.fr: Je répondis: Qui es-tu, Seigneur? Et le Seigneur dit: Je suis Jésus que tu persécutes.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ማንነህ? አልሁ። እርሱም አለኝ። አንተ የምታሳድደኝ እኔ ኢየሱስ ነኝ።

verses.en: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
verses.fr: Mais lève-toi, et tiens-toi sur tes pieds; car je te suis apparu pour t''établir ministre et témoin des choses que tu as vues et de celles pour lesquelles je t''apparaîtrai.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ተነሣና በእግርህ ቁም፤ ስለዚህ እኔን ባየህበት ነገር ለአንተም በምታይበት ነገር አገልጋይና ምስክር ትሆን ዘንድ ልሾምህ ታይቼልሃለሁና።

verses.en: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
verses.fr: Je t''ai choisi du milieu de ce peuple et du milieu des païens, vers qui je t''envoie,
verses.am: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ከሰማይ የታየኝን ራእይ እምቢ አላልሁም።

verses.en: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
verses.fr: afin que tu leur ouvres les yeux, pour qu''ils passent des ténèbres à la lumière et de la puissance de Satan à Dieu, pour qu''ils reçoivent, par la foi en moi, le pardon des péchés et l''héritage avec les sanctifiés.
verses.am: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ከሰማይ የታየኝን ራእይ እምቢ አላልሁም።

verses.en: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
verses.fr: En conséquence, roi Agrippa, je n''ai point résisté à la vision céleste:
verses.am: ነገር ግን አስቀድሜ በደማስቆ ላሉት በኢየሩሳሌምም በይሁዳም አገር ሁሉ ለአሕዛብም ንስሐ ይገቡ ዘንድና ለንስሐ የሚገባ ነገር እያደረጉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘወር ይሉ ዘንድ ተናገርሁ።

verses.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
verses.fr: à ceux de Damas d''abord, puis à Jérusalem, dans toute la Judée, et chez les païens, j''ai prêché la repentance et la conversion à Dieu, avec la pratique d''oeuvres dignes de la repentance.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አይሁድ በመቅደስ ያዙኝ ሊገድሉኝም ሞከሩ።

verses.en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi les Juifs se sont saisis de moi dans le temple, et ont tâché de me faire périr.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ ስለ ራሱ ሲመልስ ፊስጦስ በታላቅ ድምፅ። ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ አብድሃል እኮ፤ ብዙ ትምህርትህ ወደ እብደት ያዞርሃል አለው።

verses.en: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:
verses.fr: Mais, grâce au secours de Dieu, j''ai subsisté jusqu''à ce jour, rendant témoignage devant les petits et les grands, sans m''écarter en rien de ce que les prophètes et Moïse ont déclaré devoir arriver,
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ ስለ ራሱ ሲመልስ ፊስጦስ በታላቅ ድምፅ። ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ አብድሃል እኮ፤ ብዙ ትምህርትህ ወደ እብደት ያዞርሃል አለው።

verses.en: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
verses.fr: savoir que le Christ souffrirait, et que, ressuscité le premier d''entre les morts, il annoncerait la lumière au peuple et aux nations.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን እንዲህ አለ። ክቡር ፊስጦስ ሆይ፥ የእውነትንና የአእምሮን ነገር እናገራለሁ እንጂ እብደትስ የለብኝም።

verses.en: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait ainsi pour sa justification, Festus dit à haute voix: Tu es fou, Paul! Ton grand savoir te fait déraisonner.
verses.am: በእርሱ ፊት ደግሞ በግልጥ የምናገረው ንጉሥ ይህን ነገር ያውቃል፤ ከዚህ ነገር አንዳች እንዳይሰወርበት ተረድቼአለሁና፤ ይህ በስውር የተደረገ አይደለምና።

verses.en: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.
verses.fr: Je ne suis point fou, très excellent Festus, répliqua Paul; ce sont, au contraire, des paroles de vérité et de bon sens que je prononce.
verses.am: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ነቢያትን ታምናለህን? እንድታምናቸው አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
verses.fr: Le roi est instruit de ces choses, et je lui en parle librement; car je suis persuadé qu''il n''en ignore aucune, puisque ce n''est pas en cachette qu''elles se sont passées.
verses.am: አግሪጳም ጳውሎስን። በጥቂት ክርስቲያን ልታደርገኝ ትወዳለህ አለው።

verses.en: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
verses.fr: Crois-tu aux prophètes, roi Agrippa?... Je sais que tu y crois.
verses.am: ጳውሎስም። በጥቂት ቢሆን ወይም በብዙ አንተ ብቻ አይደለህም ነገር ግን ዛሬ የሚሰሙኝ ሁሉ ደግሞ ከዚህ እስራቴ በቀር እንደ እኔ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እለምናለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
verses.fr: Et Agrippa dit à Paul: Tu vas bientôt me persuader de devenir chrétien!
verses.am: ንጉሡም አገረ ገዡም በርኒቄም ከእነርሱም ጋር ተቀምጠው የነበሩት ተነሡ፥

verses.en: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
verses.fr: Paul répondit: Que ce soit bientôt ou que ce soit tard, plaise à Dieu que non seulement toi, mais encore tous ceux qui m''écoutent aujourd''hui, vous deveniez tels que je suis, à l''exception de ces liens!
verses.am: ፈቀቅ ብለውም እርስ በርሳቸው። ይህ ሰው እንኳንስ ለሞት ለእስራትም የሚገባ ምንም አላደረገ ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
verses.fr: Le roi, le gouverneur, Bérénice, et tous ceux qui étaient assis avec eux se levèrent,
verses.am: አግሪጳም ፈስጦስን። ይህ ሰው እኮ ወደ ቄሣር ይግባኝ ባይል ይፈታ ዘንድ ይቻል ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
verses.fr: et, en se retirant, ils se disaient les uns aux autres: Cet homme n''a rien fait qui mérite la mort ou la prison.
verses.am: ፈቀቅ ብለውም እርስ በርሳቸው። ይህ ሰው እንኳንስ ለሞት ለእስራትም የሚገባ ምንም አላደረገ ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.
verses.fr: Et Agrippa dit à Festus: Cet homme pouvait être relâché, s''il n''en eût pas appelé à César.
verses.am: አግሪጳም ፈስጦስን። ይህ ሰው እኮ ወደ ቄሣር ይግባኝ ባይል ይፈታ ዘንድ ይቻል ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut décidé que nous nous embarquerions pour l''Italie, on remit Paul et quelques autres prisonniers à un centenier de la cohorte Auguste, nommé Julius.
verses.am: ወደ ኢጣሊያም በመርከብ እንሄድ ዘንድ በተቈረጠ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስንና ሌሎችን እስረኞች ከአውግስጦስ ጭፍራ ለነበረ ዩልዮስ ለሚሉት ለመቶ አለቃ አሳልፈው ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
verses.fr: Nous montâmes sur un navire d''Adramytte, qui devait côtoyer l''Asie, et nous partîmes, ayant avec nous Aristarque, Macédonien de Thessalonique.
verses.am: በእስያም ዳርቻ ወዳሉ ስፍራዎች ይሄድ ዘንድ ባለው በአድራሚጢስ መርከብ ገብተን ተነሣን፤ የመቄዶንያም ሰው የሆነ የተሰሎንቄው አርስጥሮኮስ ከእኛ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
verses.fr: Le jour suivant, nous abordâmes à Sidon; et Julius, qui traitait Paul avec bienveillance, lui permit d''aller chez ses amis et de recevoir leurs soins.
verses.am: በነገውም ወደ ሲዶና ስንደርስ ዩልዮስ ለጳውሎስ ቸርነት አድርጎ እርዳታቸውን ይቀበል ዘንድ ወደ ወዳጆቹ እንዲሄድ ፈቀደለት።

verses.en: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
verses.fr: Partis de là, nous longeâmes l''île de Chypre, parce que les vents étaient contraires.
verses.am: ከዚያም ተነሥተን ነፋሱ ፊት ለፊት ነበረና በቆጵሮስ ተተግነን ሄድን፤

verses.en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
verses.fr: Après avoir traversé la mer qui baigne la Cilicie et la Pamphylie, nous arrivâmes à Myra en Lycie.
verses.am: በኪልቅያና በጵንፍልያም አጠገብ ያለውን ባሕር ከተሻገርን በኋላ በሉቅያ ወዳለ ወደ ሙራ ደረስን።

verses.en: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.
verses.fr: Et là, le centenier, ayant trouvé un navire d''Alexandrie qui allait en Italie, nous y fit monter.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃውም በዚያ ወደ ኢጣሊያ የሚሄድ የእስክንድርያውን መርከብ አግኝቶ ወደ እርሱ አገባን።

verses.en: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
verses.fr: Pendant plusieurs jours nous naviguâmes lentement, et ce ne fut pas sans difficulté que nous atteignîmes la hauteur de Cnide, où le vent ne nous permit pas d''aborder. Nous passâmes au-dessous de l''île de Crète, du côté de Salmone.
verses.am: ብዙ ቀንም እያዘገምን ሄደን በጭንቅ ወደ ቀኒዶስ አንጻር ደረስን፤ ነፋስም ስለ ከለከለን በቀርጤስ ተተግነን በሰልሙና አንጻር ሄድን፤

verses.en: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
verses.fr: Nous la côtoyâmes avec peine, et nous arrivâmes à un lieu nommé Beaux Ports, près duquel était la ville de Lasée.
verses.am: በጭንቅም ጥግ ጥጉን አልፈን ለላሲያ ከተማ ወደ ቀረበች መልካም ወደብ ወደሚሉአት ስፍራ መጣን።

verses.en: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,
verses.fr: Un temps assez long s''était écoulé, et la navigation devenait dangereuse, car l''époque même du jeûne était déjà passée. C''est pourquoi Paul avertit
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜም ካለፈ በኋላ፥ የጦም ወራት አሁን አልፎ ስለ ነበረ በመርከብ ለመሄድ አሁን የሚያስፈራ ነበርና ጳውሎስ።

verses.en: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.
verses.fr: les autres, en disant: O hommes, je vois que la navigation ne se fera pas sans péril et sans beaucoup de dommage, non seulement pour la cargaison et pour le navire, mais encore pour nos personnes.
verses.am: እናንተ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ይህ ጕዞ በጥፋትና በብዙ ጕዳት እንዲሆን አያለሁ፤ ጥፋቱም በገዛ ሕይወታችን ነው እንጂ በጭነቱና በመርከቡ ብቻ አይደለም ብሎ መከራቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.
verses.fr: Le centenier écouta le pilote et le patron du navire plutôt que les paroles de Paul.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃው ግን ጳውሎስ ከተናገረው ይልቅ የመርከብ መሪውንና የመርከቡን ባለቤት ያምን ነበር።

verses.en: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
verses.fr: Et comme le port n''était pas bon pour hiverner, la plupart furent d''avis de le quitter pour tâcher d''atteindre Phénix, port de Crète qui regarde le sud-ouest et le nord-ouest, afin d''y passer l''hiver.
verses.am: ያም ወደብ ይከርሙበት ዘንድ የማይመች ስለ ሆነ፥ የሚበዙቱ ቢቻላቸው በሰሜንና በደቡብ ምዕራብ ትይዩ ወዳለው ፍንቄ ወደሚሉት ወደ ቀርጤስ ወደብ ደርሰው ይከርሙ ዘንድ ከዚያ እንዲነሡ መከሩ።

verses.en: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
verses.fr: Un léger vent du sud vint à souffler, et, se croyant maîtres de leur dessein, ils levèrent l''ancre et côtoyèrent de près l''île de Crète.
verses.am: ልከኛም የደቡብ ነፋስ በነፈሰ ጊዜ፥ እንዳሰቡት የሆነላቸው መስሎአቸው ተነሡ በቀርጤስም አጠገብ ጥግ ጥጉን አለፉ።

verses.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
verses.fr: Mais bientôt un vent impétueux, qu''on appelle Euraquilon, se déchaîna sur l''île.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እጅግ ሳይዘገይ አውራቂስ የሚሉት ዓውሎ ነፋስ ከዚያ ወረደባቸው፤

verses.en: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
verses.fr: Le navire fut entraîné, sans pouvoir lutter contre le vent, et nous nous laissâmes aller à la dérive.
verses.am: መርከቡም ተነጥቆ ነፋሱን ሲቃወም መሄድ ስላልቻለ ለቀነው ተነዳን።

verses.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:
verses.fr: Nous passâmes au-dessous d''une petite île nommée Clauda, et nous eûmes de la peine à nous rendre maîtres de la chaloupe;
verses.am: ቄዳ በሚሉአትም ደሴት በተተገንን ጊዜ ታንኳይቱን ለመግዛት በጭንቅ ቻልን፤

verses.en: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.
verses.fr: après l''avoir hissée, on se servit des moyens de secours pour ceindre le navire, et, dans la crainte de tomber sur la Syrte, on abaissa les voiles. C''est ainsi qu''on se laissa emporter par le vent.
verses.am: ወደ ላይም ካወጡአት በኋላ መርከቡን በገመድ አስታጥቀው አጸኑ፤ ስርቲስም ወደሚሉት ወደ አሸዋ እንዳይወድቁ ፈርተው ሸራውን አውርደው እንዲሁ ተነዱ።

verses.en: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;
verses.fr: Comme nous étions violemment battus par la tempête, le lendemain on jeta la cargaison à la mer,
verses.am: ነፋሱም በርትቶ ሲያስጨንቀን በማንግሥቱ ከጭነቱ ወደ ባሕር ይጥሉ ነበር፥

verses.en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
verses.fr: et le troisième jour nous y lançâmes de nos propres mains les agrès du navire.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን የመርከቡን ዕቃ በእጃችን ወረወርን።

verses.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
verses.fr: Le soleil et les étoiles ne parurent pas pendant plusieurs jours, et la tempête était si forte que nous perdîmes enfin toute espérance de nous sauver.
verses.am: ብዙ ቀንም ፀሐይን ከዋክብትንም ሳናይ ትልቅ ነፋስም ሲበረታብን ጊዜ፥ ወደ ፊት እንድናለን የማለት ተስፋ ሁሉ ተቈረጠ።

verses.en: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
verses.fr: On n''avait pas mangé depuis longtemps. Alors Paul, se tenant au milieu d''eux, leur dit: O hommes, il fallait m''écouter et ne pas partir de Crète, afin d''éviter ce péril et ce dommage.
verses.am: ሳይበሉም ብዙ ቀን ከቆዩ በኋላ፥ ያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ሰምታችሁኝ በሆነ ኖሮ ከቀርጤስ እንዳትነሡ ይህንም ጥፋትና ጕዳት እንዳታገኙ ይገባችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
verses.fr: Maintenant je vous exhorte à prendre courage; car aucun de vous ne périra, et il n''y aura de perte que celle du navire.
verses.am: አሁንም። አይዞአችሁ ብዬ እመክራችኋለሁ፤ ይህ መርከብ እንጂ ከእናንተ አንድ ነፍስ እንኳ አይጠፋምና።

verses.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
verses.fr: Un ange du Dieu à qui j''appartiens et que je sers m''est apparu cette nuit,
verses.am: የእርሱ የምሆንና ደግሞ የማመልከው የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በዚች ሌሊት በአጠገቤ ቆሞ ነበርና፥ እርሱም።

verses.en: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
verses.fr: et m''a dit: Paul, ne crains point; il faut que tu comparaisses devant César, et voici, Dieu t''a donné tous ceux qui naviguent avec toi.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ በቄሣር ፊት ልትቆም ይገባሃል፤ እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር የሚሄዱትን ሁሉ ሰጥቶሃል አለኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, ô hommes, rassurez-vous, car j''ai cette confiance en Dieu qu''il en sera comme il m''a été dit.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እናንተ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ አይዞአችሁ፤ እንደ ተናገረኝ እንዲሁ እንዲሆን እግዚአብሔርን አምናለሁና።

verses.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
verses.fr: Mais nous devons échouer sur une île.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ አንዲት ደሴት እንድንወድቅ ያስፈልገናል።

verses.en: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
verses.fr: La quatorzième nuit, tandis que nous étions ballottés sur l''Adriatique, les matelots, vers le milieu de la nuit, soupçonnèrent qu''on approchait de quelque terre.
verses.am: በአሥራ አራተኛውም ሌሊት በአድርያ ባሕር ወዲህና ወዲያ ስንነዳ፥ መርከበኞች በእኩለ ሌሊት ወደ አንድ ምድር የቀረቡ መሰላቸው።

verses.en: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
verses.fr: Ayant jeté la sonde, ils trouvèrent vingt brasses; un peu plus loin, ils la jetèrent de nouveau, et trouvèrent quinze brasses.
verses.am: መለኪያ ገመድም ቢጥሉ ሀያ በሰው ቁመት አገኙ ጥቂትም ቆይተው ሁለተኛ ቢጥሉ አሥራ አምስት በሰው ቁመት አገኙ፤

verses.en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
verses.fr: Dans la crainte de heurter contre des écueils, ils jetèrent quatre ancres de la poupe, et attendirent le jour avec impatience.
verses.am: ድንጋያማም ወደ ሆነ ስፍራ እንዳይወድቁ ፈርተው፥ ከመርከቡ በስተኋላ አራት መልሕቅ አወረዱ፥ ቀንም እንዲሆን ተመኙ።

verses.en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
verses.fr: Mais, comme les matelots cherchaient à s''échapper du navire, et mettaient la chaloupe à la mer sous prétexte de jeter les ancres de la proue,
verses.am: መርከበኞቹም ከመርከቡ ይሸሹ ዘንድ ፈልገው ከመርከቡ በስተ ፊት መልሕቅ መጣል እንዳላቸው አመካኝተው ታንኳይቱን ወደ ባሕር ባወረዱ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
verses.fr: Paul dit au centenier et aux soldats: Si ces hommes ne restent pas dans le navire, vous ne pouvez être sauvés.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ለመቶ አለቃውና ለወታደሮቹ። እነዚህ በመርከቡ ካልቆዩ እናንተ ትድኑ ዘንድ አትችሉም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
verses.fr: Alors les soldats coupèrent les cordes de la chaloupe, et la laissèrent tomber.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ወታደሮቹ የታንኳይቱን ገመድ ቈርጠው ትወድቅ ዘንድ ተዉአት።

verses.en: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
verses.fr: Avant que le jour parût, Paul exhorta tout le monde à prendre de la nourriture, disant: C''est aujourd''hui le quatorzième jour que vous êtes dans l''attente et que vous persistez à vous abstenir de manger.
verses.am: ቀንም ሲነጋ ጳውሎስ ምግብ ይበሉ ዘንድ ሁሉን ይለምን ነበር፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። እየጠበቃችሁ ምንም ሳትቀበሉ ጦማችሁን ከሰነበታችሁ ዛሬ አሥራ አራተኛ ቀናችሁ ነው።

verses.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
verses.fr: Je vous invite donc à prendre de la nourriture, car cela est nécessaire pour votre salut, et il ne se perdra pas un cheveu de la tête d''aucun de vous.
verses.am: ሰለዚህ ምግብ ትበሉ ዘንድ እለምናችኋለሁ፤ ይህ ለደኅንነታችሁ ይሆናልና፤ ከእናንተ ከአንዱ የራስ ጠጕር እንኳ አትጠፋምና።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
verses.fr: Ayant ainsi parlé, il prit du pain, et, après avoir rendu grâces à Dieu devant tous, il le rompit, et se mit à manger.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ እንጀራን ይዞ በሁሉ ፊት እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ ቈርሶም ይበላ ዘንድ ጀመረ።

verses.en: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
verses.fr: Et tous, reprenant courage, mangèrent aussi.
verses.am: ሁለም ተጽናንተው ራሳቸው ደግሞ ምግብ ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
verses.fr: Nous étions, dans le navire, deux cent soixante-seize personnes en tout.
verses.am: በመርከቡም ያለን ሁላችን ሁለት መቶ ሰባ ስድስት ነፍስ ነበርን።

verses.en: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
verses.fr: Quand ils eurent mangé suffisamment, ils allégèrent le navire en jetant le blé à la mer.
verses.am: በልተውም በጠገቡ ጊዜ ስንዴውን ወደ ባሕር እየጣሉ መርከቡን አቃለሉት።

verses.en: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.
verses.fr: Lorsque le jour fut venu, ils ne reconnurent point la terre; mais, ayant aperçu un golfe avec une plage, ils résolurent d''y pousser le navire, s''ils le pouvaient.
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ ምድሩን አላወቁትም፥ ነገር ግን የአሸዋ ዳር ያለውን የባሕር ስርጥ ተመለከቱ፥ ቢቻላቸውም መርከቡን ወደዚያ ይገፉ ዘንድ ቈረጡ።

verses.en: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
verses.fr: Ils délièrent les ancres pour les laisser aller dans la mer, et ils relâchèrent en même temps les attaches des gouvernails; puis ils mirent au vent la voile d''artimon, et se dirigèrent vers le rivage.
verses.am: መልሕቆቹንም ፈትተው በባሕር ተዉአቸው፥ ያን ጊዜም የመቅዘፊያውን ማሠሪያ ፈቱት፤ ታናሹንም ሸራ ለነፋስ ከፍ አድርገው ወደ ዳር አቅንተው ይሄዱ ዘንድ ጀመሩ።

verses.en: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
verses.fr: Mais ils rencontrèrent une langue de terre, où ils firent échouer le navire; et la proue, s''étant engagée, resta immobile, tandis que la poupe se brisait par la violence des vagues.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁለት ባሕር በተገናኙበት ስፍራ ወድቀው መርከቡን በዲብ ላይ ነዱ፤ በስተ ፊቱም ተተክሎ የማይነቃነቅ ሆነ፥ በስተ ኋላው ግን ከማዕበሉ ግፊያ የተነሣ ይሰበር ነበር።

verses.en: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
verses.fr: Les soldats furent d''avis de tuer les prisonniers, de peur que quelqu''un d''eux ne s''échappât à la nage.
verses.am: ወታደሮቹም ከእስረኞች አንድ ስንኳ ዋኝቶ እንዳያመልጥ ይገድሉአቸው ዘንድ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:
verses.fr: Mais le centenier, qui voulait sauver Paul, les empêcha d''exécuter ce dessein. Il ordonna à ceux qui savaient nager de se jeter les premiers dans l''eau pour gagner la terre,
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃው ግን ጳውሎስን ያድነው ዘንድ አስቦ ምክራቸውን ከለከለ፤ ዋና የሚያውቁትም ከመርከብ ራሳቸውን እየወረወሩ አስቀድመው ወደ ምድር ይወጡ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
verses.fr: et aux autres de se mettre sur des planches ou sur des débris du navire. Et ainsi tous parvinrent à terre sains et saufs.
verses.am: የቀሩትም እኵሌቶቹ በሳንቃዎች ላይ እኵሌቶቹም በመርከቡ ስባሪ ይወጡ ዘንድ አዘዘ። እንዲሁም ሁሉ በደኅና ወደ ምድር ደረሱ።

verses.en: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
verses.fr: Après nous être sauvés, nous reconnûmes que l''île s''appelait Malte.
verses.am: በደኅና ከደረስን በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ ደሴቲቱ መላጥያ እንድትባል አወቅን።

verses.en: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
verses.fr: Les barbares nous témoignèrent une bienveillance peu commune; ils nous recueillirent tous auprès d''un grand feu, qu''ils avaient allumé parce que la pluie tombait et qu''il faisait grand froid.
verses.am: አረማውያንም የሚያስገርም ቸርነት አደረጉልን፤ ዝናብ ስለ ሆነም ስለ ብርዱም እሳት አንድደው ሁላችንን ተቀበሉን።

verses.en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
verses.fr: Paul ayant ramassé un tas de broussailles et l''ayant mis au feu, une vipère en sortit par l''effet de la chaleur et s''attacha à sa main.
verses.am: ጳውሎስ ግን ብዙ ጭራሮ አከማችቶ ወደ እሳት ሲጨምር እፉኝት ከሙቀት የተነሣ ወጥታ እጁን ነደፈችው።

verses.en: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
verses.fr: Quand les barbares virent l''animal suspendu à sa main, ils se dirent les uns aux autres: Assurément cet homme est un meurtrier, puisque la Justice n''a pas voulu le laisser vivre, après qu''il a été sauvé de la mer.
verses.am: አረማውያንም እባብ በእጁ ተንጠልጥላ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ እርስ በርሳቸው። ይህ ሰው በእርግጥ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፥ ከባሕርም ስንኳ በደኅና ቢወጣ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ አልተወውም አሉ።

verses.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
verses.fr: Paul secoua l''animal dans le feu, et ne ressentit aucun mal.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን እባቢቱን ወደ እሳት አራገፋት አንዳችም አልጐዳችውም፤

verses.en: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
verses.fr: Ces gens s''attendaient à le voir enfler ou tomber mort subitement; mais, après avoir longtemps attendu, voyant qu''il ne lui arrivait aucun mal, ils changèrent d''avis et dirent que c''était un dieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሊያብጥ ወይም ወዲያው ሞቶ ሊወድቅ ነው ብለው ይጠባበቁት ነበር ብዙ ጊዜ ግን ሲጠባበቁ በእርሱ ላይ የሚያስገርም ነገር ምንም ባላዩ ጊዜ። ይህስ አምላክ ነው ብለው አሳባቸውን ለወጡ።

verses.en: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
verses.fr: Il y avait, dans les environs, des terres appartenant au principal personnage de l''île, nommé Publius, qui nous reçut et nous logea pendant trois jours de la manière la plus amicale.
verses.am: በዚያም ስፍራ አጠገብ ፑፕልዮስ የሚሉት የደሴት አለቃ መሬት ነበረ፥ እርሱም እንግድነት ተቀብሎን ሦስት ቀን በፍቅር አሳደረን።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
verses.fr: Le père de Publius était alors au lit, malade de la fièvre et de la dysenterie; Paul, s''étant rendu vers lui, pria, lui imposa les mains, et le guérit.
verses.am: የፑፕልዮስም አባት በንዳድና በተቅማጥ ታሞ ተኝቶ ነበር፤ ጳውሎስም ወደ እርሱ ገብቶ ጸለየለት እጁንም በላዩ ጭኖ ፈወሰው።

verses.en: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
verses.fr: Là-dessus, vinrent les autres malades de l''île, et ils furent guéris.
verses.am: ይህም በሆነ ጊዜ የቀሩት ደግሞ በደሴቲቱ ደዌ የነበረባቸው እየመጡ ተፈወሱ፤

verses.en: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
verses.fr: On nous rendit de grands honneurs, et, à notre départ, on nous fournit les choses dont nous avions besoin.
verses.am: በብዙ ክብርም ደግሞ አከበሩን፥ በተነሣንም ጊዜ በመርከብ ላይ የሚያስፈልገንን ነገር አኖሩልን።

verses.en: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
verses.fr: Après un séjour de trois mois, nous nous embarquâmes sur un navire d''Alexandrie, qui avait passé l''hiver dans l''île, et qui portait pour enseigne les Dioscures.
verses.am: ከሦስት ወርም በኋላ በደሴቲቱ ከርሞ በነበረው በእስክንድርያው መርከብ ተነሣን፥ በእርሱም የዲዮስቆሮስ አላማ ነበረበት።

verses.en: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
verses.fr: Ayant abordé à Syracuse, nous y restâmes trois jours.
verses.am: ወደ ሰራኩስም በገባን ጊዜ ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጥን፤

verses.en: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
verses.fr: De là, en suivant la côte, nous atteignîmes Reggio; et, le vent du midi s''étant levé le lendemain, nous fîmes en deux jours le trajet jusqu''à Pouzzoles,
verses.am: ከዚያም እየተዛወርን ወደ ሬጊዩም ደረስን። ከአንድ ቀን በኋላም የደቡብ ነፋስ በነፈሰ ጊዜ በሁለተኛው ቀን ወደ ፑቲዮሉስ መጣን።

verses.en: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
verses.fr: où nous trouvâmes des frères qui nous prièrent de passer sept jours avec eux. Et c''est ainsi que nous allâmes à Rome.
verses.am: በዚያም ወንድሞችን አግኝተን በእነርሱ ዘንድ ሰባት ቀን እንድንቀመጥ ለመኑን፤ እንዲሁም ወደ ሮሜ መጣን።

verses.en: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
verses.fr: De Rome vinrent à notre rencontre, jusqu''au Forum d''Appius et aux Trois Tavernes, les frères qui avaient entendu parler de nous. Paul, en les voyant, rendit grâces à Dieu, et prit courage.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወንድሞች ስለ እኛ ሰምተው እስከ አፍዩስ ፋሩስና ሦስት ማደሪያ እስከሚባለው ሊቀበሉን ወጡ፥ ጳውሎስም ባያቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ ልቡም ተጽናና።

verses.en: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
verses.fr: Lorsque nous fûmes arrivés à Rome, on permit à Paul de demeurer en son particulier, avec un soldat qui le gardait.
verses.am: ወደ ሮሜም በገባን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ ከሚጠብቀው ወታደር ጋር ለብቻው ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ተፈቀደለት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
verses.fr: Au bout de trois jours, Paul convoqua les principaux des Juifs; et, quand ils furent réunis, il leur adressa ces paroles: Hommes frères, sans avoir rien fait contre le peuple ni contre les coutumes de nos pères, j''ai été mis en prison à Jérusalem et livré de là entre les mains des Romains.
verses.am: ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ጳውሎስ የአይሁድን ታላላቆች ወደ እርሱ ጠራ፤ በተሰበሰቡም ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ሕዝቡን ወይም የአባቶችን ሥርዓት የሚቃወም አንዳች ሳላደርግ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ታሰርሁ በሮማውያን እጅ አሳልፈው ሰጡኝ።

verses.en: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
verses.fr: Après m''avoir interrogé, ils voulaient me relâcher, parce qu''il n''y avait en moi rien qui méritât la mort.
verses.am: እነርሱም መርምረው ለሞት የሚገባ ምክንያት ስላልነበረብኝ ሊፈቱኝ አሰቡ፤

verses.en: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
verses.fr: Mais les Juifs s''y opposèrent, et j''ai été forcé d''en appeler à César, n''ayant du reste aucun dessein d''accuser ma nation.
verses.am: አይሁድ ግን በተቃወሙ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቄሣር ይግባኝ እንድል ግድ ሆነብኝ እንጂ ሕዝቤን የምከስበት ነገር ኖሮኝ አይደለም።

verses.en: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi j''ai demandé à vous voir et à vous parler; car c''est à cause de l''espérance d''Israël que je porte cette chaîne.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት አያችሁና እነግራችሁ ዘንድ ጠራኋችሁ፤ ስለ እስራኤል ተስፋ ይህን ሰንሰለት ለብሻለሁና።

verses.en: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Nous n''avons reçu de Judée aucune lettre à ton sujet, et il n''est venu aucun frère qui ait rapporté ou dit du mal de toi.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እኛ ከይሁዳ ስለ አንተ ደብዳቤ አልተቀበልንም፥ ከወንድሞችም አንድ ስንኳ መጥቶ ስለ አንተ ክፉ ነገር አላወራልንም ወይም አልተናገረብህም።

verses.en: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
verses.fr: Mais nous voudrions apprendre de toi ce que tu penses, car nous savons que cette secte rencontre partout de l''opposition.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ወገን በየስፍራው ሁሉ እንዲቃወሙ በእኛ ዘንድ ታውቆአልና የምታስበውን ከአንተ እንሰማ ዘንድ እንፈቅዳለን አሉት።

verses.en: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
verses.fr: Ils lui fixèrent un jour, et plusieurs vinrent le trouver dans son logis. Paul leur annonça le royaume de Dieu, en rendant témoignage, et en cherchant, par la loi de Moïse et par les prophètes, à les persuader de ce qui concerne Jésus. L''entretien dura depuis le matin jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ቀንም ቀጥረውለት ብዙ ሆነው ወደ መኖሪያው ወደ እርሱ መጡ፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትም እየመሰከረ ስለ ኢየሱስም ከሙሴ ሕግና ከነቢያት ጠቅሶ እያስረዳቸው፥ ከጥዋት ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ይገልጥላቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
verses.fr: Les uns furent persuadés par ce qu''il disait, et les autres ne crurent point.
verses.am: እኵሌቶቹም የተናገረውን አመኑ፥ እኵሌቶቹ ግን አላመኑም፤

verses.en: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
verses.fr: Comme ils se retiraient en désaccord, Paul n''ajouta que ces mots: C''est avec raison que le Saint-Esprit, parlant à vos pères par le prophète Esaïe,
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም ባልተስማሙ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስ አንዲት ቃል ከተናገረ በኋላ ሄዱ፤ እንዲህም አለ። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ለአባቶቻችን።

verses.en: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
verses.fr: a dit: Va vers ce peuple, et dis: Vous entendrez de vos oreilles, et vous ne comprendrez point; Vous regarderez de vos yeux, et vous ne verrez point.
verses.am: ወደዚህ ሕዝብ ሂድና። መስማትን ትሰማላችሁና አታስተውሉም፥ ማየትንም ታያላችሁና አትመለከቱም፤

verses.en: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.fr: Car le coeur de ce peuple est devenu insensible; Ils ont endurci leurs oreilles, et ils ont fermé leurs yeux, De peur qu''ils ne voient de leurs yeux, qu''ils n''entendent de leurs oreilles, Qu''ils ne comprennent de leur coeur, Qu''ils ne se convertissent, et que je ne les guérisse.
verses.am: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ በጆሮአቸው እንዳይሰሙ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ ተመልሰውም እንዳልፈውሳቸው፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ደንድኖአል ጆሮአቸውም ደንቁሮአል ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍነዋል በላቸው

verses.en: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
verses.fr: Sachez donc que ce salut de Dieu a été envoyé aux païens, et qu''ils l''écouteront.
verses.am: ሲል መልካም ተናገረ። እንግዲህ ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ደኅንነት ለአሕዛብ እንደ ተላከ በእናንተ ዘንድ የታወቀ ይሁን፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ይሰሙታል።

verses.en: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut dit cela, les Juifs s''en allèrent, discutant vivement entre eux.
verses.am: ይህንም በተናገረ ጊዜ አይሁድ እርስ በርሳቸው እጅግ እየተከራከሩ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
verses.fr: Paul demeura deux ans entiers dans une maison qu''il avait louée. Il recevait tous ceux qui venaient le voir,
verses.am: ጳውሎስም በተከራየው ቤት ሁለት ዓመት ሙሉ ተቀመጠ፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚመጡትን ሁሉ ይቀበል ነበር፤

verses.en: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
verses.fr: prêchant le royaume de Dieu et enseignant ce qui concerne le Seigneur Jésus-Christ, en toute liberté et sans obstacle.
verses.am: ማንም ሳይከለክለው የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እየሰበከ ስለ ጌታ ስለ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እጅግ ገልጦ ያስተምር ነበር።
